_about: STEPBible TIPNR people and places (CC BY 4.0, STEPBible.org). Built by scripts/build-names.py.

0.d: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
0.b: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel
0.s: Aaron was Moses' older brother and served as the first high priest of Israel.

1.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1.b: One of King Ahasuerus' seven eunuchs
1.s: Abagtha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

2.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2.b: Father of Adoram, who was over forced labor
2.s: Abda was the father of Adoram (or 'Adoniram'), who was in charge of forced labor during Solomon's reign.

3.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3.b: Father of Shelemiah, an official under King Jehoiakim
3.s: Abdeel was the father of Shelemiah, an official sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah.

4.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
4.b: A Levite, ancestor of Ethan the musician
4.s: Abdi, a Levite, was an ancestor of Ethan, one of the musicians appointed by David to serve in the temple.

5.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
5.s: Abdi, a Levite, was the father of Kish and served during the reign of King Hezekiah.

6.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
6.b: An Israelite who married a foreign wife
6.s: Abdi, one of the descendants of Elam, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's time.

7.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
7.s: Abdiel, son of Guni, was a chief of a Gadite family during the time of Jotham, king of Judah.

8.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
8.s: Abdon was a son of Shashak and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

9.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
9.s: Abdon, the son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel') and brother of Ner, was a member of the Israelite community in Gibeon.

10.b: A minor judge of Israel from Ephraim
10.s: Abdon, the son of Hillel the Pirathonite, was a minor Judge of Israel who led for eight years.

11.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
11.b: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain
11.s: Abel, the second son of Adam and Eve, was a shepherd who was killed by his brother Cain.

12.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
12.b: Mother of King Hezekiah of Judah
12.s: Abi, also known as Abijah, was the mother of King Hezekiah and the daughter of Zechariah.

13.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
13.b: Wife of Hezron, who gave birth after he died
13.s: Abiah was the wife of Hezron who bore Ashhur after her husband's death.

14.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
14.b: One of David's mighty men, an Arbathite
14.s: Abi-albon, also known as Abiel, was one of David's mighty men, an Arbathite.

15.d: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
15.b: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon
15.s: Abiathar, son of Ahimelech, was a high priest who served during the reigns of David and Solomon.

16.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
16.b: Son of Midian, grandson of Abraham
16.s: Abida was a son of Midian and a grandson of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

17.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
17.b: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus
17.s: Abidan, son of Gideoni, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

18.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
18.b: Father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul
18.s: Abiel, also known as Jeiel, Ner, or Abigibeon (or '[re]-founder of Gibeon'), was the father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul.

19.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
19.b: Son of Hammolecheth, from the tribe of Manasseh
19.s: Abiezer, son of Hammolecheth, was a descendant of Manasseh and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

20.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
20.b: One of David's mighty men, from Anathoth
20.s: Abiezer the Anathothite was one of David's mighty men and served as a commander in his army.

21.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
21.b: Clan of Manasseh, home of Gideon
21.s: Abiezer, also known as Iezer, was a clan of the tribe of Manasseh and the home of Gideon, one of Israel's judges.

22.d: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy
22.b: Wife of Nabal, later married David
22.s: Abigail, initially the wife of Nabal, became one of David's wives after Nabal's death and bore him a son named Chileab.

23.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
23.b: Sister of David; mother of Amasa
23.s: Abigail, David's sister, was the mother of Amasa, who became the commander of Absalom's army.

24.d: Woman of living at the time of Divided Monarchy
24.b: Wife of Abishur; mother of Ahban and Molid
24.s: Abihail was the wife of Abishur and the mother of Ahban and Molid, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

25.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
25.s: Abihail, a descendant of Guni, was a leader of the tribe of Gad who lived in Gilead.

26.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
26.s: Abihail was the mother of Mahalath, who was one of King Rehoboam's wives and the daughter of David's son Jerimoth.

27.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
27.s: Abihail was the father of Esther (also known as Hadassah), who became Queen of Persia and saved the Jewish people from Haman's plot.

28.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
28.b: Father of Zuriel, a Levite leader
28.s: Abihail was the father of Zuriel, who was the leader of the Merarite clan of the Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

29.d: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
29.s: Abihu was a son of Aaron who served as a priest. (<ref="Exo.6.23">Exo.6.23</ref>)

30.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
30.s: Abihud was a son of Bela and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

31.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
31.b: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
31.s: Abijah was the head of the eighth priestly division established during King David's reign, and Zechariah, the father of John the Baptist, belonged to this division.

32.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
32.s: Abijah was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

33.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
33.b: Son of Jeroboam I, died in childhood
33.s: Abijah, the son of King Jeroboam I, fell ill and died in childhood, as prophesied by Ahijah the prophet.

34.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
34.b: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam
34.s: Abijah, the son of Rehoboam, reigned as king of Judah for three years and continued in the sins of his father.

35.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
35.b: Son of Samuel, a corrupt judge
35.s: Abijah was one of Samuel's sons who served as a judge in Israel but did not follow his father's righteous ways.

36.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
36.s: Abijah was one of the priests who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time and was also listed among the priests who returned from the Babylonian exile.

37.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
37.b: Descendant of Shem, son of Joktan
37.s: Abimael was a descendant of Shem and one of the sons of Joktan, as mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

38.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
38.b: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac
38.s: Abimelech was a Philistine king who had dealings with both Abraham and Isaac, involving incidents where the patriarchs claimed their wives were their sisters.

39.b: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem
39.s: Abimelech, a son of Gideon, declared himself king of Shechem but was eventually killed when a millstone was dropped on his head during the siege of Thebez.

40.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
40.b: Solomon's son-in-law, an official in his government
40.s: Abinadab, the son of Iddo, was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath and served as an official in Solomon's government, overseeing the region of Dor.

41.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
41.b: Son of King Saul, killed in battle
41.s: Abinadab, also known as Ishvi, was one of the sons of King Saul who died alongside his father and brothers in battle against the Philistines at Mount Gilboa.

42.d: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
42.b: Son of Jesse, brother of David
42.s: Abinadab was one of the sons of Jesse and an older brother of King David, but he was not chosen to be anointed as king by Samuel.

43.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
43.b: Kept the ark of God in his house
43.s: Abinadab, in whose house the ark of God was kept for 20 years.

44.b: Father of Barak, the Israelite commander
44.s: Abinoam was the father of Barak, the Israelite commander who, along with the prophetess Deborah, led the Israelites to victory against the Canaanite army led by Sisera.

45.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
45.b: Firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite
45.s: Abiram, the firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite, died when his father laid the foundation of Jericho.

46.d: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
46.b: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron
46.s: Abiram, along with Korah and Dathan, led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed up by the earth.

47.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
47.b: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David
47.s: Abishag, the beautiful Shunammite who served King David in his old age and was later sought as a wife by Adonijah.

48.d: David's warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
48.b: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders
48.s: Abishai, the son of Zeruiah and nephew of David, was a loyal commander and one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and military prowess.

49.d: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
49.b: Son of Phinehas, grandson of Eleazar the high priest
49.s: Abishua was the son of Phinehas and grandson of Eleazar, who served as high priests in the line of Aaron.

50.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
50.b: Descendant of Benjamin, son of Bela
50.s: Abishua was a descendant of Benjamin and one of the sons of Bela mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

51.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
51.b: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah
51.s: Abishur, the son of Shammai, was a descendant of Judah; he married Abihail, and they had two sons, Ahban and Molid.

52.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
52.b: One of David's wives; mother of Shephatiah
52.s: Abital was one of King David's wives and the mother of his son Shephatiah.

53.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
53.s: Abitub was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjaminite, and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

54.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
54.b: Son of Zerubbabel, ancestor of Jesus
54.s: Abiud was the son of Zerubbabel and is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in the Gospel of Matthew.

55.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
55.b: Saul's cousin and commander of his army
55.s: Abner, the son of Ner, was King Saul's cousin and the commander of his army; he later supported Saul's son Ish-bosheth as king before defecting to David.

56.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
56.b: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people
56.s: Abraham, originally named Abram, was the patriarch whom God called to leave his homeland and blessed to become the father of many nations, establishing His covenant with him and his descendants.

57.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
57.b: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.
57.s: Absalom was David's third son who led a revolt against his father's reign.

58.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
58.b: A Corinthian Christian who visited Paul.
58.s: Achaicus, along with Stephanas and Fortunatus, visited Paul from Corinth.

59.b: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.
59.s: Achan took devoted things, leading to Israel's defeat at Ai.

60.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
60.b: Official during the reign of King Josiah
60.s: Achbor, also known as Abdon, was an official during the reign of King Josiah of Judah and was involved in the discovery of the Book of the Law and the subsequent religious reforms.

61.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
61.s: Achbor was an Edomite king, the son of Baal-hanan, who reigned before the establishment of the Israelite monarchy.

62.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
62.b: Ancestor of Jesus, son of Zadok (or 'Sadoc')
62.s: Achim was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew.

63.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
63.b: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David
63.s: Achish, also referred to as Abimelech, was the Philistine king of Gath who granted refuge to David when he fled from King Saul, but later dismissed him due to the suspicion of his servants.

64.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
64.b: Daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur
64.s: Achsah is mentioned as the daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur, in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

65.b: Daughter of Caleb; wife of Othniel
65.s: Achsah was the daughter of Caleb, given in marriage to Othniel as a reward for capturing Kiriath-sepher, and she requested springs of water from her father as a blessing.

66.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
66.b: Hittite wife of Esau; mother of Eliphaz
66.s: Adah, also known as Basemath, was one of Esau's Hittite wives and the mother of Eliphaz, who became a chief in the land of Edom.

67.d: Woman living at the time before the Flood
67.b: Wife of Lamech; mother of Jabal and Jubal
67.s: Adah was one of the two wives of Lamech, a descendant of Cain, and the mother of Jabal, the first to live in tents and raise livestock, and Jubal, the first to play the lyre and pipe.

68.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
68.s: Adaiah, a descendant of Benjamin, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

69.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
69.b: Priest, descendant of Malchijah, during the post-exilic period
69.s: Adaiah, a priest and descendant of Malchijah, served in the house of God during the post-exilic period in Jerusalem.

70.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
70.b: Father of Maaseiah, during the reign of Joash
70.s: Adaiah was the father of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king of Judah.

71.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
71.b: Father of Jedidah who was mother of King Josiah of Judah
71.s: Adaiah of Bozkath's daughter Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah, who reigned over Judah and initiated significant religious reforms.

72.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
72.b: A leader who married a foreign wife
72.s: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Bani, was among the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

73.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
73.b: A priest who married a foreign wife
73.s: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Harim, was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

74.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
74.b: An ancestor of Maaseiah, a resident of Jerusalem
74.s: Adaiah was an ancestor of Maaseiah, a leader who resided in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

75.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
75.b: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
75.s: Adalia was one of the ten sons of Haman, the enemy of the Jews, who was killed along with his brothers.

76.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
76.b: The first man, created by God
76.s: Adam, the first man created by God, sinned and brought death into the world, but through Christ, the last Adam, came life and resurrection.

77.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
77.b: Son of Ishmael, grandson of Abraham
77.s: Adbeel was a son of Ishmael and a grandson of Abraham, likely representing an Arab tribe or clan.

78.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
78.s: Addar, also known as Ard, was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.

79.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
79.s: Addi was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy in the Gospel of Luke.

80.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
80.s: Adiel, the son of Azmaveth, was one of the officials in charge of King David's treasuries.

81.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
81.b: Simeonite leader during the reign of Hezekiah
81.s: Adiel was one of the Simeonite leaders who, during the reign of King Hezekiah, attacked the Hamites and Meunites in the valley of Gedor and settled in their lands.

82.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
82.b: A priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
82.s: Adiel (also called Azarel) was a priest who served in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

83.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
83.b: Jewish exile who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel
83.s: Adin was one of the Jewish exiles who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian captivity, as recorded in the lists of returnees in Ezra and Nehemiah.

84.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
84.b: Jewish leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant
84.s: Adin was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during the time of Nehemiah.

85.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
85.b: One of David's mighty men, a Reubenite leader
85.s: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, was one of David's mighty men and a leader among the Reubenites.

86.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
86.b: Alternate name or description of Josheb-Basshebeth
86.s: Adino the Eznite is mentioned in some translations of <ref="2Sa.23.8">2Sa.23.8</ref>) as one of David's mighty men, but the Hebrew text is unclear, and it may be a description of Josheb-Basshebeth's actions rather than a separate person.

87.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
87.b: Overseer of King David's herds in the valleys
87.s: Adlai was responsible for overseeing King David's herds that were pastured in the valleys.

88.d: Prince living at the time of Exile and Return
88.b: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
88.s: Admatha was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

89.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
89.b: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile
89.s: Adna was one of the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Babylonian exile and pledged to put away his foreign wife as part of Ezra's reforms.

90.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
90.b: Priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim
90.s: Adna was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

91.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
91.b: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
91.s: Adnah was one of the Manassite leaders who defected to David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

92.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
92.b: Commander of 300,000 troops under King Jehoshaphat
92.s: Adnah was a commander from Judah who led 300,000 mighty men of valor in King Jehoshaphat's army.

93.b: Canaanite king captured and mutilated by Judah
93.s: Adoni-bezek was a Canaanite king who was defeated by the men of Judah, and had his thumbs and big toes cut off as he had done to seventy other kings.

94.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
94.b: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
94.s: Adonijah was one of the Levites King Jehoshaphat sent to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

95.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
95.b: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne
95.s: Adonijah, the fourth son of David, declared himself king when David was old, but Solomon was chosen to succeed David instead, and Adonijah was later put to death for his rebellious actions.

96.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
96.b: Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
96.s: Adonijah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

97.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
97.b: Jewish exile whose descendants returned to Jerusalem
97.s: Adonikam was one of the Jewish exiles whose descendants returned to Jerusalem from Babylon, as recorded in the lists in Ezra and Nehemiah.

98.b: King of Jerusalem who fought against Joshua
98.s: Adoni-zedek, the king of Jerusalem, formed an alliance with other Amorite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites but was defeated and killed.

99.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
99.b: Official in charge of forced labor under David and Solomon
99.s: Adoram, also known as Adoniram or Hadoram, was an official in charge of forced labor during the reigns of David, Solomon, and Rehoboam.

100.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
100.b: Assyrian god worshipped by Sepharvites in Samaria
100.s: Adrammelech was an Assyrian deity worshipped by the Sepharvite people.

101.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
101.b: Son of Sennacherib who murdered his father
101.s: Adrammelech, son of Assyrian king Sennacherib, assassinated his father.

102.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
102.s: Adriel married Saul's daughter Merab and had five sons.

103.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
103.b: Paralyzed man in Lydda healed by Peter
103.s: Aeneas, paralyzed for eight years, was healed by Peter in Lydda.

104.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
104.b: Prophet who predicted famine and Paul's arrest
104.s: Agabus, a prophet, foretold a famine and Paul's arrest in Jerusalem.

105.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
105.b: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel
105.s: Agag, king of the Amalekites, was spared by Saul but killed by Samuel.

106.d: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
106.b: King mentioned in Balaam's oracle about Israel
106.s: Agag, a king, is mentioned in Balaam's prophetic oracle about Israel's future.

107.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
107.b: Father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men
107.s: Agee the Hararite was the father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men.

108.d: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
108.b: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea
108.s: Tetrarch Agrippa heard Paul's defense and found no grounds for his imprisonment.

109.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
109.b: Author of Proverbs 30, son of Jakeh
109.s: Agur, son of Jakeh, is credited as the author of Proverbs 30.

110.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
110.b: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel
110.s: Ahab, son of Omri, reigned as king of Israel and did evil in the sight of the Lord.

111.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
111.b: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
111.s: Ahab, son of Kolaiah, was a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

112.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
112.b: Son of Harum, from the tribe of Judah
112.s: Aharhel was a son of Harum, a descendant of Judah.

113.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
113.b: Father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men
113.s: Ahasbai the Maachathite was the father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men.

114.d: Emperor Xerxes I, living at the time of Exile and Return
114.b: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther
114.s: Ahasuerus, Emperor of Persia (probably Xerxes I), chose Esther as his queen and issued decrees impacting the Jews.

115.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
115.s: Ahaz was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan, from the tribe of Benjamin.

116.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
116.b: King of Judah, son of Jotham
116.s: Ahaz, son of Jotham, reigned as king of Judah for 16 years.

117.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
117.b: King of Israel, son of Ahab
117.s: Ahaziah, son of Ahab, reigned as king of Israel for two years.

118.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
118.b: King of Judah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah
118.s: Ahaziah (also called Jehoahaz), son of Jehoram, reigned as king of Judah for one year.

119.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
119.b: Son of Abishur, from the tribe of Judah
119.s: Ahban was the son of Abishur, a descendant of Judah.

120.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
120.b: Son of Shemer, from the tribe of Asher
120.s: Aher was a son of Shemer, a descendant of Asher.

121.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
121.b: Son of Abdiel, a Gadite chief
121.s: Ahi, son of Abdiel, was a chief of the Gadites.

122.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
122.b: Son of Shomer, from the tribe of Asher
122.s: Ahi (or "brother") was a son of Shomer (or 'Shamer'), a descendant of Asher.

123.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
123.b: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
123.s: Ahiah was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

124.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
124.b: One of David's mighty men, son of Sharar
124.s: Ahiam, son of Sharar the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men.

125.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
125.b: Son of Shemidah, from the tribe of Manasseh
125.s: Ahian was a son of Shemidah, a descendant of Manasseh.

126.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
126.b: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
126.s: Ahiezer was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

127.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
127.b: Leader from the tribe of Dan during the Exodus
127.s: Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, was a leader of the tribe of Dan during the Exodus.

128.b: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
128.s: Ahihud was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

129.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
129.b: Leader from the tribe of Asher for land allocation
129.s: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was a leader from the tribe of Asher appointed to help allocate the Promised Land.

130.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
130.b: One of David's mighty men, the Pelonite
130.s: Ahijah the Pelonite was one of David's mighty men.

131.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
131.b: Son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah
131.s: Ahijah was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

132.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
132.b: Levite in charge of the treasuries of the temple
132.s: Ahijah, a Levite, was in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.

133.b: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
133.s: Ahijah was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

134.d: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
134.b: Prophet from Shiloh who prophesied to Jeroboam
134.s: Ahijah the Shilonite was a prophet who foretold Jeroboam's rise to power and the division of the kingdom.

135.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
135.b: Father of Baasha, king of Israel
135.s: Ahijah was the father of Baasha, who became king of Israel and ruled for 24 years.

136.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
136.b: Son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), a scribe during Solomon's reign
136.s: Ahijah, son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), served as a scribe during King Solomon's reign.

137.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
137.b: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death
137.s: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was an official during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim, and he protected Jeremiah from death.

138.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
138.b: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon
138.s: Ahilud was the father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder, and Baana, one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

139.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
139.s: Ahimaaz, who was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath, served as the governor of Naphtali during Solomon's reign.

140.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
140.s: Ahimaaz was the father of Ahinoam, who was the wife of King Saul.

141.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
141.b: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David
141.s: Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, was a messenger who helped David during Absalom's rebellion and brought news of Absalom's death.

142.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
142.s: Ahiman was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of David.

143.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
143.b: One of the giant descendants of Anak in Hebron
143.s: Ahiman was one of the three giant descendants of Anak who lived in Hebron and were driven out by Caleb.

144.d: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
144.b: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul
144.s: Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob, gave David consecrated bread and Goliath's sword but was later killed by Saul for aiding David.

145.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
145.b: Son of Ahitub, a Hittite warrior who joined David
145.s: Ahimelech the Hittite was one of David's warriors who accompanied him to Saul's camp while Saul was pursuing David.

146.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
146.b: Son of Abiathar, a priest during David's reign
146.s: Ahimelech, son of Abiathar, served as a priest during the reign of King David.

147.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
147.b: Levite descendant of Kohath, son of Elkanah
147.s: Ahimoth, also known as Mahath, was a Levite descended from Kohath, the son of Elkanah.

148.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
148.b: Son of Iddo, a governor under Solomon
148.s: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, was one of Solomon's twelve governors, responsible for providing provisions for the king's household.

149.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
149.b: Wife of King Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
149.s: Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz, was one of King Saul's wives.

150.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
150.b: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon
150.s: Ahinoam of Jezreel was one of David's wives and the mother of his firstborn son, Amnon.

151.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
151.s: Ahio was a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

152.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
152.s: Ahio was a son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), a Benjamite who was the re-founder of Gibeon.

153.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
153.b: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim
153.s: Ahio, along with his brother Uzzah, drove the cart carrying the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

154.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
154.b: Leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Exodus
154.s: Ahira, son of Enan, was the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

155.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
155.b: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ahiramite clan
155.s: Ahiram, also known as Aharah or Ehi, was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ahiramite clan.

156.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
156.b: Father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan for the tabernacle
156.s: Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, was the father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan who helped construct the tabernacle.

157.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
157.s: Ahishahar was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

158.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
158.s: Ahishar was in charge of King Solomon's palace.

159.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
159.b: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide
159.s: Ahithophel was a wise counselor to David who defected to Absalom's side during Absalom's rebellion, but later committed suicide when his advice was not followed.

160.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
160.b: Ancestor of Ezra the scribe, in the priestly line
160.s: Ahitub, son of Amariah and father of Zadok, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe in the priestly line.

161.d: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
161.b: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul
161.s: Ahitub was the father of Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob who was killed by Saul for aiding David.

162.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
162.b: Father of Zadok the priest during David's reign
162.s: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, who served as a priest alongside Abiathar during the reign of King David.

163.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
163.b: Father of Zabad, one of David's mighty men
163.s: Ahlai was the father of Zabad, who was one of David's mighty men.

164.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
164.s: Ahlai was the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

165.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
165.b: Descendant of Benjamin, clan of David's mighty men
165.s: The Ahohites, descendants of Ahoah of Benjamin, were a clan that included some of David's mighty men, such as Eleazar and Zalmon.

166.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
166.s: Ahumai was a descendant of Judah through his grandson Reaiah.

167.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
167.b: Son of Ashhur and Naarah, a Judahite
167.s: Ahuzzam was the son of Ashhur and his wife Naarah, from the tribe of Judah.

168.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
168.b: Friend and advisor of Abimelech, Philistine king of Gerar
168.s: Ahuzzath was a friend and advisor of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied him when making a treaty with Isaac.

169.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
169.s: Aiah was the father of Rizpah, who was a concubine of King Saul.

170.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
170.b: Son of Zibeon the Hivite, brother of Anah
170.s: Aiah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite and the brother of Anah, who was a descendant of Esau.

171.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
171.b: Son of Ezer, a Horite chief in Seir
171.s: Akan was the son of Ezer, a Horite chief who lived in the land of Seir.

172.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
172.b: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
172.s: Akkub was a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah, listed in the genealogy of the royal line.

173.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
173.b: Levite gatekeeper during the post-exilic period
173.s: Akkub was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the Temple during the post-exilic period.

174.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
174.b: Family head of Temple servants who returned from exile
174.s: Akkub was a family head of the Temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

175.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
175.b: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
175.s: Akkub was a Levite who assisted Ezra in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading.

176.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
176.s: Alemeth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin.

177.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
177.b: Son of Jehoaddah, a Benjamite from Gibeon
177.s: Alemeth was a son of Jehoaddah (or 'Jehoadah'), a Benjamite from Gibeon, and is listed in the genealogies of Saul's family.

178.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
178.b: Opponent of Paul, along with Hymenaeus
178.s: Alexander, along with Hymenaeus, was an opponent of Paul's teaching and was handed over to Satan by Paul.

179.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
179.b: Jew put forward by the crowd in Ephesus
179.s: Alexander was a Jew whom the crowd put forward during the riot in Ephesus, but they shouted him down when they realized he was a Jew.

180.d: Priest living at the time of the New Testament
180.b: Member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem
180.s: Alexander was a member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem who was present during Peter and John's interrogation before the Sanhedrin.

181.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
181.b: Son of Simon who carried the cross
181.s: Alexander was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross.

182.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
182.s: Allon was the son of Jedaiah, a descendant of Simeon.

183.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
183.b: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
183.s: Almodad was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, listed in the genealogies of the nations.

184.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
184.b: Father of apostles James and Matthew (Levi)
184.s: Alphaeus was the father of two of Jesus' apostles, James and Matthew (also known as Levi).

185.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
185.s: Alvah was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau through his son Eliphaz.

186.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
186.s: Alvan was a Horite chief, a descendant of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom before Esau's descendants.

187.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
187.s: Amal was a son of Helem, a descendant of Asher, and is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

188.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
188.b: Grandson of Esau, ancestor of the Amalekites
188.s: Amalek was the son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, and he became the ancestor of the Amalekite people.

189.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
189.b: Levite, descendant of Hebron, during David's reign
189.s: Amariah was a Levite, a descendant of Hebron, who served during the reign of King David.

190.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
190.b: High priest, ancestor of Ezra the scribe
190.s: Amariah was a high priest during the reign of Jehoshaphat and an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

191.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
191.b: Ancestor of Zadok the priest, in Aaron's line
191.s: Amariah, son of Meraioth, was an ancestor of Zadok the priest and a descendant of Aaron through his son Eleazar.

192.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
192.b: Chief priest under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
192.s: Amariah was the chief priest who assisted King Jehoshaphat in his judicial reforms in Judah.

193.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
193.b: Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah
193.s: Amariah was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

194.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
194.b: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
194.s: Amariah was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

195.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
195.b: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and served as chief priest
195.s: Amariah was a priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and later served as a chief priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

196.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
196.s: Amariah, a descendant of Judah through Perez, was among those chosen to resettle in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

197.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
197.s: Amariah was an ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet, who prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

198.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
198.b: Ephraimite leader who opposed enslaving Judahite captives
198.s: Amasa, along with other leaders of Ephraim, opposed the Israelite army's attempt to bring Judahite captives as slaves to Samaria.

199.d: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
199.b: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab
199.s: Amasa, the son of Jether and Abigail (David's sister), was a military commander who served under Absalom and later David, but was killed by Joab.

200.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
200.b: Chief of thirty who joined David
200.s: Amasai, a chief of thirty mighty men, joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

201.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
201.s: Amasai, a priest, was among those who blew the trumpet when the Ark of the Covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

202.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
202.s: Amasai, a Levite descended from Kohath, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

203.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
203.b: Levite who helped purify the temple
203.s: Amasai, a Levite of the sons of Merari, helped purify the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

204.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
204.b: Commander who volunteered for God's service
204.s: Amasiah, the son of Zichri, was a commander who willingly offered himself for the service of the Lord during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

205.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
205.s: Amaziah, the son of Joshah, was a descendant of Simeon.

206.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
206.s: Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah, was a Levite of the family of Merari during the time of David.

207.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
207.b: King of Judah, son of Joash
207.s: Amaziah, son of Joash, was the ninth king of Judah who reigned for 29 years.

208.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
208.b: Priest of Bethel during Amos' ministry
208.s: Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, opposed the prophet Amos and told him to leave the kingdom of Israel.

209.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
209.s: The descendants of Ami (or Amon) were among the returned exiles who were servants of Solomon.

210.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
210.s: Amittai was the father of Jonah, the prophet from Gath-hepher.

211.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
211.s: Ammiel was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

212.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
212.s: Ammiel was the father of Machir, who provided assistance to David during his flight from Absalom.

213.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
213.b: Spy from the tribe of Dan
213.s: Ammiel, the son of Gemalli, was the representative from the tribe of Dan among the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

214.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
214.b: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
214.s: Ammihud, a descendant of Judah, was among those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

215.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
215.b: Father of Talmai, king of Geshur
215.s: Ammihud (or Ammihur) was the father of Talmai, the king of Geshur, to whom Absalom fled after killing his brother Amnon.

216.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
216.b: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim
216.s: Ammihud was the father of Elishama, the leader of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness journey.

217.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
217.b: Father of Shemuel, leader from Simeon
217.s: Ammihud was the father of Shemuel, the leader from the tribe of Simeon appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

218.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
218.b: Father of Pedahel, leader from Naphtali
218.s: Ammihud was the father of Pedahel, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

219.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
219.b: Levite leader during the Ark's transfer
219.s: Amminadab was a Levite leader from the Uzzielite clan who participated in the transfer of the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem.

220.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
220.b: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David
220.s: Amminadab was the father of Elisheba, who married Aaron, and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

221.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
221.b: Noble mentioned in a love song
221.s: Amminadib is mentioned in a poetic passage in the Song of Solomon, possibly referring to a noble or prince.

222.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
222.b: Father of Ahiezer, leader of Dan
222.s: Ammishaddai was the father of Ahiezer, the leader of the tribe of Dan during the wilderness journey.

223.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
223.b: Son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men
223.s: Ammizabad was the son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men, and served as his father's second-in-command.

224.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
224.b: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah
224.s: Amnon was a son of Shimon and a descendant of Judah.

225.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
225.b: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom
225.s: Amnon, David's firstborn son, raped his half-sister Tamar and was later killed by her brother Absalom.

226.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
226.b: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
226.s: Amok was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and signed the covenant under Nehemiah.

227.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
227.b: Governor of Samaria during Ahab's reign
227.s: Amon was the governor of Samaria during the reign of King Ahab of Israel.

228.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
228.b: King of Judah, son of Manasseh
228.s: Amon, the son of Manasseh, was the 15th king of Judah who reigned for two years before being assassinated by his servants.

229.b: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel
229.s: The Amorites were a Canaanite people group who lived in the hill country and were among the enemies the Israelites faced when entering the Promised Land.

230.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
230.b: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel
230.s: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, called by God as a prophet to Israel.

231.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
231.b: Son of Naum in Jesus' genealogy
231.s: Amos, an ancestor of Jesus, son of Naum.

232.d: Isaiah's father living at the time of Divided Monarchy
232.s: Amoz, the father of the prophet Isaiah.

233.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
233.b: Believer greeted by Paul in Rome
233.s: Ampliatus, a beloved fellow believer greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

234.d: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
234.b: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
234.s: Amram was the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, and a member of the tribe of Levi.

235.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
235.b: Israelite who married a foreign wife
235.s: Amram was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the Exile and agreed to put her away.

236.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
236.b: King of Shinar, ally of Chedorlaomer
236.s: Amraphel, king of Shinar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the Plain.

237.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
237.s: Amzi, a descendant of Merari, was a Levite who served as a musician in the temple.

238.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
238.b: Priest in Jerusalem after the Exile
238.s: Amzi was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

239.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
239.b: Horite, father of Oholibamah, Esau's wife
239.s: Anah was a Horite, the father of Oholibamah, one of Esau's wives, and the discoverer of hot springs in the wilderness.

240.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
240.s: Anaiah was a priest who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during Nehemiah's time.

241.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
241.b: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
241.s: Anaiah was one of the men who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

242.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
242.b: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan
242.s: Anak was the ancestor of the Anakim, a race of giants who inhabited Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

243.b: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
243.s: The Anamim were a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, and are listed among the nations in the Table of Nations.

244.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
244.s: Anammelech was an Assyrian deity worshiped by the Sepharvites, who were among the foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king.

245.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
245.b: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
245.s: Anan was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

246.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
246.s: Anani was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

247.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
247.b: Repairer of the wall in Jerusalem
247.s: Ananiah made repairs to a section of the wall near his house during the rebuilding of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

248.d: High Priest living at the time of the New Testament
248.s: Ananias, the high priest, presided over Paul's trial and ordered him to be struck on the mouth for his defense.

249.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
249.b: Husband of Sapphira, lied about offering proceeds
249.s: Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from the sale of their property and faced divine judgment.

250.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
250.s: Ananias, a disciple in Damascus, was sent by God to heal and baptize Saul (later known as Paul) after his conversion on the road to Damascus.

251.b: Father of Shamgar, a judge of Israel
251.s: Anath was the father of Shamgar, one of the judges who delivered Israel from oppression.

252.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
252.b: Son of Becher, descendant of Benjamin
252.s: Anathoth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

253.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
253.b: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
253.s: Anathoth was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

254.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
254.s: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ and played a significant role in the early church.

255.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
255.b: Fellow prisoner with Paul, outstanding among the apostles
255.s: Andronicus, along with Junia, was a fellow prisoner with Paul and was noted as outstanding among the apostles.

256.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
256.s: Aner was an Amorite, one of the allies of Abram, who joined him in the battle against the kings who had taken Lot captive.

257.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
257.b: Son of Shemida, descendant of Manasseh
257.s: Aniam was a son of Shemida and a descendant of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

258.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
258.b: Prophetess who witnessed Jesus' dedication in the temple
258.s: Anna, a prophetess and widow, witnessed the dedication of the infant Jesus in the temple and spoke about Him to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

259.d: High Priest living at the time of the New Testament
259.b: High priest during Jesus' ministry and trial
259.s: Annas, a high priest, played a significant role in the events surrounding Jesus' arrest, trial, and crucifixion, as well as in the early persecution of the apostles.

260.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
260.b: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
260.s: Anthothijah was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

261.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
261.s: Antipas, described as Christ's faithful witness, was martyred in Pergamum, where Satan's throne was said to be.

262.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
262.b: Son of Coz, descendant of Judah
262.s: Anub was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

263.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
263.b: Approved in Christ, greeted by Paul
263.s: Apelles, described as "approved in Christ," was among those greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

264.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
264.b: Ancestor of King Saul, a Benjamite
264.s: Aphiah, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul, the first king of Israel.

265.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
265.b: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul
265.s: Apollos, an eloquent and learned Jewish Christian from Alexandria, was an important figure in the early church who worked alongside Paul in spreading the gospel.

266.b: Son of Nadab, descendant of Judah
266.s: Appaim was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

267.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
267.b: Recipient of Paul's letter to Philemon
267.s: Apphia, likely a member of Philemon's household, was one of the recipients of Paul's letter to Philemon.

268.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
268.b: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul
268.s: Aquila, along with his wife Priscilla, was a Jewish Christian who worked as a tentmaker and played a significant role in the early church, partnering with Paul in his ministry.

269.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
269.b: Son of Jether, descendant of Asher
269.s: Ara was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

270.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
270.s: Arad was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Beriah.

271.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
271.s: Arah, the son of Shual ('Ulla'), was a descendant of Asher.

272.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
272.s: Arah, whose daughter was married to Shechaniah, was the father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite.

273.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
273.b: A Jewish leader whose daughter married Tobiah's son.
273.s: Arah's daughter was married to the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

274.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
274.b: Son of Shemer, descendant of Asher
274.s: Aram was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

275.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
275.b: Son of Shem, ancestor of the Arameans
275.s: Aram, a son of Shem and ancestor of the Aramean people.

276.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
276.b: Son of Kemuel, nephew of Abraham
276.s: Aram was the son of Kemuel, who was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor.

277.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
277.b: Concubine of Manasseh; mother of Asriel
277.s: An Aramitess, who was a concubine of Manasseh, gave birth to Machir and Asriel..

278.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
278.b: Son of Dishan, descendant of Seir the Horite
278.s: Aran was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau's family and the Horite clans.

279.b: Father of Anak, former name of Hebron
279.s: Arba was the father of Anak and the namesake of Kiriath-arba, which was the former name of Hebron.

280.d: Ethnarch living at the time of the New Testament
280.b: Son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch of Judea
280.s: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch over Judea, causing Joseph to fear returning there with Mary and the child Jesus.

281.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
281.b: Fellow soldier and minister in Colossae
281.s: Archippus, addressed as a fellow soldier by Paul, was urged to complete the ministry he had received in the Lord.

282.b: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel
282.s: The Archites were a people group mentioned in relation to the boundaries of Ephraim's territory and as the origin of Hushai, King David's friend and advisor.

283.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
283.b: Son of Benjamin, brother of Bela
283.s: Ard, a son of Benjamin, is listed among the descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt during the famine.

284.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
284.b: Grandson of Benjamin, son of Bela
284.s: Ard, a grandson of Benjamin, is mentioned in the census of the Israelites taken in the wilderness of Moab.

285.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
285.b: Son of Caleb, brother of Jether and Mered
285.s: Ardon was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

286.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
286.b: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob
286.s: Areli, a son of Gad, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jacob and the census of the Israelites in the wilderness.

287.d: King living at the time of the New Testament
287.b: King of the Nabataeans in Damascus
287.s: Aretas, the king of the Nabataeans, governed Damascus and tried to arrest Paul.

288.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
288.b: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
288.s: Argob, along with Arieh, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

289.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
289.b: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
289.s: Aridai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

290.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
290.b: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
290.s: Aridatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

291.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
291.b: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
291.s: Arieh, along with Argob, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

292.d: Warriors living at the time of Exile and Return
292.b: Two lion-like men of Moab killed by Benaiah
292.s: Ariel refers to two lion-like men of Moab who were killed by Benaiah, one of David's mighty warriors.

293.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
293.b: One of the leaders summoned by Ezra
293.s: Ariel was one of the leaders summoned by Ezra to assist in the return of the exiles to Jerusalem.

294.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
294.s: Arioch, the captain of King Nebuchadnezzar's guard, was commanded to execute the wise men of Babylon but brought Daniel before the king to interpret his dream.

295.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
295.b: King of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer
295.s: Arioch, king of Ellasar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

296.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
296.b: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
296.s: Arisai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

297.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
297.b: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner
297.s: Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was a faithful companion of Paul during his missionary journeys and imprisonment.

298.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
298.b: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul
298.s: Paul sends greetings to those who belong to the household of Aristobulus, suggesting that Aristobulus was a prominent believer in Rome.

299.b: Canaanite people group descended from Canaan
299.s: The Arkites were one of the Canaanite tribes descended from Canaan, the son of Ham, and are mentioned in the Table of Nations.

300.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
300.b: Son of Saul by Rizpah, killed by Gibeonites
300.s: Armoni was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah, killed by the Gibeonites (<ref="2Sa.21.8">2Sa.21.8</ref>).

301.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
301.s: Arnan was a descendant of David's son Solomon (<ref="1Ch.3.21">1Ch.3.21</ref>).

302.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
302.b: Son of Gad and founder of the Arodite clan
302.s: Arod, son of Gad, was the founder of the Arodite clan (<ref="Gen.46.16; Num.26.17">Gen.46.16; Num.26.17</ref>).

303.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
303.b: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
303.s: Arpachshad, son of Shem, was born two years after the flood and was an ancestor of Abraham (<ref="Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36">Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36</ref>).

304.d: Artaxerxes Longimanus, an emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
304.b: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time
304.s: Artaxerxes was the Persian king who allowed Ezra and Nehemiah to return to Jerusalem (<ref="Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14">Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14</ref>).

305.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
305.b: Companion of Paul, potential replacement for Titus
305.s: Artemas was a companion of Paul who could potentially replace Titus in Crete (<ref="Titus 3:12">Titus 3:12</ref>).

306.b: Canaanite descendants of Canaan, son of Ham
306.s: The Arvadites were a Canaanite People from Canaan, son of Ham (<ref="Gen.10.18; 1Ch.1.16">Gen.10.18; 1Ch.1.16</ref>).

307.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
307.b: Steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah
307.s: Arza was the steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah (<ref="1Ki.16.9">1Ki.16.9</ref>).

308.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
308.b: Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem
308.s: Asa was a Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem (<ref="1Ch.9.16">1Ch.9.16</ref>).

309.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
309.b: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat
309.s: Asa was a king of Judah who reigned for 41 years, known for his religious reforms (1Kings 15; 2Chr 14-16).

310.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
310.b: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
310.s: Asahel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah (<ref="2Ch.17.8">2Ch.17.8</ref>).

311.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
311.b: Levite in charge of tithes under Hezekiah
311.s: Asahel was a Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute the tithes and dedicated things (<ref="2Ch.31.13">2Ch.31.13</ref>).

312.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
312.b: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner
312.s: Asahel, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was a fast runner killed by Abner during a battle (<ref="2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7">2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7</ref>).

313.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
313.b: Opposed Ezra's dissolution of mixed marriages
313.s: Asahel, along with Jahzeiah, opposed Ezra's plan to dissolve mixed marriages among the returned exiles (<ref="Ezra 10:15">Ezra 10:15</ref>).

314.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
314.b: Levite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
314.s: Asaiah was a Levite leader who assisted in bringing the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem during David's reign (<ref="1Ch.15.6, 11">1Ch.15.6, 11</ref>).

315.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
315.s: Asaiah was a Simeonite leader during the reign of King Hezekiah (<ref="1Ch.4.36">1Ch.4.36</ref>).

316.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
316.b: Merarite Levite, ancestor of Ethan the singer
316.s: Asaiah was a Merarite Levite, an ancestor of Ethan the singer (<ref="1Ch.6.30">1Ch.6.30</ref>).

317.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
317.b: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
317.s: Asaiah, a descendant of Judah, lived in Jerusalem (<ref="1Ch.9.5">1Ch.9.5</ref>).

318.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
318.b: Servant of King Josiah during Book of Law discovery
318.s: Asaiah was a servant of King Josiah sent to consult the prophetess Huldah about the Book of the Law (<ref="2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20">2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20</ref>).

319.d: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
319.b: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

320.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
320.b: Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem
320.s: Asaph was a Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (<ref="1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17">1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17</ref>).

321.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
321.s: Asaph served as the recorder during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah (<ref="2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22">2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22</ref>).

322.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
322.b: Keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time
322.s: Asaph was the keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.2.8">Neh.2.8</ref>).

323.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
323.b: Son of Jehallelel, from the tribe of Judah
323.s: Asarel was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.4.16">1Ch.4.16</ref>).

324.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
324.b: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
324.s: Asen was an ancestor of 223 individuals who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

325.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
325.b: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim
325.s: Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, was given to Joseph as his wife by Pharaoh (<ref="Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20">Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20</ref>).

326.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
326.b: Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres
326.s: Asharelah (or Jesharelah) was a Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres (<ref="1Ch.25.2, 14">1Ch.25.2, 14</ref>).

327.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
327.b: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ashbelite clan
327.s: Ashbel was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ashbelite clan (<ref="Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1">Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1</ref>).

328.d: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
328.b: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher
328.s: Asher was the eighth son of Jacob, born to Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, and became the founder of the tribe of Asher (<ref="Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36">Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36</ref>).

329.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
329.s: Ashhur, a descendant of Judah through Hezron, was the  father (ie founder) of Tekoa (<ref="1Ch.2.24; 4:5">1Ch.2.24; 4:5</ref>).

330.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
330.b: Grandson of Japheth, son of Gomer
330.s: Ashkenaz was a grandson of Japheth and son of Gomer, mentioned in the Table of Nations (<ref="Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6">Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6</ref>).

331.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
331.s: Ashpenaz was the chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court, responsible for selecting and training young Israelite exiles (<ref="Dan.1.3">Dan.1.3</ref>).

332.b: Son of Japhlet, descendant of Asher
332.s: Ashvath was a son of Japhlet and a descendant of Asher (<ref="1Ch.7.33">1Ch.7.33</ref>).

333.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
333.s: Asiel was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe (<ref="1Ch.4.35">1Ch.4.35</ref>).

334.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
334.b: Head of a family of temple servants who returned from exile
334.s: Asnah was the head of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile (<ref="Ezra 2:50">Ezra 2:50</ref>).

335.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
335.b: One of the ten sons of Haman
335.s: Aspatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were executed after their father's downfall (<ref="Est.9.7">Est.9.7</ref>).

336.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
336.b: Son of Gilead, descendant of Manasseh
336.s: Asriel was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh (<ref="1Ch.7.14">1Ch.7.14</ref>).

337.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
337.b: Son of Manasseh, founder of the Asrielite clan
337.s: Asriel was a son of Manasseh and the founder of the Asrielite clan (<ref="Num.26.31; Josh 17:2">Num.26.31; Josh 17:2</ref>).

338.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
338.b: Son of Shem; father of the Assyrians
338.s: Asshur was a son of Shem and is considered the father of the Assyrians (<ref="Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17">Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17</ref>).

339.s: Asshurim was a descendant of Abraham through his son Jokshan and grandson Dedan (<ref="Gen.25.3">Gen.25.3</ref>).

340.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
340.b: Levite ancestor of the prophet Samuel
340.s: Assir was a Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet (<ref="1Ch.6.23">1Ch.6.23, 37</ref>).

341.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
341.b: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath
341.s: Assir was a son of Korah and great-grandson of Kohath, from the tribe of Levi (<ref="Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22">Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22</ref>).

342.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
342.b: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
342.s: Asyncritus was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings (<ref="Rom.16.14">Rom.16.14</ref>).

343.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
343.b: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Onam
343.s: Atarah was the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.26">1Ch.2.26</ref>).

344.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
344.b: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
344.s: Ater was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (<ref="Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21">Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21</ref>).

345.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
345.b: Head of a family of gatekeepers who returned from exile
345.s: Ater was the head of a family of gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (<ref="Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45">Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45</ref>).

346.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
346.b: One of the signers of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
346.s: Ater was one of the individuals who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah's reforms (<ref="Neh.10.17">Neh.10.17</ref>).

347.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
347.b: Descendant of Judah who resettled in Jerusalem
347.s: Athaiah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the people who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (<ref="Neh.11.4">Neh.11.4</ref>).

348.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
348.s: Athaliah was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of Saul's family (<ref="1Ch.8.26">1Ch.8.26</ref>).

349.d: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy
349.b: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel
349.s: Athaliah, the daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, became queen of Judah and ruled for six years before being overthrown (<ref="2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7">2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7</ref>).

350.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
350.b: Descendant of Elam who returned from Babylonian exile
350.s: Athaliah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra (<ref="Ezr.8.7">Ezr.8.7</ref>).

351.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
351.b: One of those who agreed to put away foreign wives
351.s: Athlai was one of the men who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms (<ref="Ezr.10.28">Ezr.10.28</ref>).

352.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
352.b: One of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior
352.s: Attai the son of Zabad was one of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior who joined him at Ziklag (<ref="1Ch.12.11">1Ch.12.11</ref>).

353.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
353.b: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah
353.s: Attai was the grandson of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.35-36">1Ch.2.35-36</ref>).

354.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
354.b: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
354.s: Attai was a son of King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah (<ref="2Ch.11.20">2Ch.11.20</ref>).

355.d: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
355.b: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus
355.s: Augustus, also known as Caesar, was the Roman emperor during the time of Jesus' birth and early life (<ref="Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1">Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1</ref>).

356.d: People who lived in modern Gaza
356.b: Ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area
356.s: The Avvim were an ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area before being destroyed by the Caphtorim (<ref="Deut 2:23; Josh 13:3">Deut 2:23; Josh 13:3</ref>).

357.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
357.b: Father of Shaphan the scribe during Josiah's reign
357.s: Azaliah was the father of Shaphan the scribe, who served during the reign of King Josiah of Judah (<ref="2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8">2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8</ref>).

358.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
358.b: One of the Levites who sealed the covenant
358.s: Azaniah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (<ref="Neh.10.9">Neh.10.9</ref>).

359.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
359.b: One of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag
359.s: Azarel was one of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag (<ref="1Ch.12.6">1Ch.12.6</ref>).

360.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
360.b: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
360.s: Azarel son of Jeroham was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign (<ref="1Ch.27.22">1Ch.27.22</ref>).

361.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
361.b: One of those who married foreign women during Ezra's time
361.s: Azarel was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezr.10.41">Ezr.10.41</ref>).

362.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
362.b: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
362.s: Azarel was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.12.36">Neh.12.36</ref>).

363.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
363.b: Descendant of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron
363.s: Azariah was a descendant of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.38, 39">1Ch.2.38, 39</ref>).

364.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
364.b: Son of Ethan, descendant of Judah
364.s: Azariah was the son of Ethan, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.8">1Ch.2.8</ref>).

365.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
365.b: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests
365.s: Azariah was father of Seraiah, father of Ezra. His ancestors served as high priests (<ref="1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1">1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1</ref>).

366.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
366.b: Descendant of Zadok, a priest before Solomon's reign
366.s: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, was a priest before the reign of King Solomon (<ref="1Ki.4.2; 1Ch.6.9">1Ki.4.2; 1Ch.6.9</ref>).

367.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
367.b: High priest during Solomon's reign, descendant of Zadok
367.s: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, served as high priest during the reign of King Solomon (<ref="1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3">1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3</ref>).

368.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
368.b: Son of Nathan, an official in Solomon's court
368.s: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was an official in King Solomon's court (<ref="1Ki.4.5">1Ki.4.5</ref>).

369.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
369.b: Prophet who encouraged King Asa to seek God
369.s: Azariah, the son of Oded, was a prophet who encouraged King Asa of Judah to seek God (<ref="2Ch.15.1">2Ch.15.1</ref>).

370.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
370.b: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
370.s: Azariah was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (<ref="2Ch.21.2">2Ch.21.2</ref>).

371.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
371.b: A commander who helped crown Joash king
371.s: Azariah son of Jeroham was a military commander who supported Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne of Judah.

372.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
372.b: A commander who supported Joash's coronation
372.s: Azariah son of Obed was one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

373.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
373.b: High priest who confronted King Uzziah
373.s: Azariah, the high priest, confronted King Uzziah when he attempted to burn incense in the temple (<ref="2Ch.26.17 , 20">2Ch.26.17, 20</ref>).

374.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
374.b: Leader who opposed the enslaving of captives
374.s: Azariah, along with other leaders, opposed the enslaving of captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz (<ref="2Ch.28.12">2Ch.28.12</ref>).

375.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
375.b: A Levite who helped purify the temple
375.s: Azariah son of Jehallel was a Merarite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

376.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
376.b: A Levite who helped purify the temple
376.s: Azariah son of Jehallelel was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

377.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
377.s: Azariah, the chief priest from the family of Zadok, served during the reign of King Hezekiah (<ref="2Ch.31.10, 13">2Ch.31.10, 13</ref>).

378.d: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return
378.b: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace
378.s: Azariah, also known as Abednego, was one of Daniel's companions who survived the fiery furnace (<ref="Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3">Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3</ref>).

379.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
379.b: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall
379.s: Azariah, son of Maaseiah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.3.23, 24">Neh.3.23, 24</ref>).

380.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
380.b: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
380.s: Azariah was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33">Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33</ref>).

381.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
381.b: Levite who helped the people understand the Law
381.s: Azariah was a Levite who helped the people understand the Law during the time of Ezra (<ref="Neh.8.7">Neh.8.7</ref>).

382.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
382.b: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
382.s: Azariahu was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (<ref="2Ch.21.2">2Ch.21.2</ref>).

383.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
383.b: Descendant of Reuben; father of Bela
383.s: Azaz, a descendant of Reuben, was the father of Bela (<ref="1Ch.5.8">1Ch.5.8</ref>).

384.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
384.s: Azaziah was a Levite musician who played the harp during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.15.21">1Ch.15.21</ref>).

385.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
385.b: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
385.s: Azaziah was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.27.20">1Ch.27.20</ref>).

386.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
386.b: Levite during Hezekiah's reign, in charge of offerings
386.s: Azaziah was a Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah, appointed to oversee the freewill offerings (<ref="2Ch.31.13">2Ch.31.13</ref>).

387.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
387.b: Father of Nehemiah, who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
387.s: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David (<ref="Neh.3.16">Neh.3.16</ref>).
