1337.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1337.b: Levite, descendant of Merari during David's reign.
1337.s: Jaaziah was a Levite, a descendant of Merari through his son Beno, who served during King David's reign.

1338.d: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1338.s: Jaaziel (or Aziel or Jeiel) was a Levite appointed as a musician to play the bronze cymbals during the bringing of the ark to Jerusalem in David's reign.

1339.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
1339.b: Son of Lamech; father of nomadic herdsmen.
1339.s: Jabal, the son of Lamech and Adah, was the ancestor of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

1340.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1340.b: Assassinated Zechariah; reigned as king of Israel for a month.
1340.s: Jabesh, the son of Shallum, conspired against and assassinated Zechariah, becoming king of Israel, but reigned for only one month before being killed by Menahem.

1341.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1341.b: More honorable than his brothers; God granted his prayer.
1341.s: Jabez, who was more honorable than his brothers, cried out to God, who granted his request to enlarge his territory and keep him from harm.

1342.b: Canaanite king who oppressed Israel; defeated by Deborah and Barak.
1342.s: Jabin, a Canaanite king of Hazor, oppressed Israel for twenty years until he was defeated by Deborah and Barak.

1343.b: King of Hazor; led Canaanite coalition against Joshua.
1343.s: Jabin, king of Hazor, formed an alliance with other Canaanite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites.

1344.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1344.b: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham.
1344.s: Jacan was a leader from the tribe of Gad during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

1345.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1345.b: Head of a priestly division during David's reign.
1345.s: Jachin was the head of the twenty-first priestly division organized by King David.

1346.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
1346.b: Priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
1346.s: Jachin was a priest who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

1347.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1347.b: Son of Simeon; founder of the Jachinites clan.
1347.s: Jachin (or Jarib), a son of Simeon, was the founder of the Jachinites clan within the tribe of Simeon.

1348.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1348.b: Father of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
1348.s: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

1349.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1349.b: Son of Onam and brother of Shammai.
1349.s: Jada was the son of Onam and the brother of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.

1350.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1350.b: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife.
1350.s: Jaddai was among the Israelites who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

1351.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1351.b: One of the leaders who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
1351.s: Jaddua was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant made by the people of Israel during Nehemiah's time.

1352.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
1352.b: High priest during the time of Alexander the Great.
1352.s: Jaddua served as the high priest during the reign of Darius the Persian and was contemporary with Alexander the Great.

1353.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1353.b: Meronothite who helped repair Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.
1353.s: Jadon the Meronothite was one of the people who helped repair the walls of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

1354.b: Wife of Heber; killed Sisera, the Canaanite commander.
1354.s: Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, killed Sisera, the commander of the Canaanite army, by driving a tent peg through his temple.

1355.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1355.b: Levite, descendant of Shimei, son of Gershon.
1355.s: Jahath was a Levite, a descendant of Shimei, and a grandson of Gershon.

1356.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1356.b: Levite, son of Shelomoth, descendant of Izhar.
1356.s: Jahath was a Levite, the son of Shelomoth, and a descendant of Izhar.

1357.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1357.b: Son of Reaiah, descendant of Judah through Shobal.
1357.s: Jahath was the son of Reaiah and a descendant of Judah through Shobal.

1358.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1358.b: Levite who supervised repairs in Josiah's temple restoration.
1358.s: Jahath, along with Obadiah, were Levites from the Merarites who faithfully supervised the workmen repairing the temple during Josiah's reign.

1359.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1359.b: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
1359.s: Jahaziel, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

1360.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1360.b: Levite priest who played the trumpet regularly.
1360.s: Jahaziel, along with Benaiah, were Levite priests who regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant.

1361.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1361.b: Levite, son of Hebron, during David's reign.
1361.s: Jahaziel, a Levite and son of Hebron, was a chief of the Hebronites during the reign of David.

1362.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1362.b: Levite who prophesied Jehoshaphat's victory over his enemies.
1362.s: Jahaziel, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, prophesied by the Spirit of the Lord that Jehoshaphat would have victory over his enemies.

1363.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1363.b: Descendant of Shecaniah; returned with Ezra from Babylon.
1363.s: Jahaziel, a descendant of Shecaniah, was one of the men who returned with Ezra from Babylon to Jerusalem.

1364.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1364.b: Descendant of Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
1364.s: Jahdai was one of the descendants of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

1365.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1365.b: Mighty warrior and head of a father's house in Manasseh.
1365.s: Jahdiel was a mighty warrior and head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh, east of the Jordan.

1366.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1366.s: Jahdo, a son of Buz, was a descendant of Gad and a clan head.

1367.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1367.b: Son of Zebulun, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.
1367.s: Jahleel, son of Zebulun, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

1368.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1368.s: Jahmai, a son of Tola, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

1369.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1369.b: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.
1369.s: Jahzeel (or Jahziel), son of Naphtali, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

1370.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1370.b: Opposed Ezra's command for Israelites to divorce foreign wives.
1370.s: Jahzeiah, along with three others, opposed Ezra's order for Israelites to divorce their foreign wives.

1371.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
1371.s: Jahzerah was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

1372.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1372.s: Jair was the father of Mordecai, a Benjamite mentioned in the book of Esther.

1373.s: Jair the Gileadite was a judge who led Israel for twenty-two years.

1374.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1374.s: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured the region of Gilead.

1375.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1375.b: Synagogue leader whose daughter Jesus healed
1375.s: Jairus, a synagogue leader, sought Jesus to heal his dying daughter.

1376.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
1376.b: Father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30
1376.s: Jakeh was the father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30.

1377.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1377.s: Jakim was the head of the 12th priestly division during David's reign.

1378.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1378.s: Jakim was a Benjamite, the son of Shimei, mentioned in a genealogy.

1379.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1379.s: Jalam was a son of Esau and Oholibamah, and a chief of Edom.

1380.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1380.b: Son of Ezrah, from the tribe of Judah
1380.s: Jalon was a son of Ezrah, from the tribe of Judah.

1381.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1381.s: Jambres was an Egyptian magician who, along with Jannes, opposed Moses.

1382.d: Father of an apostle living at the time of the New Testament
1382.s: James, father of Judas who was also know as Thaddaeus, one of the Twelve Apostles chosen by Jesus.

1383.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
1383.s: James son of Alphaeus, known as "James the Less"was one of the Twelve Apostles.

1384.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1384.b: Jesus' brother, leader in the Jerusalem church
1384.s: James, the brother of Jesus, was a leader in the Jerusalem church and authored the epistle of James.

1385.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
1385.b: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles
1385.s: James, son of Zebedee and brother of John, was one of the Twelve Apostles and a member of Jesus' inner circle.

1386.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1386.b: Son of Ram, descendant of Judah
1386.s: Jamin was a son of Ram and a descendant of Judah.

1387.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1387.b: Son of Simeon, grandson of Jacob
1387.s: Jamin was a son of Simeon and a grandson of Jacob.

1388.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1388.b: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
1388.s: Jamin was a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

1389.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1389.s: Jamlech was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during King Hezekiah's reign.

1390.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1390.b: Gadite leader who settled in Bashan
1390.s: Janai was a leader from the tribe of Gad who settled in the region of Bashan.

1391.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1391.b: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
1391.s: Jannai was an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

1392.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1392.s: Jannes was an Egyptian magician who, along with Jambres, opposed Moses.

1393.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1393.b: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples
1393.s: Japheth was one of Noah's three sons and the ancestor of the Indo-European peoples.

1394.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
1394.b: Son of David, born in Jerusalem
1394.s: Japhia was one of King David's sons, born to him in Jerusalem.

1395.b: King of Lachish, defeated by Joshua
1395.s: Japhia was the king of Lachish, one of the Amorite cities defeated by Joshua.

1396.b: Descendant of Asher, son of Heber
1396.s: Japhlet was a descendant of Asher and the son of Heber.

1397.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
1397.b: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch
1397.s: Jared was an ancestor of Noah and the father of Enoch, who walked with God.

1398.d: Egyptian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1398.b: Egyptian servant who married Sheshan's daughter
1398.s: Jarha was an Egyptian servant who married the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah.

1399.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1399.b: Priest who married a foreign woman
1399.s: Jarib was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

1400.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1400.b: Leader sent by Ezra to find Levites
1400.s: Jarib was one of the leaders sent by Ezra to find Levites to serve in the Temple.

1401.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1401.s: Jaroah was a Gadite, the son of Gilead, mentioned in a genealogy.

1402.b: Ancient Hebrew book mentioned in the Old Testament
1402.s: Jashar was an ancient Hebrew book mentioned in the Old Testament, but not included in the biblical canon.

1403.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
1403.b: Father of some of David's mighty men
1403.s: Jashen, also known as Hashem, was the father of some of David's mighty men.

1404.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1404.b: Korahite who joined David at Ziklag
1404.s: Jashobeam was a Korahite who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

1405.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1405.b: Chief of David's mighty men, Hachmoni's son
1405.s: Jashobeam, also known as Josheb-basshebet, was the chief of David's mighty men and the son of Hachmoni.

1406.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1406.b: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
1406.s: Jashub was an Israelite who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

1407.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1407.b: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob
1407.s: Jashub, also known as Yob, was a son of Issachar and a grandson of Jacob.

1408.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1408.b: Paul's host in Thessalonica; relative of Paul
1408.s: Jason was Paul's host in Thessalonica and a relative of Paul mentioned in his letter to the Romans.

1409.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1409.s: Jathniel was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

1410.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1410.b: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people
1410.s: Javan, the ancestor of the Greek people, was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah.

1411.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1411.b: Hagrite in charge of David's flocks
1411.s: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of King David's flocks.

1412.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1412.b: Levite, son of Zerah, ancestor of Asaph
1412.s: Jeatherai, also known as Ethni, was a Levite, the son of Zerah, and an ancestor of Asaph.

1413.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1413.b: Witness to Isaiah's prophecy about Maher-shalal-hash-baz
1413.s: Jeberechiah was a witness to Isaiah's prophecy concerning his son Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

1414.b: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest
1414.s: The Jebusites were a Canaanite tribe that inhabited Jerusalem before King David conquered the city.

1415.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1415.b: Mother of King Uzziah (Azariah) of Judah
1415.s: Jecoliah was the mother of King Uzziah (also known as Azariah) of Judah.

1416.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1416.b: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
1416.s: Jedaiah was the head of the second priestly division during King David's reign and his descendants returned from the Babylonian exile.

1417.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1417.s: Jedaiah was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in a genealogy.

1418.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
1418.b: Priest who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
1418.s: Jedaiah was a priest who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile and served in the temple.

1419.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1419.s: Jedaiah was a priest who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel and signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

1420.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1420.b: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
1420.s: Jedaiah made repairs to a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during Nehemiah's rebuilding project.

1421.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1421.b: Returned exile who provided silver and gold for crowns
1421.s: Jedaiah was a returned exile who provided silver and gold for the crowns placed on Joshua's head.

1422.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1422.b: One of David's mighty men from the tribe of Manasseh
1422.s: Jediael the son of Shimri was one of David's mighty men from the tribe of Manasseh.

1423.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1423.b: Manassite who joined David at Ziklag
1423.s: Jediael was one of the Manassites who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

1424.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1424.s: Jediael was a Levite gatekeeper, the second son of Meshelemiah, during the time of David.

1425.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1425.b: Son of Benjamin, head of a clan
1425.s: Jediael was a son of Benjamin and the head of a Benjamite clan.

1426.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1426.b: Mother of King Josiah of Judah
1426.s: Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah of Judah and the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

1427.d: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
1427.b: Levitical musician and singer during David's reign
1427.s: Jeduthun, also known as Ethan, was a Levitical musician and singer during the reign of King David.

1428.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
1428.b: Levite gatekeeper and singer in post-exilic Jerusalem
1428.s: Jeduthun was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper and singer in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

1429.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1429.b: Son of Elah, descendant of Judah
1429.s: Jehallelel was a son of Elah and a descendant of Judah.

1430.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1430.b: Levite who helped purify the temple under Hezekiah
1430.s: Jehallelel, a Levite from the Merari clan, helped purify the temple during King Hezekiah's religious reforms.

1431.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1431.b: Levite descendant of Amram during David's reign
1431.s: Jehdeiah was a Levite descendant of Amram who served during the reign of King David.

1432.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1432.b: Officer in charge of King David's donkeys
1432.s: Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of King David's donkeys.

1433.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1433.b: Head of the 20th priestly division under David
1433.s: Jehezkel was the head of the 20th priestly division during the reign of King David.

1434.d: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1434.b: Levitical musician during the reign of King David
1434.s: Jehiel was a Levitical musician who played the harp and lyre during the reign of King David.

1435.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1435.s: Jehiel, King David's uncle, was a counselor and a scribe.

1436.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1436.b: Levite leader during the reign of King David
1436.s: Jehiel, also known as Jahath, was a Levite leader who served during the reign of King David.

1437.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1437.b: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
1437.s: Jehiel was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

1438.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1438.b: Levite appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute offerings
1438.s: Jehiel was a Levite appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute the offerings and tithes in the temple.

1439.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1439.b: Temple officer during King Josiah's Passover celebration
1439.s: Jehiel, along with Zechariah and Jehiel, was a temple officer who gave animals for King Josiah's Passover offerings.

1440.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1440.b: A leader who married a foreign wife
1440.s: Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, was guilty of marrying a foreign wife during the Exile.

1441.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1441.b: Priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile
1441.s: Jehiel, one of the descendants of Harim, was a priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile.

1442.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1442.b: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile
1442.s: Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, married a foreign woman during the Exile but agreed to put her away.

1443.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1443.b: Leader who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra
1443.s: Jehiel, son of Shechaniah, was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

1444.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1444.b: Ephraimite leader who opposed taking Judean captives
1444.s: Jehizkiah, an Ephraimite leader, opposed taking Judean captives during the reign of King Ahaz of Judah.

1445.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1445.s: Jehoaddah, also known as Jarah, was a descendant of King Saul mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

1446.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1446.b: Mother of King Amaziah of Judah
1446.s: Jehoaddan was the mother of King Amaziah of Judah and was from Jerusalem.

1447.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1447.b: King of Israel, son of Jehu
1447.s: Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, was king of Israel and reigned for seventeen years.

1448.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1448.b: King of Judah, son of Josiah
1448.s: Jehoahaz, also known as Johanan, was a king of Judah and the son of Josiah.

1449.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1449.b: Levite gatekeeper during the reign of David
1449.s: Jehohanan was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

1450.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1450.b: Military commander under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
1450.s: Jehohanan was a military commander from Judah during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

1451.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1451.b: Father of Ishmael, a military leader under Jehoiada
1451.s: Jehohanan was the father of Ishmael, one of the military leaders who supported Jehoiada in his coup against Athaliah.

1452.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1452.b: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile
1452.s: Jehohanan, one of the descendants of Bebai, married a foreign woman during the Exile but pledged to put her away.

1453.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1453.b: Son of Eliashib, a priest during Ezra's time
1453.s: Jehohanan was the son of Eliashib, a priest during the time of Ezra.

1454.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1454.b: Head of a priestly family during the high priesthood of Joiakim
1454.s: Jehohanan was the head of a priestly family during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua.

1455.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1455.b: Priest during the dedication of Jerusalem's walls
1455.s: Jehohanan was one of the priests who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's walls during Nehemiah's time.

1456.d: Ammonite living at the time of Exile and Return
1456.b: Father-in-law of Tobiah, an opponent of Nehemiah
1456.s: Jehohanan was the father-in-law of Tobiah, an opponent of Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

1457.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1457.b: King of Judah, son of Jehoiakim
1457.s: Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah, Coniah, or Shallum, was a king of Judah who reigned for three months before being exiled to Babylon.

1458.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1458.b: Counselor to King David after Ahithophel
1458.s: Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, succeeded Ahithophel as King David's counselor.

1459.d: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1459.b: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash
1459.s: Jehoiada, also known as Barachiah, was a high priest who led a revolt against Queen Athaliah and crowned Joash as king of Judah.

1460.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
1460.b: Father of one of David's warriors, Benaiah
1460.s: Jehoiada was the father  of one of David's warriors who commanded the Kerethites and Pelethites;

1461.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1461.b: Overseer in the house of the Lord
1461.s: Jehoiada was appointed as an overseer in the house of the Lord during the time of Jeremiah.

1462.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1462.b: King of Judah, son of Josiah
1462.s: Jehoiakim, also known as Eliakim, was a king of Judah who reigned for eleven years before being succeeded by his son Jehoiachin.

1463.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1463.b: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
1463.s: Jehoiarib was the head of the first priestly division organized by King David.

1464.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1464.b: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
1464.s: Jehonathan was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

1465.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1465.b: Head of a priestly family during the high priesthood of Joiakim
1465.s: Jehonathan was the head of the priestly family of Shemaiah during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua.

1466.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1466.b: King of N. Israel, son of Ahab
1466.s: Joram (or Jehoram), the son of Ahab, was king of Northern Israel for twelve years.

1467.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1467.b: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.
1467.s: Jehoram, also known as Joram, was the son of Jehoshaphat and king of Judah.

1468.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1468.b: A Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach.
1468.s: Jehoram was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

1469.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1469.b: Son of Asa, king of Judah.
1469.s: Jehoshaphat was the son of Asa and became a powerful and righteous king of Judah.

1470.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
1470.s: Jehoshaphat, son of Paruah, was one of Solomon's twelve officers responsible for providing food for the king and his household.

1471.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1471.b: Father of Jehu, king of Israel.
1471.s: Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehu, who became king of Israel.

1472.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
1472.s: Jehoshaphat served as a recorder for King David and his son Solomon.

1473.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1473.b: Daughter of Jehoram, saved Joash from Athaliah's massacre.
1473.s: Jehosheba, also known as Jehoshabeath, was the daughter of King Jehoram and the wife of Jehoiada the priest; she saved the infant Joash from Athaliah's massacre of the royal family.

1474.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
1474.b: Son of Obed-edom, a gatekeeper for the ark.
1474.s: Jehozabad was one of the sons of Obed-edom who served as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.

1475.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1475.s: Jehozabad was a commander who led 180,000 warriors under King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

1476.d: Moabite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1476.b: Son of Shomer, killed King Joash of Judah.
1476.s: Jehozabad, the son of Shomer, was one of the servants who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.

1477.d: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
1477.b: Father of Joshua the high priest during the exile.
1477.s: Jehozadak (or Jozadak) was the father of Joshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and helped rebuild the temple.

1478.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1478.b: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
1478.s: Jehu was one of the Benjamite archers and slingers who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

1479.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1479.b: Son of Obed, a descendant of Judah.
1479.s: Jehu was a descendant of Judah through Obed, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1480.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1480.b: Son of Joshibiah, a descendant of Simeon.
1480.s: Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

1481.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1481.b: Son of Hanani, prophet during the reign of Baasha and Jehoshaphat.
1481.s: Jehu, the son of Hanani, was a prophet who prophesied against Baasha, king of Israel, and later rebuked Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, for his alliance with Ahab.

1482.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1482.b: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.
1482.s: Jehu, son of Jehoshaphat, was anointed king of Israel by Elisha's servant; he destroyed the house of Ahab and the worship of Baal, but continued in the sins of Jeroboam.

1483.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1483.s: Jehubbah was a descendant of Asher mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

1484.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1484.b: An official during Zedekiah's reign, opposed Jeremiah.
1484.s: Jehucal (or Jucal) was an official during King Zedekiah's reign who opposed the prophet Jeremiah and sought his punishment.

1485.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1485.b: An official who read Jeremiah's scroll to Jehoiakim.
1485.s: Jehudi was an official during King Jehoiakim's reign who read Jeremiah's scroll to the king, who then burned it piece by piece.

1486.b: Wife of Mered; mother of Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel.
1486.s: Jehudijah (or the Judahite) was the wife of Mered and the mother of Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah.

1487.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1487.b: A Levite who helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah.
1487.s: Jehuel was a Levite from the family of Heman who participated in the cleansing of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

1488.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1488.b: One of David's mighty men from Mahavite.
1488.s: Jeiel the Mahavite was listed among David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles.

1489.d: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1489.b: A Levite musician and gatekeeper during David's reign.
1489.s: Jeiel (or Jehiah) was a Levite who served as a musician and gatekeeper during the time of David, particularly in the transportation of the ark to Jerusalem.

1490.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1490.s: Jeiel was the head of a family in the tribe of Reuben, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1491.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1491.b: Grandfather of Jahaziel, a Levite during Jehoshaphat's reign.
1491.s: Jeiel was the grandfather of Jahaziel, a Levite who prophesied during the reign of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

1492.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1492.b: A scribe in King Uzziah's army.
1492.s: Jeiel was the scribe who recorded the number of soldiers in King Uzziah's army.

1493.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1493.b: A Levite who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.
1493.s: Jeiel was one of the Levites who generously provided animals for King Josiah's Passover celebration.

1494.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1494.b: A descendant of Nebo who married a foreign wife.
1494.s: Jeiel, a descendant of Nebo, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

1495.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1495.s: Jekameam was a Levite, the son of Hebron, mentioned in the genealogies of the Levites in 1 Chronicles.

1496.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1496.b: Son of Shallum, a descendant of Judah.
1496.s: Jekamiah was a descendant of Judah through Shallum, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1497.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1497.b: Descendant of Jeconiah, a descendant of David.
1497.s: Jekamiah was a descendant of Jeconiah and a descendant of David, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1498.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1498.b: Son of Mered, founder of Zanoah.
1498.s: Jekuthiel was the son of Mered and the  father (ie founder) of Zanoah, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

1499.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
1499.b: One of Job's daughters born after his restoration.
1499.s: Jemimah was the first of three daughters born to Job after God restored his fortunes, as recorded in the book of Job.

1500.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1500.b: Son of Simeon, also known as Nemuel.
1500.s: Jemuel (or Nemuel) was a son of Simeon and a founder of the Nemuelite clan, as recorded in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

1501.b: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.
1501.s: Jephthah was a judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the Ammonites but made a tragic vow that resulted in the sacrifice of his daughter.

1502.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1502.s: Jephunneh is mentioned in the genealogy of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

1503.d: Caleb's father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1503.b: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.
1503.s: Jephunneh, a Kenizzite, was the father of Caleb, one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

1504.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1504.b: A son of Joktan, descendant of Shem.
1504.s: Jerah was one of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, as recorded in the Table of Nations in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

1505.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1505.b: A Levite of the Merari clan.
1505.s: Jerahmeel was a Levite of the family of Merari, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1506.b: Son of Hezron, a descendant of Judah.
1506.s: Jerahmeel was the son of Hezron and a prominent figure in the genealogy of Judah, with his descendants being called the Jerahmeelites.

1507.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1507.b: Son of Hammelech, sent to arrest Jeremiah.
1507.s: Jerahmeel, the son of Hammelech, was one of the officers sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest Jeremiah and Baruch.

1508.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1508.b: Son of Mered, founder of Gedor.
1508.s: Jered was the son of Mered and the  father (ie founder) of Gedor, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

1509.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1509.b: A descendant of Hashum who married a foreign wife.
1509.s: Jeremai, a descendant of Hashum, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

1510.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1510.b: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
1510.s: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

1511.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1511.b: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
1511.s: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

1512.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1512.b: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
1512.s: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

1513.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1513.b: A leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
1513.s: Jeremiah was one of the leaders of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the time of the Chronicles.

1514.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1514.b: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.
1514.s: Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, was a prophet who ministered during the reigns of the last kings of Judah, warning of the Babylonian exile and calling for repentance.

1515.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1515.s: Jeremiah of Libnah was the father of Hamutal, who was the mother of King Jehoahaz and King Zedekiah of Judah.

1516.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1516.s: Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, was a Rechabite who was tested by the prophet Jeremiah for his obedience to his ancestor's commands.

1517.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1517.b: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.
1517.s: Jeremiah was one of the priests who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, as recorded in Nehemiah.

1518.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1518.s: Jeremoth was a son of Becher and a member of the tribe of Benjamin, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1519.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1519.b: Son of Beriah, a Benjamite leader in Jerusalem.
1519.s: Jeremoth, the son of Beriah, was a leader of the Benjamites living in Jerusalem, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1520.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1520.b: A descendant of Elam who married a foreign wife.
1520.s: Jeremoth, a descendant of Elam, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

1521.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1521.b: A descendant of Zattu who married a foreign wife.
1521.s: Jeremoth, a descendant of Zattu, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

1522.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1522.b: A descendant of Bani who married a foreign wife.
1522.s: Jeremoth, a descendant of Bani, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

1523.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1523.b: A Levite, the firstborn son of Hebron.
1523.s: Jeriah was a Levite, the firstborn son of Hebron, and an ancestor of the Hebronites who served in the tabernacle during David's reign.

1524.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1524.s: Jeribai was listed among David's mighty men, a group of skilled warriors who fought alongside him.

1525.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1525.b: A son of Tola, from the tribe of Issachar.
1525.s: Jeriel was one of the sons of Tola and a leader in the tribe of Issachar, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1526.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1526.b: A Levite leader during David's reign.
1526.s: Jerijah was a Levite leader from the family of Hebron who served during the reign of King David.

1527.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1527.b: One of David's warriors from the tribe of Benjamin.
1527.s: Jerimoth was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

1528.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1528.b: A Levite, son of Mushi, from the Merari clan.
1528.s: Jerimoth was a Levite, the son of Mushi, from the clan of Merari, as recorded in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles.

1529.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1529.b: A Levite, son of Heman the singer.
1529.s: Jerimoth was a son of Heman, the Levitical singer, and was appointed by King David to serve in the tabernacle choir.

1530.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1530.b: Son of Azriel, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.
1530.s: Jerimoth, the son of Azriel, was a leader from the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David.

1531.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1531.b: Son of Bela, from the tribe of Benjamin.
1531.s: Jerimoth was a son of Bela and a leader in the tribe of Benjamin, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1532.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
1532.s: Jerimoth was a son of King David and Abihail, the daughter of Eliab, David's brother.

1533.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1533.b: A Levite overseer during Hezekiah's temple restoration.
1533.s: Jerimoth was a Levite appointed as an overseer during King Hezekiah's restoration of the temple and its services.

1534.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1534.b: Wife of Caleb; mother of unnamed children.
1534.s: Jerioth was one of the wives of Caleb, and she bore him some unnamed children, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

1535.d: King living at the time of United Monarchyand Divided Monarchy
1535.b: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.
1535.s: Jeroboam I was the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel after the split of the united monarchy following Solomon's reign.

1536.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1536.b: King of Israel, son of Jehoash.
1536.s: Jeroboam II was a king of Israel who reigned for 41 years, restoring some of Israel's former territories.

1537.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1537.b: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
1537.s: Jeroham was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

1538.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1538.b: A leader from the tribe of Dan.
1538.s: Jeroham was a leader from the tribe of Dan during the reign of King David.

1539.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1539.s: Jeroham was a Benjamite, the son of Jeshaiah, mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

1540.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
1540.s: Jeroham was a priest, the father of Adaiah, who served in the temple during the time of Nehemiah.

1541.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1541.s: Jeroham was a Benjamite, the father of Ibneiah, mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

1542.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
1542.b: An Ephraimite, father of Elkanah and grandfather of Samuel.
1542.s: Jeroham was an Ephraimite, the father of Elkanah and grandfather of the prophet Samuel.

1543.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1543.b: Father of Azariah, who supported Jehoiada's coup.
1543.s: Jeroham was the father of Azariah, one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king.

1544.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
1544.s: The unnamed wives David took in Jerusalem, who bore him more sons and daughters.

1545.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1545.b: Mother of King Jotham of Judah.
1545.s: Jerusha was the mother of King Jotham of Judah and the daughter of Zadok.

1546.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
1546.b: A Levite, son of Jeduthun the musician.
1546.s: Jeshaiah was a Levite, the son of Jeduthun, and a musician appointed by King David to serve in the tabernacle choir.

1547.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1547.b: A descendant of Shecaniah from the line of David.
1547.s: Jeshaiah was a descendant of Shecaniah, from the royal line of David, mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

1548.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1548.b: A Levite who accompanied Ezra to Jerusalem.
1548.s: Jeshaiah was a Levite who accompanied Ezra on his journey from Babylon to Jerusalem.

1549.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1549.b: A descendant of Elam who returned with Ezra.
1549.s: Jeshaiah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

1550.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1550.b: A descendant of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem.
1550.s: Jeshaiah, a descendant of Benjamin, was among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

1551.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1551.b: Head of the fourteenth priestly division.
1551.s: Jeshebeab was the head of the fourteenth division of priests during the time of David.

1552.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1552.b: A son of Caleb and Azubah.
1552.s: Jesher was one of the sons of Caleb and his wife Azubah, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

1553.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1553.s: Jeshishai was an ancestor of the Gadite leaders who lived in Bashan, as mentioned in the genealogy of Gad in 1 Chronicles.

1554.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1554.b: A leader from the tribe of Simeon.
1554.s: Jeshohaiah was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the time of King Hezekiah.

1555.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1555.b: Head of a priestly family that returned from exile.
1555.s: Jeshua was the head of a priestly family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

1556.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1556.b: A Levite during King Hezekiah's reign.
1556.s: Jeshua was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

1557.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1557.b: A prominent Levite leader during the post-exilic period.
1557.s: Jeshua was a prominent Levite leader who played a significant role in the restoration of Jerusalem and the temple after the Babylonian exile.

1558.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1558.b: Leader of a group that returned from Babylonian exile.
1558.s: Jeshua was the leader of a group of Israelites who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

1559.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1559.b: A priest who received the temple treasures.
1559.s: Jeshua was a priest who received the temple treasures brought back from Babylon during the return from exile.

1560.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1560.b: A Levite leader during Nehemiah's time.
1560.s: Jeshua was a Levite leader who served during the time of Nehemiah and participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

1561.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1561.b: Son of Jozadak, who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall.
1561.s: Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, was a high priest who helped rebuild a section of Jerusalem's wall during the time of Nehemiah.

1562.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1562.b: A leader from the tribe of Simeon.
1562.s: Jesimiel was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

1563.d: David's father living at the time of United Monarchy
1563.s: Jesse was the father of King David and an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

1564.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1564.b: The Son of God and Savior of the world.
1564.s: Jesus Christ, the central figure of Christianity, is the Son of God who became incarnate, died for the sins of humanity, and rose from the dead, providing salvation for all who believe in Him.

1565.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1565.b: A son of Jada from the tribe of Judah.
1565.s: Jether was a son of Jada, a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

1566.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1566.b: Son of Ezrah; brother of Mered, Epher and Jalon
1566.s: Jether, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

1567.d: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
1567.s: Jether, also known as Ithra, was an Ishmaelite and the father of Amasa, who was Absalom's commander and later killed by Joab.

1568.b: Gideon's firstborn son who refused to kill captives.
1568.s: Jether was Gideon's firstborn son who was commanded to kill Zebah and Zalmunna but was too young and fearful to do so.

1569.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1569.s: Jetheth, one of the chiefs of Edom.

1570.d: Midianite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1570.s: Jethro, also known as Reuel, was Moses' father-in-law and a priest of Midian.

1571.d: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
1571.s: Jetur, one of the twelve sons of Ishmael.

1572.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1572.s: Jeuel, a descendant of Zerah, settled in Jerusalem.

1573.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1573.b: A Levite who helped cleanse the temple
1573.s: Jeuel, a Levite who assisted in cleansing the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

1574.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1574.b: A descendant of Adonikam who returned from exile
1574.s: Jeuel, a descendant of Adonikam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

1575.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1575.b: A Levite, son of Shimei or Shubael
1575.s: Jeush, a Levite, was a son of Shimei (or Shubael) during David's reign.

1576.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1576.b: A descendant of Bilhan from the tribe of Benjamin
1576.s: Jeush, a Benjamite, was a descendant of Bilhan.

1577.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1577.b: A descendant of Eleasah from the tribe of Benjamin
1577.s: Jeush, a Benjamite, was a son of Eleasah (or 'Eshek').

1578.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1578.b: Son of King Rehoboam and Mahalath
1578.s: Jeush was a son of King Rehoboam and his wife Mahalath.

1579.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1579.s: Jeush, a son of Esau and Oholibamah, was a chief of Edom.

1580.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1580.b: A descendant of Shaharaim from the tribe of Benjamin
1580.s: Jeuz was a Benjamite, born to Shaharaim in the country of Moab.

1581.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1581.b: A leader of the Judean forces
1581.s: Jezaniah, also known as Azariah, was a leader of the Judean forces after the fall of Jerusalem.

1582.d: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1582.b: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab
1582.s: Queen Jezebel, the Phoenician wife of King Ahab, promoted Baal worship and persecuted the prophets of God.

1583.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1583.b: Son of Naphtali, founder of the Jezerite clan
1583.s: Jezer, a son of Naphtali, was the ancestor of the Jezerite clan.

1584.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1584.b: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1584.s: Jeziel, a Benjamite, was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

1585.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1585.b: A leader of the singers at the wall dedication
1585.s: Jezrahiah was one of the leaders of the singers during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

1586.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1586.b: A son of Hur in the genealogy of Judah
1586.s: Jezreel was a son of Hur, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

1587.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1587.b: A symbolic name given to Hosea's son
1587.s: Jezreel was the name given to Hosea's son as a sign of God's judgment on the house of Jehu.

1588.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1588.s: Jidlaph, a son of Nahor and Milcah, was Abraham's nephew.

1589.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1589.b: Son of Seraiah, founder of Ge-harashim
1589.s: Joab, the son of Seraiah, was the  father (ie founder) of Ge-harashim.

1590.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
1590.b: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army
1590.s: Joab, David's nephew and commander of his army, was a key figure in David's reign, known for his military prowess and loyalty.

1591.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1591.b: Ancestor of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
1591.s: Joab was the ancestor of a family that returned to Judah from Babylonian exile.

1592.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1592.b: A descendant of Pahath-Moab who returned with Ezra
1592.s: Joab, a descendant of Pahath-Moab, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

1593.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
1593.b: A son of Obed-edom, a gatekeeper of the temple
1593.s: Joah, a son of Obed-edom, was one of the gatekeepers assigned to guard the temple.

1594.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1594.b: A Gershonite Levite, son of Zimmah
1594.s: Joah (or Ethan), a Gershonite Levite, was the son of Zimmah in the genealogy of Levi.

1595.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1595.b: A Levite who helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah
1595.s: Joah, a Levite of the Gershonites, assisted in the purification of the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

1596.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1596.b: A Levite who helped purify the temple
1596.s: Joah son of Joahaz was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

1597.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1597.b: Son of Joahaz, King Josiah's secretary
1597.s: Joah, the son of Joahaz, served as King Josiah's secretary during the temple repairs.

1598.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1598.b: Son of Asaph, King Hezekiah's secretary
1598.s: Joah, the son of Asaph, served as King Hezekiah's secretary during the Assyrian invasion.

1599.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1599.b: Father of Joah, King Josiah's secretary
1599.s: Joahaz was the father of Joah, who served as King Josiah's secretary during the temple repairs.

1600.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1600.s: Joanan is listed as an ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

1601.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
1601.b: A follower of Jesus who supported His ministry
1601.s: Joanna, the wife of Chuza, was one of the women who followed and supported Jesus during His earthly ministry.

1602.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1602.b: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1602.s: Joash, the son of Shemaah the Gibeathite, was a Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

1603.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1603.b: An official in charge of David's olive and sycamore trees
1603.s: Joash the Abiezrite was responsible for King David's olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah.

1604.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1604.b: A descendant of Shelah in the tribe of Judah
1604.s: Joash was a descendant of Shelah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

1605.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1605.b: A descendant of Benjamin through Becher
1605.s: Joash was a descendant of Benjamin through Becher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

1606.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1606.b: Son of King Ahab of Israel
1606.s: Joash, the son of King Ahab, was imprisoned by his father for a prophecy against him.

1607.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1607.b: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah
1607.s: Joash (Jehoash), son of Ahaziah, became king of Judah at age seven and reigned for forty years.

1608.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1608.b: King of Israel, son of Jehoahaz
1608.s: Joash (Jehoash), son of Jehoahaz, reigned as king of Israel for sixteen years.

1609.b: The father of Gideon, a judge of Israel
1609.s: Joash, the father of Gideon, supported his son's actions in tearing down the altar of Baal.

1610.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1610.b: A righteous man who endured great suffering
1610.s: Job, a blameless and upright man from Uz, endured severe trials and maintained his faith in God.

1611.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1611.b: A son of Elpaal, descendant of Benjamin
1611.s: Jobab, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Elpaal.

1612.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1612.b: A son of Shaharaim and Hodesh
1612.s: Jobab was one of the sons born to Shaharaim and his wife Hodesh in the genealogy of Benjamin.

1613.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1613.b: A son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
1613.s: Jobab, a descendant of Shem through Joktan, is mentioned in the Table of Nations.

1614.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
1614.b: A king of Edom, son of Zerah of Bozrah
1614.s: Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, was an early king of Edom who reigned before Israel had a king.

1615.b: King of Madon, who joined forces against Joshua
1615.s: Jobab, the king of Madon, was one of the northern kings who allied against Israel during the conquest of Canaan.

1616.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1616.b: Mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
1616.s: Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, married her nephew Amram and became the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

1617.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1617.s: Joda is listed as an ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

1618.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1618.b: A Benjaminite who resettled in Jerusalem
1618.s: Joed, a Benjaminite, was among those who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

1619.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
1619.b: The brother of Nathan, one of David's mighty men
1619.s: Joel, the brother of Nathan, was one of the mighty men who fought valiantly for King David.

1620.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1620.b: A Gershomite Levite during the reign of David
1620.s: Joel, a Levite of the Gershomite clan, was appointed by David to help transport the ark of the covenant.

1621.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1621.b: A Gershonite Levite during David's organization of the Levites
1621.s: Joel, a descendant of Ladan from the Gershonite clan, was a Levite during David's time.

1622.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1622.b: A ruler of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead
1622.s: Joel was appointed as the ruler over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead during David's reign.

1623.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1623.b: A Simeonite mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
1623.s: Joel is listed in the genealogy of Judah as a descendant of Simeon.

1624.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1624.s: Joel was a chief of the Gadites who lived in the territory of Bashan.

1625.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1625.s: Joel is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Reuben as a descendant of Shemaiah.

1626.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1626.b: Father of Shema living in Reubenite lands
1626.s: Joel, a father of Shema who lived in Reuben and also neighbouring Gad.

1627.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1627.b: A son of Izrahiah from the tribe of Issachar
1627.s: Joel was one of the five sons of Izrahiah, a descendant of Issachar, known for their bravery.

1628.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
1628.b: Samuel's firstborn son who judged Israel
1628.s: Joel, the firstborn son of Samuel, served as a judge in Israel but did not walk in his father's ways.

1629.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1629.b: A Kohathite Levite during Hezekiah's temple restoration
1629.s: Joel, a Levite of the Kohathite clan, participated in the purification of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

1630.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1630.b: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile
1630.s: Joel was among the Israelites who had married foreign women and pledged to put them away during Ezra's reforms.

1631.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1631.b: A prophet of Judah and the author of the Book of Joel
1631.s: Joel, the son of Pethuel, was a prophet of Judah who delivered a message of judgment and hope.

1632.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1632.b: A Benjaminite leader in Jerusalem after the Exile
1632.s: Joel, the son of Zichri, was a Benjaminite leader in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

1633.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1633.b: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1633.s: Joelah, a Benjaminite warrior, was among those who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

1634.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1634.b: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1634.s: Joezer, a Korahite warrior, was among the Benjaminites who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

1635.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1635.b: A leader from the tribe of Dan
1635.s: Jogli, the son of Bukki, was a leader from the tribe of Dan appointed to help divide the Promised Land.

1636.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1636.b: One of David's mighty warriors from the Tizite clan
1636.s: Joha the Tizite was one of David's mighty warriors, known for his bravery and military skill.

1637.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1637.s: Joha was a son of Beriah and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

1638.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1638.b: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1638.s: Johanan, a Gadite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag and helped him fight against raiding bands.

1639.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1639.b: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1639.s: Johanan, a Benjaminite warrior, was among the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag.

1640.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1640.b: A descendant of David through the line of Jehoiachin
1640.s: Johanan is listed in the genealogy of David as a descendant of King Jehoiachin.

1641.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1641.b: A Levite in the lineage of Elkanah
1641.s: Johanan was a Priest in the lineage of Elkanah, the father of Samuel.

1642.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1642.b: An Ephraimite leader during the reign of Ahaz
1642.s: Johanan, the son of Jehohanan, was one of the leaders of Ephraim who opposed the bringing of Judean captives to Samaria.

1643.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1643.b: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem
1643.s: Johanan, the son of Kareah, was a prominent Judean military leader who played a significant role in the events following the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

1644.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1644.b: A leader who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra
1644.s: Johanan, the son of Hakkatan, was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

1645.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
1645.b: A high priest during the Persian period
1645.s: Johanan served as a high priest during the Persian period, as recorded in the genealogies of the priests and Levites.

1646.d: Priest living at the time of the New Testament
1646.b: A member of the high priest's family
1646.s: John, a member of the high priest's family, was present during Peter and John's questioning before the Sanhedrin.

1647.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1647.s: John, also known as Jonah, was the father of Simon Peter, one of Jesus' closest disciples.

1648.d: Prophet living at the time of the New Testament
1648.b: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus
1648.s: John the Baptist was a prophet who preached repentance and baptized many, including Jesus, preparing the way for the Messiah.

1649.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
1649.s: John and James, the sons of Zebedee, were among the twelve apostles and part of Jesus' inner circle.

1650.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
1650.b: A high priest, son of Eliashib
1650.s: Joiada served as a high priest during the Persian period, succeeding his father Eliashib.

1651.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1651.b: Son of Paseah, who repaired the Old Gate
1651.s: Joiada, the son of Paseah, repaired the Old Gate during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.

1652.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
1652.b: A high priest, son of Jeshua
1652.s: Joiakim served as a high priest during the early Persian period, succeeding his father Jeshua.

1653.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
1653.b: A priestly family that returned from Babylonian exile
1653.s: Joiarib (or Jehoiarib) was a priestly family that returned from the Babylonian exile and settled in Jerusalem.

1654.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1654.b: A man of understanding sent by Ezra
1654.s: Joiarib was one of the men of understanding sent by Ezra to bring Levites to Jerusalem.

1655.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1655.b: A descendant of Judah who settled in Jerusalem
1655.s: Joiarib, a descendant of Judah through Perez, settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

1656.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1656.b: A descendant of Judah through Shelah
1656.s: Jokim was a descendant of Judah through Shelah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

1657.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1657.b: A son of Abraham and Keturah
1657.s: Jokshan was one of the sons born to Abraham and his wife Keturah after the death of Sarah.

1658.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1658.b: Son of Eber and ancestor of Arabian tribes
1658.s: Joktan, a descendant of Shem through Eber, was the ancestor of several Arabian tribes.

1659.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1659.b: Son of Rechab, who promoted Rechabite lifestyle
1659.s: Jonadab, the son of Rechab, instructed his descendants to abstain from wine, live in tents, and follow a nomadic lifestyle, which they faithfully observed.

1660.d: David's nephew living at the time of United Monarchy
1660.b: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon
1660.s: Jonadab, also known as Jonathan, was the son of David's brother Shimeah and a friend and advisor to Amnon, David's eldest son.

1661.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1661.b: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh
1661.s: Jonah, a prophet from Gath-hepher, was sent to preach to Nineveh.

1662.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1662.s: Jonam, son of Eliakim, was an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

1663.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1663.b: Son of Jada, descendant of Judah
1663.s: One of the descendants of Judah, Jonathan was the son of Jada.

1664.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1664.s: Jonathan, the son of Uzziah, was one of King David's officials in charge of the royal treasuries.

1665.d: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
1665.b: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David
1665.s: Jonathan, the eldest son of King Saul, was a valiant warrior and a close friend of David, ultimately dying in battle alongside his father.

1666.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
1666.b: Son of Abiathar the priest during David's reign
1666.s: Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, served as a messenger and informant for David during Absalom's rebellion.

1667.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
1667.b: Son of Shammah the Hararite, one of David's mighty men
1667.s: Jonathan, the son of Shammah the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men, known for his military prowess.

1668.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1668.b: Opposed divorcing foreigners, with Jahzeiah and Meshullam
1668.s: Jonathan, along with Jahzeiah and Meshullam, opposed Ezra's demand to put away foreign wives.

1669.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1669.b: Descendant of Adaiah who returned from exile
1669.s: Jonathan, of the descendants of Adaiah, was among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

1670.b: A Levite who served as a priest for Dan
1670.s: Jonathan, a Levite from Bethlehem, became a priest for the tribe of Dan after they set up a carved image.

1671.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1671.b: Scribe with a house used as prison
1671.s: Jonathan was a scribe who had a house in Jerusalem that was used as a prison.

1672.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1672.b: Son of Kareah, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
1672.s: Jonathan son of Kareah was one of the army officers who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem.

1673.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1673.b: Head of priestly family of Malluchi
1673.s: Jonathan was the head of the priestly family of Malluchi during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

1674.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1674.b: Priest who participated in dedication of Jerusalem's wall
1674.s: Jonathan, a priest, was among those who blew trumpets at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

1675.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1675.b: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
1675.s: The descendants of Jorah (or Hariph) were among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

1676.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1676.b: A chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh
1676.s: Jorai was a clan chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King Jotham of Judah.

1677.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1677.b: A Levite during the reign of King David
1677.s: Joram was a Levite who served during the reign of King David.

1678.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
1678.b: Son of King Toi, brought gifts to David
1678.s: Joram (or Hadoram), son of King Toi of Hamath, brought gifts to King David after David's defeat of Hadadezer.

1679.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1679.s: Jorim is listed as one of the ancestors of Jesus Christ in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

1680.d: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
1680.b: A son or town founded by Raham
1680.s: Jorkeam was a descendant of Caleb or a town founded by Raham in the tribe of Judah.

1681.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1681.s: Josech (or Joseph) is listed as one of the ancestors of Jesus Christ in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

1682.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1682.b: Son of Asaph, a musician in David's time
1682.s: Joseph, a son of Asaph, was a musician who served during King David's reign.

1683.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1683.b: Candidate to replace Judas as apostle
1683.s: Joseph, also called Barsabbas or Justus, was considered as a replacement for Judas among the apostles.

1684.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1684.b: An Israelite who married a foreign woman
1684.s: Joseph was among the Israelites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

1685.d: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
1685.b: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt
1685.s: Joseph, Jacob's son, rose to power in Egypt and saved his family during a famine.

1686.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1686.s: Joseph, the son of Mattathias, is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

1687.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1687.s: Joseph, the son of Jonam, is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

1688.d: Mary's husband living at the time of the New Testament
1688.b: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus
1688.s: Joseph was the husband of Mary and the earthly father of Jesus Christ.

1689.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1689.b: Of Arimathea, buried Jesus in his own tomb
1689.s: Joseph of Arimathea was a wealthy disciple who buried Jesus in his own new tomb.

1690.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1690.b: Head of the priestly family of Shebaniah
1690.s: Joseph was the head of the priestly family of Shebaniah during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

1691.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1691.b: Representative of Issachar among the spies
1691.s: Joseph son of Igal represented the tribe of Issachar among the twelve spies sent to Canaan.

1692.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1692.b: Brother of Jesus and son of Mary
1692.s: Joses (or Joseph) was one of Jesus' brothers and a son of Mary.

1693.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1693.b: Brother of James "the Less" and son of the "other" Mary
1693.s: Joses (or Joseph) was brother of James "the Less" who was an apostle.

1694.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1694.b: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
1694.s: Joshah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

1695.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1695.b: One of David's mighty warriors from Mithan
1695.s: Joshaphat the Mithnite was listed among David's mighty warriors.

1696.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1696.b: A priest who blew trumpets before the ark
1696.s: Joshaphat, along with other priests, blew trumpets before the ark of the covenant during its transfer to Jerusalem.

1697.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1697.b: One of David's mighty warriors from Eliahba's sons
1697.s: Joshaviah, a son of Elnaam, was listed among David's mighty warriors.

1698.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1698.b: A son of Heman, a musician in David's time
1698.s: Joshbekashah, one of Heman's sons, was a musician appointed by King David to lead worship.

1699.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1699.b: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
1699.s: Joshibiah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

1700.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
1700.b: Owner of a field in Beth-shemesh
1700.s: The ark of the covenant was placed on a rock in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.

1701.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1701.b: Governor of Jerusalem during Josiah's reign
1701.s: Joshua was the governor of Jerusalem during the reign of King Josiah.

1702.d: Judge living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
1702.b: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan
1702.s: Joshua, the son of Nun, was Moses' assistant and successor who led the Israelites into the Promised Land.

1703.d: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
1703.b: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple
1703.s: Joshua (or Jeshua), the son of Jehozadak, was the high priest who led the rebuilding of the temple after the Babylonian exile.

1704.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1704.s: Joshua (or Jose) is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

1705.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1705.b: King of Judah known for his religious reforms
1705.s: Josiah was a king of Judah who instituted significant religious reforms and repaired the temple.

1706.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1706.b: One who provided silver and gold for a crown
1706.s: Josiah (or Hen), along with others, provided silver and gold for a crown in a symbolic act during Zechariah's time.

1707.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1707.b: Father of Shelomith, a returning exile
1707.s: Josiphiah was the father of Shelomith, who was among the exiles who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem.

1708.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1708.b: A son of Jahdai, a Calebite
1708.s: Jotham was a son of Jahdai, who was a wife of Caleb.

1709.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1709.b: King of Judah and son of Uzziah
1709.s: Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was a king of Judah who reigned for sixteen years.

1710.b: Youngest son of Gideon who escaped Abimelech's massacre
1710.s: Jotham, the youngest son of Gideon, was the only one to escape when Abimelech killed his seventy brothers.

1711.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1711.b: A Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
1711.s: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

1712.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1712.b: A Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
1712.s: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

1713.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1713.b: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
1713.s: Jozabad, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag.

1714.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1714.b: A Levite appointed as an overseer during Hezekiah's reign
1714.s: Jozabad, a Levite, was one of the overseers appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute the contributions to the priests and Levites.

1715.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1715.b: A Levite who contributed to the Passover celebration
1715.s: Jozabad, along with other Levitical leaders, generously provided animals for the Passover offerings during King Josiah's reign.

1716.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1716.b: A priest who married a foreign woman
1716.s: Jozabad was one of the priests who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

1717.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1717.b: A Levite who married a foreign woman
1717.s: Jozabad was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

1718.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1718.b: A priest who weighed the silver and gold offerings
1718.s: Jozabad, along with Noadiah, was a priest appointed to weigh the silver, gold, and vessels brought as offerings to the temple.

1719.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1719.b: A Levite leader in charge of outside work
1719.s: Jozabad, one of the leaders of the Levites, was in charge of the outside work of the house of God.

1720.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1720.b: A Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
1720.s: Jozabad was one of the Levites who helped the people understand the Law as Ezra read it aloud.

1721.d: Ammonite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1721.b: One of the servants who killed King Joash
1721.s: Jozacar (or Zabad), along with Jehozabad, was one of the servants who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.

1722.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1722.b: A priest whose descendants married foreign women
1722.s: Among the descendants of Jozadak, some priests were found to have married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

1723.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
1723.b: Father of musicians who play the lyre and pipe
1723.s: Jubal was the father of all who play the lyre and pipe.

1724.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1724.b: A Levite who married a foreign woman
1724.s: Judah was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

1725.d: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
1725.s: Judah, also known as the Jews or Judea, refers to the Israelite tribe, the southern kingdom, and the Roman province in various biblical contexts.

1726.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1726.s: Judah is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

1727.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1727.b: Leader of Judahites living in Jerusalem
1727.s: Judah was a leader of the people of Judah living in Jerusalem after the exile.

1728.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1728.b: A priest who participated in the dedication ceremony
1728.s: Judah, along with other priests, played musical instruments during the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

1729.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1729.b: A Levite who participated in the dedication ceremony
1729.s: Judah was one of the Levites who led the thanksgiving choir during the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

1730.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1730.b: A prophet and leader in the Jerusalem church
1730.s: Judas, also known as Barsabbas, was a prophet and respected leader in the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul and Barnabas to Antioch.

1731.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1731.b: The Galilean, a Jewish rebel leader
1731.s: Judas the Galilean led a revolt against the Roman census during the time of Quirinius, governor of Syria.

1732.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1732.b: A Christian living on Straight Street in Damascus
1732.s: Judas was a Christian living on Straight Street in Damascus, where Saul (Paul) stayed after his conversion.

1733.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
1733.b: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus
1733.s: Judas, also known as Lebbaeus or Thaddaeus, was one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus Christ.

1734.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
1734.s: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve apostles who betrayed Jesus, leading to His arrest and crucifixion.

1735.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1735.b: A brother of Jesus and author of the epistle
1735.s: Jude, a brother of Jesus, was the author of the Epistle of Jude and is mentioned in the lists of Jesus' siblings.

1736.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
1736.b: A Hittite woman who married Esau
