1736.s: Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, was one of Esau's wives, causing grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

1737.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
1737.b: A Christian woman greeted by Paul in Romans
1737.s: Julia, along with Philologus and Nereus, was greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

1738.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1738.b: A centurion of the Augustan Cohort
1738.s: Julius, a centurion of the Augustan Cohort, was responsible for escorting Paul to Rome and showed him kindness during the journey.

1739.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
1739.b: A prominent apostle and relative of Paul
1739.s: Junia, along with Andronicus, was recognized as a prominent apostle and a relative of Paul who had been imprisoned with him.

1740.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1740.s: Jushab-hesed was one of the sons of Zerubbabel, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

1741.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1741.b: Titius Justus, a Gentile believer who hosted Paul in Corinth
1741.s: Titius Justus, a Gentile worshiper of God, hosted Paul in Corinth after he left the synagogue.

1742.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1742.b: Jesus Justus, a Jewish believer who supported Paul
1742.s: Jesus, also called Justus, was one of the few Jewish believers who supported Paul during his imprisonment.

1743.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1743.b: A Levite who returned from Babylonian exile
1743.s: Kadmiel was a Levite who returned from Babylonian exile and played a significant role in the rebuilding of the temple and the spiritual renewal of the people.

1744.s: The Kadmonites were one of the Canaanite people groups living in the land promised to Abraham's descendants.

1745.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1745.b: A priest during the time of Joiakim
1745.s: Kallai was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, after the Babylonian exile.

1746.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1746.s: Kareah was the father of Johanan and Jonathan, two military leaders who joined Gedaliah after the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

1747.d: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
1747.b: A son of Ishmael and a nomadic tribe
1747.s: Kedar was a son of Ishmael and the eponymous ancestor of a nomadic Arab tribe known for their tents and flocks.

1748.d: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
1748.b: A son of Ishmael; Nodab, a Hagrite tribe
1748.s: Kedemah was a son of Ishmael, while the Nodab were a Hagrite tribe defeated by the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh.

1749.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1749.b: A Levite who married a foreign woman
1749.s: Kelaiah, also known as Kelita, was a Levite who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reform.

1750.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1750.b: A Levite who taught the Law and sealed the covenant
1750.s: Kelita was a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people and sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

1751.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1751.b: A Levite leader during David's reign
1751.s: Kemuel, the son of Hebron, was the leader of the Levites during the reign of King David.

1752.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1752.b: A son of Nahor and Milcah
1752.s: Kemuel was a son of Nahor and Milcah and the father of Aram.

1753.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1753.b: A leader from the tribe of Ephraim
1753.s: Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan, was a leader from the tribe of Ephraim appointed to help divide the Promised Land.

1754.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
1754.b: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth
1754.s: Kenan (Cainan), the son of Enosh, was a descendant of Seth and an ancestor of Noah.

1755.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1755.s: Kenaz was a descendant of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

1756.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1756.b: An Edomite clan descended from Esau
1756.s: Kenaz was one of the clans of Edom, descended from Esau through his son Eliphaz.

1757.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1757.b: Father of Othniel, a judge of Israel
1757.s: Kenaz was the father of Othniel, a judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the oppression of Cushan-rishathaim.

1758.b: A nomadic tribe friendly to the Israelites
1758.s: The Kenites were a nomadic tribe who lived in the region of Canaan and were generally friendly to the Israelites, often providing them with assistance and support.

1759.b: A Canaanite tribe in the Promised Land
1759.s: The Kenizzites were one of the Canaanite tribes inhabiting the land God promised to give to Abraham's descendants.

1760.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
1760.b: Job's third daughter born after his restoration
1760.s: Keren-happuch was the name of Job's third daughter, born to him after God restored his fortunes.

1761.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1761.b: A family of temple servants who returned from exile
1761.s: Keros was the name of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

1762.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
1762.s: Keturah was the concubine Abraham took after the death of Sarah, and she bore him six sons.

1763.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
1763.b: Job's second daughter born after his restoration
1763.s: Keziah was the name of Job's second daughter, born to him after God restored his fortunes.

1764.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1764.b: A Levite from the Merari clan
1764.s: Kish was a Levite from the clan of Merari, whose descendants were assigned duties in the tabernacle service.

1765.d: Saul's father living at the time of United Monarchy
1765.b: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel
1765.s: Kish was a Benjamite, the father of Saul, who was anointed by Samuel as the first king of Israel.

1766.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1766.b: A Levite who helped purify the temple
1766.s: Kish, a Levite from the clan of Merari, participated in the purification of the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

1767.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1767.s: Kish, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of Mordecai, the cousin and guardian of Queen Esther.

1768.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1768.b: A Levite and father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan')
1768.s: Kishi, also known as Kushaiah, was a Levite from the clan of Merari and the father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan'), a prominent musician in King David's court.

1769.b: Descendants of Javan, son of Japheth
1769.s: Kittim, a descendant of Japheth, son of Noah.

1770.d: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1770.b: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor
1770.s: Kohath, son of Levi, was the ancestor of Moses and Aaron.

1771.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1771.s: Kolaiah, a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

1772.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1772.s: Kolaiah, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.

1773.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1773.b: Son of Hebron, descendant of Caleb
1773.s: Korah, son of Hebron, from the tribe of Judah.

1774.d: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1774.b: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants
1774.s: Korah, a Levite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron; his descendants became temple musicians and gatekeepers.

1775.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1775.s: Korah, an Edomite chief, descendant of Eliphaz, son of Esau.

1776.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1776.s: Korah, son of Esau and Oholibamah

1777.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1777.s: Kore, a Levite gatekeeper, descendant of Korah

1778.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1778.b: Levite in charge of freewill offerings
1778.s: Kore, a Levite in charge of distributing freewill offerings during Hezekiah's reign.

1779.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1779.s: Koz, a descendant of Judah through Ashhur.

1780.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1780.s: Laadah, a son of Shelah and descendant of Judah.

1781.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1781.b: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel
1781.s: Laban, the brother of Rebekah and father of Jacob's wives, Leah and Rachel.

1782.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

1783.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1783.b: Father of Eliasaph, a Gershonite Levite
1783.s: Lael, the father of Eliasaph, a leader of the Gershonite Levites.

1784.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1784.s: Lahad, a descendant of Judah through Jahath.

1785.d: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
1785.s: Lahmi, the brother of Goliath, was killed by Elhanan the Bethlehemite.

1786.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
1786.s: Laish, the father of Palti (or 'Paltiel'), to whom Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage.

1787.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
1787.b: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible
1787.s: Lamech, a descendant of Cain, was the first polygamist mentioned in the Bible.

1788.d: Man living at the time before the Flood
1788.s: Lamech, the father of Noah, lived 777 years.

1789.b: Husband of Deborah the prophetess and judge
1789.s: Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah, a prophetess and judge in Israel.

1790.d: Mary's brother living at the time of the New Testament
1790.b: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead
1790.s: Lazarus, the brother of Mary and Martha, was raised from the dead by Jesus (<ref="Jhn.11.1-44; 12.1-2,9-11">Jhn.11.1-44; 12.1-2,9-11</ref>).

1791.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1791.b: Poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man
1791.s: Lazarus, a poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man and Lazarus (<ref="Luk.16.20-25">Luk.16.20-25</ref>).

1792.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
1792.b: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah
1792.s: Leah, the first wife of Jacob and mother of six of his sons and his daughter Dinah.

1793.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1793.b: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile
1793.s: Lebanah or Lebana, whose descendants were among the temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

1794.d: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
1794.s: Lecah, a descendant of Judah through Er.

1795.b: Son of Mizraim; progenitor of a people group
1795.s: Lehabim, a son of Mizraim and progenitor of a people group.

1796.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
1796.b: King mentioned in Proverbs; his mother taught him wisdom
1796.s: Lemuel, a king whose wise sayings are recorded in Proverbs 31, as taught by his mother.

1797.b: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah
1797.s: Letushim, a son of Dedan and descendant of Abraham and Keturah.

1798.b: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah
1798.s: Leummim, a son of Dedan and descendant of Abraham and Keturah.

1799.d: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
1799.b: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites
1799.s: Levi, son of Jacob and Leah, was the progenitor of the Levites, the priestly tribe of Israel.

1800.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1800.b: Son of Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus
1800.s: Levi, son of Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy (<ref="Luk.3.24">Luk.3.24</ref>).

1801.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1801.b: Son of Simeon, an ancestor of Jesus
1801.s: Levi, son of Simeon, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy (<ref="Luk.3.29">Luk.3.29</ref>).

1802.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1802.b: Grandson of Merari; grandson of Levi
1802.s: Libni, a grandson of Merari and grandson of Levi.

1803.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1803.b: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi
1803.s: Libni or Ladan, a son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.

1804.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1804.s: Likhi, a son of Shemida and descendant of Manasseh.

1805.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1805.b: Christian in Rome; greeted by Paul
1805.s: Linus, a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

1806.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1806.b: Symbolic name of Hosea's son; represents God's rejection of Israel
1806.s: Lo-ammi, meaning "not my people," was the symbolic name given to Hosea's son, representing God's rejection of Israel.

1807.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
1807.b: Grandmother of Timothy; commended for her faith
1807.s: Lois, the grandmother of Timothy, was commended by Paul for her sincere faith.

1808.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1808.b: Symbolic name of Hosea's daughter; represents God's withdrawal of mercy
1808.s: Lo-ruhamah, meaning "not pitied," was the symbolic name given to Hosea's daughter, representing God's withdrawal of mercy from Israel.

1809.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1809.b: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction
1809.s: Lot, the nephew of Abraham, was rescued from Sodom before its destruction.

1810.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
1810.b: Son of Seir the Horite; chief of Edom
1810.s: Lotan, a son of Seir the Horite and a chief of Edom.

1811.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1811.b: Prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch.
1811.s: Lucius of Cyrene was a prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch who was involved in sending Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey.

1812.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1812.b: Son of Shem; progenitor of the Lydians
1812.s: Lud, a son of Shem and progenitor of the Lydians.

1813.b: Son of Mizraim; progenitor of a people group
1813.s: Ludim, a son of Mizraim and progenitor of a people group.

1814.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1814.b: Physician; companion of Paul; author of Luke and Acts
1814.s: Luke, a physician and companion of Paul, was the author of the Gospel of Luke and the Book of Acts.

1815.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
1815.b: Seller of purple goods; converted by Paul in Philippi
1815.s: Lydia, a seller of purple goods from Thyatira, was converted by Paul in Philippi and hosted the church in her home.

1816.d: Tetrarch of Abilene living at the time of the New Testament
1816.b: Tetrarch of Abilene during John the Baptist's ministry
1816.s: Lysanias, the tetrarch of Abilene, ruled during the time of John the Baptist's ministry (<ref="Luk.3.1">Luk.3.1</ref>).

1817.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
1817.b: Roman commander who rescued Paul from a Jewish mob
1817.s: Claudius Lysias, the Roman commander in Jerusalem, rescued Paul from a Jewish mob and sent him to Felix.

1818.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1818.b: Father of Hanan, one of David's mighty men
1818.s: Maacah was the father of Hanan, one of David's mighty men.

1819.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1819.b: Caleb's concubine; mother of Sheber and Tirhanah
1819.s: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

1820.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
1820.b: Father of Shephatiah, leader of the Simeonites under David
1820.s: Maacah was the father of Shephatiah, the leader of the Simeonites during the reign of King David.

1821.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
1821.b: Sister of Huppim and Shuppim; mother of Peresh and Sheresh
1821.s: Maacah, the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, was the wife of Machir and mother of Peresh and Sheresh.

1822.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
1822.s: Maacah, the mother of Kish, the father of Saul.

1823.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
1823.b: Daughter of Abishalom; wife of Rehoboam; mother of Abijah
1823.s: Maacah, also known as Micaiah, the daughter of Abishalom (Absalom), was the wife of Rehoboam and mother of Abijah, king of Judah.

1824.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
1824.b: Daughter of Talmai; wife of David; mother of Absalom
1824.s: Maacah, the daughter of King Talmai of Geshur, was one of David's wives and the mother of Absalom.

1825.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
1825.s: Maacah, a concubine of Nahor, was the mother of Nahor's son Tebah.

1826.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
1826.b: One of the men who married foreign women during Ezra's time
1826.s: Maadai was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

1827.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

2091.s: Mordecai, Esther's cousin and guardian, played a crucial role in saving the Jews from Haman's plot during the reign of King Ahasuerus (Xerxes) of Persia.

2092.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2092.b: A leader who returned from Babylonian exile.
2092.s: Mordecai was one of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian captivity to Jerusalem.

2093.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2093.b: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
2093.s: Moses was a prophet whom God used to lead Israel out of slavery in Egypt and give them the law.

2094.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2094.b: Son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah
2094.s: Moza was a son of Caleb, the renowned spy, by his concubine Ephah.

2095.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2095.b: Son of Zimri, descendant of King Saul
2095.s: Moza, a Benjamite, was a descendant of King Saul.

2096.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2096.s: Muppim, also known as Shephupham, Shephuphan, or Shuphamite, was a son of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

2097.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2097.b: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.
2097.s: Mushi was a son of Merari and a grandson of Levi, who became the head of the Mushite clan within the Levitical tribe.

2098.b: Son of Caleb, from the tribe of Judah.
2098.s: Naam was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

2099.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
2099.b: An Ammonite; mother of King Rehoboam of Judah.
2099.s: Naamah, an Ammonite woman, was the mother of Rehoboam, who succeeded his father Solomon as king of Judah.

2100.d: Woman living at the time before the Flood
2100.b: Daughter of Lamech and Zillah, sister of Tubal-cain.
2100.s: Naamah was the daughter of Lamech and Zillah, and the sister of Tubal-cain, mentioned in the genealogy of Cain.

2101.b: A descendant of Benjamin, son of Ehud.
2101.s: Naaman, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Ehud mentioned in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles.

2102.d: Syrian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2102.b: Aramean commander healed of leprosy by Elisha.
2102.s: Naaman, a commander of the Aramean army, was healed of his leprosy by the prophet Elisha, demonstrating God's power and compassion.

2103.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2103.s: Naaman, also known as Nohah, was one of the sons of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

2104.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2104.b: Grandson of Benjamin, head of the Naamite clan.
2104.s: Naaman, a grandson of Benjamin through Bela, was the head of the Naamite clan within the tribe of Benjamin.

2105.b: The people group of Zophar, Job's friend.
2105.s: The Naamathites were the people group to which Zophar, one of Job's three friends, belonged.

2106.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2106.b: Wife of Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa.
2106.s: Naarah was one of the two wives of Ashhur, the  father (ie founder) of Tekoa, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

2107.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2107.b: One of David's mighty warriors, son of Ezbai.
2107.s: Naarai, the son of Ezbai, was one of the mighty warriors who fought alongside King David.

2108.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2108.b: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.
2108.s: Nabal, a wealthy man from Carmel, was known for his foolishness and mistreatment of David, which nearly led to his demise.

2109.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2109.b: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.
2109.s: Naboth, a Jezreelite, was unjustly killed by King Ahab and Queen Jezebel for refusing to sell his ancestral vineyard.

2110.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2110.b: Threshing floor where Uzzah touched the ark.
2110.s: Nacon, also known as Chidon, was the owner of the threshing floor where Uzzah touched the ark of God and was struck down.

2111.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2111.b: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.
2111.s: Nadab was a son of Shammai, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

2112.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2112.b: Son of Abiel, from the tribe of Benjamin.
2112.s: Nadab was a son of Abiel, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

2113.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2113.b: King of Israel, son of Jeroboam I, reigned briefly.
2113.s: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam I, reigned as king of Israel for two years before being assassinated by Baasha.

2114.d: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2114.b: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.
2114.s: Nadab, the eldest son of Aaron, was consumed by fire from the Lord for offering unauthorized incense.

2115.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2115.s: Naggai is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ as recorded in the Gospel of Luke.

2116.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2116.b: Brother of Hodiah who married Ishbar.
2116.s: Naham, the brother of Hodiah whose son founded Keilah the Garmite city.

2117.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2117.b: One who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.
2117.s: Nahamani was among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity with Zerubbabel.

2118.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
2118.b: One of David's mighty men, Joab's armor-bearer.
2118.s: Naharai the Beerothite, Joab's armor-bearer, was one of David's mighty men.

2119.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
2119.b: Ammonite king who besieged Jabesh Gilead.
2119.s: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, besieged Jabesh Gilead and threatened to gouge out the right eyes of its inhabitants.

2120.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
2120.b: Ammonite king, father of Hanun, showed kindness to David.
2120.s: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites and father of Hanun, had shown kindness to David, prompting David to send envoys to console Hanun after Nahash's death.

2121.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
2121.b: Mother of Abigail and Zeruiah, David's sisters.
2121.s: Nahash, the mother of David and his sisters Abigail and Zeruiah, is mentioned in the context of Amasa's lineage.

2122.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
2122.b: King of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David.
2122.s: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David and his men during their time in Mahanaim.

2123.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2123.b: A Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah.
2123.s: Nahath was one of the Levites appointed by King Hezekiah to oversee the distribution of offerings and tithes.

2124.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
2124.b: A descendant of Esau, a chief of Edom.
2124.s: Nahath, a descendant of Esau, was one of the chiefs of Edom.

2125.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2125.b: The spy from the tribe of Naphtali.
2125.s: Nahbi, the son of Vophsi, was the representative from the tribe of Naphtali among the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

2126.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2126.b: Son of Serug; father of Terah, Abraham's father.
2126.s: Nahor, the son of Serug and father of Terah, was Abraham's grandfather.

2127.d: Abraham's brother living at the time of the Patriarchs
2127.b: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.
2127.s: Nahor, the son of Terah and brother of Abraham, was the father of Bethuel and the grandfather of Rebekah.

2128.b: Son of Amminadab, leader of Judah, ancestor of David.
2128.s: Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, was a leader of the tribe of Judah during the Exodus and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

2129.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2129.s: Nahum is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ as recorded in the Gospel of Luke.

2130.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2130.b: Old Testament prophet, author of the Book of Nahum.
2130.s: Nahum, identified as the Elkoshite, was a prophet of God who delivered a message of judgment against the Assyrian city of Nineveh.

2131.s: Naomi, also known as Mara, was an Israelite woman who, after losing her husband and sons, returned from Moab to Bethlehem with her daughter-in-law Ruth.

2132.d: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
2132.b: Son of Ishmael, defeated by Reubenites, Gadites, and Manassites.
2132.s: Naphish, a son of Ishmael, was among the Hagrite tribes defeated by the Reubenites, Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

2133.d: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
2133.b: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.
2133.s: Naphtali, the sixth son of Jacob and second son of Bilhah, was the founder of the Israelite tribe that bore his name.

2134.b: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
2134.s: The Naphtuhim were descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham, who settled in northern Egypt.

2135.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2135.b: Christian in Rome with a household
2135.s: Narcissus was likely a wealthy Christian in Rome with a household of believers.

2136.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2136.b: Son of Attai, from the tribe of Judah.
2136.s: Nathan, the son of Attai, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

2137.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
2137.b: One of David's mighty men, brother of Joel.
2137.s: Nathan, the brother of Joel, was one of David's mighty men.

2138.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
2138.b: Son of David and Bathsheba, ancestor of Jesus.
2138.s: Nathan, a son of David and Bathsheba, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ.

2139.d: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
2139.b: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.
2139.s: Nathan, a prophet of God, served during the reigns of David and Solomon, offering guidance, confronting David's sin, and supporting Solomon's accession to the throne.

2140.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2140.b: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile.
2140.s: Nathan is listed among the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Exile and pledged to put them away.

2141.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2141.b: A leader summoned by Ezra to help teach the Law.
2141.s: Nathan, along with other leaders, was summoned by Ezra to assist in teaching the Law to the people.

2142.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2142.b: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.
2142.s: Nathanael, also known as Bartholomew, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, who was initially skeptical but later confessed Jesus as the Son of God.

2143.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2143.b: A court official during King Josiah's reign.
2143.s: Nathan-melech was a court official who had living quarters near the entrance of the temple during King Josiah's reign.

2144.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2144.b: Descendant of David, son of Shemaiah.
2144.s: Neariah, a descendant of King David, was the son of Shemaiah and had three sons: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.

2145.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2145.b: A Simeonite leader who defeated the Amalekites.
2145.s: Neariah, along with other Simeonite leaders, defeated the remaining Amalekites during the reign of King Hezekiah.

2146.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2146.b: A leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
2146.s: Nebai was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah to follow God's law.

2147.d: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
2147.b: Firstborn son of Ishmael; father of a tribe.
2147.s: Nebaioth, the firstborn son of Ishmael, was the ancestor of a tribe known for their flocks and mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy of future blessing.

2148.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2148.b: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.
2148.s: Nebat was the father of Jeroboam I, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel after the division of the monarchy.

2149.d: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2149.b: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah
2149.s: Nebuchadnezzar II was the powerful Emperor of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem and exiled the Jews.

2150.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2150.s: Nebu-sar-sekim was a high official in Nebuchadnezzar's army when Jerusalem fell.

2151.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2151.b: Babylonian official during the fall of Jerusalem.
2151.s: Nebushazban, a Babylonian official, was among those who took charge of Jeremiah after the fall of Jerusalem.

2152.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2152.b: Babylonian captain of the guard during Jerusalem's fall.
2152.s: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the Babylonian guard, oversaw the destruction of Jerusalem, the exile of its inhabitants, and the release of Jeremiah.

2153.d: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2153.b: Egyptian Pharaoh during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim.
2153.s: Pharaoh Neco II, the ruler of Egypt, opposed King Josiah of Judah, installed Jehoiakim as a vassal king, and was later defeated by Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

2154.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2154.b: Descendant of King Jeconiah of Judah
2154.s: Nedabiah was a descendant of Jeconiah, the exiled king of Judah.

2155.b: Hometown of the false prophet Shemaiah
2155.s: Nehelam was the hometown of Shemaiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah.

2156.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2156.b: A leader who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem.
2156.s: Nehemiah was among the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian exile to Jerusalem.

2157.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2157.b: Governor of Judah, rebuilt Jerusalem's walls.
2157.s: Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah, served as the governor of Judah and led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls in the mid-5th century BC.

2158.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2158.b: Son of Azbuk, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
2158.s: Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk, was a leader who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David during the rebuilding process led by Nehemiah the governor.

2159.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2159.b: Mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.
2159.s: Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, was the mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

2160.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2160.b: A family of temple servants who returned from exile.
2160.s: The descendants of Nekoda were among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

2161.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2161.b: Family excluded from the priesthood after the Exile.
2161.s: The descendants of Nekoda were among those who could not prove their priestly lineage after returning from the Babylonian exile.

2162.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2162.b: Son of Eliab, from the tribe of Reuben.
2162.s: Nemuel was a son of Eliab and a member of the tribe of Reuben.

2163.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
2163.b: Son of King David, born in Jerusalem.
2163.s: Nepheg was one of the sons of King David, born to him in Jerusalem.

2164.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2164.b: Son of Izhar, from the tribe of Levi.
2164.s: Nepheg was a son of Izhar and a member of the Levite clan of Kohath.

2165.b: Mysterious giants mentioned in the pre-flood and post-flood eras.
2165.s: The Nephilim were a race of giants mentioned in the context of the sons of God marrying human women before the flood and later encountered by the Israelite spies in Canaan.

2166.b: Family of temple servants who returned from exile.
2166.s: The Nephushesim (or Nephisim) were a family of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

2167.d: Saul's uncle living at the time of United Monarchy
2167.b: Father of Abner, King Saul's commander.
2167.s: Ner was the father of Abner, the commander of King Saul's army, and a member of Saul's family.

2168.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2168.b: A Christian in Rome greeted by Paul.
2168.s: Nereus was a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

2169.d: Babylonian official living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2169.b: Future Babylonian king at Jerusalem's fall
2169.s: Nergal-sar-ezer was a Babylonian official present at the capture of Jerusalem in 587 BC and probably became king Neriglissar.

2170.d: Babylonian official of Samgar living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2170.s: Nergal-sar-ezer the Rab-mag was a Babylonian official present at the capture of Jerusalem in 587 BC.

2171.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2171.s: Neri was an ancestor of Jesus, mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

2172.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2172.s: Neriah was the father of Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe.

2173.d: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
2173.s: Nero was likely the Roman emperor during Paul's final imprisonment.

2174.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2174.s: Nethanel was a priest who blew trumpets before the ark of God.

2175.d: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
2175.s: Nethanel was a son of Jesse and brother of King David.

2176.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2176.s: Nethanel was a scribe who helped divide the priests into their divisions during David's reign.

2177.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
2177.s: Nethanel was one of the sons of Obed-Edom, the Levite.

2178.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2178.s: Nethanel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

2179.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2179.s: Nethanel was a Levite leader who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

2180.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2180.s: Nethanel was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the Exile.

2181.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2181.s: Nethanel was a priest in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

2182.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2182.s: Nethanel was a musician who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

2183.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2183.s: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

2184.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2184.b: Musician in David's time, descended from Asaph
2184.s: Nethaniah was a musician in David's time, brother of Asharelah (or 'Asarelah').

2185.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2185.s: Nethaniah was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

2186.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2186.s: Nethaniah was the father of Ishmael, the assassin of Gedaliah the governor.

2187.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2187.s: Nethaniah was the father of Jehudi, an official in King Jehoiakim's court.

2188.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2188.s: Neziah was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

2189.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2189.s: Nicanor was one of the seven men chosen to assist the apostles in the early Jerusalem church.

2190.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2190.s: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who had several encounters with Jesus.

2191.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2191.s: Nicolaus was a proselyte from Antioch chosen as one of the seven deacons in the early church.

2192.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2192.s: Nimrod was a mighty hunter and ruler who built several notable cities, including Babel and Nineveh.

2193.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2193.s: Nimshi was the grandfather of Jehu, the king of Israel who overthrew the dynasty of Ahab.

2194.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2194.s: Noadiah was a Levite entrusted with the oversight of the treasuries during the time of Ezra.

2195.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
2195.s: Noadiah was a false prophetess who opposed Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

2196.d: Flood survivor living at the time before the Flood
2196.b: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood
2196.s: Noah was a righteous man who built the ark and survived the great flood with his family.

2197.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2197.s: Noah was one of the daughters of Zelophehad who received an inheritance in the Promised Land.

2198.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2198.s: Nobah was an Israelite who captured the town of Kenath and renamed it after himself.

2199.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
2199.s: Nogah was one of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.

2200.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2200.s: Nun was the father of Joshua, Moses' assistant and successor as leader of Israel.

2201.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2201.b: Hosted a church in her house
2201.s: Nympha was a woman who hosted a church in her house in Laodicea.

2202.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2202.s: Obadiah was a Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

2203.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2203.b: Ruler over Zebulun in David's time
2203.s: Obadiah was the ruler over the tribe of Zebulun during the reign of King David.

2204.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2204.s: Obadiah was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

2205.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2205.s: Obadiah was one of the six sons of Azel, a descendant of King Saul.

2206.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2206.s: Obadiah was one of the five sons of Izrahiah, a descendant of Issachar.

2207.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2207.s: Obadiah, also known as Abda, was a gatekeeper and descendant of Jeduthun who served in the temple.

2208.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2208.s: Obadiah was a palace administrator under King Ahab who feared the Lord and protected a hundred prophets during Jezebel's persecution.

2209.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2209.b: Levite sent to teach in Judah
2209.s: Obadiah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

2210.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2210.s: Obadiah was a Levite who served as an overseer during the temple repairs under King Josiah.

2211.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2211.s: Obadiah was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile with Ezra.

2212.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2212.s: Obadiah was one of the leaders who signed the covenant of faithfulness during Nehemiah's time.

2213.d: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
2213.s: Obadiah was a prophet who delivered a message of judgment against the nation of Edom.

2214.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2214.s: Obal was one of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

2215.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2215.s: Obed was an Ishmaelite warrior who fought in David's army.

2216.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2216.s: Obed was a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

2217.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2217.s: Obed was a gatekeeper in the temple, the son of Shemaiah.

2218.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2218.s: Obed was the father of Azariah, one of the captains who supported Joash in overthrowing Athaliah.

2219.s: Obed was the son of Boaz and Ruth, and the grandfather of King David.

2220.d: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
2220.s: Obed-edom was a Gittite in whose house the Ark of the Covenant stayed for three months, bringing blessings to his household.

2221.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2221.s: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of King David's camels.

2222.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2222.s: Ochran was the father of Pagiel, a leader from the tribe of Asher during the Exodus.

2223.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2223.s: Oded was a prophet and the father of Azariah, who prophesied during the reign of King Asa of Judah.

2224.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2224.b: Prophet who confronted victorious Israelite army
2224.s: Oded was a prophet who confronted the Israelite army returning from a victory over Judah, urging them to release their Judean captives.

2225.d: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2225.b: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel
2225.s: Og was the Amorite king of Bashan who was defeated by the Israelites during their journey to the Promised Land.

2226.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2226.s: Ohad was one of the sons of Simeon, as listed in the genealogies.

2227.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2227.s: Ohel was a descendant of Judah through the line of Zerubbabel.

2228.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
2228.s: Oholah was a symbolic name given to Samaria, representing the northern kingdom of Israel in Ezekiel's prophecy.

2229.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2229.s: Oholiab was a skilled craftsman from the tribe of Dan who was appointed to work on the construction of the tabernacle.

2230.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
2230.s: Oholibah was a symbolic name given to Jerusalem, representing the southern kingdom of Judah in Ezekiel's prophecy.

2231.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
2231.s: Oholibamah was one of Esau's wives, a descendant of Seir the Horite.

2232.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2232.s: Olympas was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

2233.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
2233.b: Son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau
2233.s: Omar was a son of Eliphaz and a grandson of Esau, mentioned in the genealogies of Edom.

2234.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2234.b: Chief of the tribe of Issachar
2234.s: Omri was the chief of the tribe of Issachar during the reign of King David.

2235.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2235.s: Omri was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

2236.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2236.s: Omri was a descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

2237.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2237.b: King of Israel; father of Ahab
2237.s: Omri was the sixth king of Israel who established Samaria as the capital and founded a powerful dynasty.

2238.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2238.s: On was a Reubenite who joined Korah in his rebellion against Moses and Aaron.

2239.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2239.b: Descendant of Judah, son of Jerahmeel
2239.s: Onam was a descendant of Judah, the son of Jerahmeel, and had two sons, Shammai and Jada.

2240.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
2240.s: Onam was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Edom.

2241.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2241.s: Onan was the second son of Judah, who was punished by God for his wicked actions.

2242.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2242.s: Onesimus was a runaway slave who became a Christian through Paul's ministry and was the subject of Paul's letter to Philemon.

2243.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2243.s: Onesiphorus was a friend of Paul who often refreshed him and was not ashamed of his imprisonment.

2244.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2244.s: Ophir was a son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

2245.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2245.s: Ophrah was the son of Meonothai, a descendant of Judah.

2246.s: Oreb was a Midianite prince who was killed by the Ephraimites during the time of Gideon.

2247.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2247.s: Oren was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

2248.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2248.b: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David
2248.s: Ornan (Araunah) was a Jebusite who sold his threshing floor to King David, which later became the site of Solomon's temple.

2249.s: Orpah was Naomi's daughter-in-law who stayed in Moab after the death of her husband, while Ruth accompanied Naomi to Bethlehem.

2250.d: King living at the time of Exile and Return
2250.b: Assyrian king who settled people in Samaria
2250.s: Osnappar (probably Ashurbanipal) was an Assyrian king who brought people from various regions and settled them in Samaria.

2251.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2251.b: Son of Shemaiah, gatekeeper of the ark
2251.s: Othni was a son of Shemaiah and served as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.

2252.b: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew
2252.s: Othniel, Caleb's nephew, was the first judge of Israel who delivered the people from Cushan-Rishathaim.

2253.d: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
2253.s: Ozem was one of David's brothers, a son of Jesse.

2254.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2254.s: Ozem was a son of Jerahmeel and a nephew of Caleb.

2255.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
2255.s: Paarai the Arbite was one of David's mighty men, known for his military prowess.

2256.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2256.s: Padon was an ancestor of a group of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

2257.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2257.b: Leader of the tribe of Asher
2257.s: Pagiel, son of Ochran, was the leader of the tribe of Asher during the wilderness wanderings.

2258.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2258.b: Group of returnees from Babylonian exile
2258.s: Pahath-moab was a group of people who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, some of whom married foreign women.

2259.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2259.s: Pahath-moab was one of the leaders who signed the covenant of renewal during Nehemiah's time.

2260.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2260.b: Repairer of the wall of Jerusalem
2260.s: Pahath-moab was one of the people who repaired a section of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

2261.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2261.b: Son of Uzai, repaired Jerusalem's wall
2261.s: Palal, son of Uzai, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the Parbar during Nehemiah's time.

2262.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2262.b: Son of Reuben, ancestor of the Palluites
2262.s: Pallu was a son of Reuben and the ancestor of the Palluite clan within the tribe of Reuben.

2263.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2263.s: Palti (Paltiel), son of Laish, was Michal's husband from Gallim before she was taken back by David.

2264.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2264.b: Son of Raphu, spy from Benjamin
2264.s: Palti, son of Raphu, was the spy from the tribe of Benjamin sent to explore Canaan.

2265.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2265.b: Leader from Issachar, helped divide Canaan
2265.s: Paltiel, son of Azzan, was the leader from the tribe of Issachar who helped divide the land of Canaan.

2266.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2266.b: Son of Haman, killed by the Jews
2266.s: Parmashta was one of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews in Susa during the events of Purim.

2267.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2267.s: Parmenas was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to serve as deacons in the early church.

2268.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2268.b: Father of Elizaphan, leader from Zebulun
2268.s: Parnach was the father of Elizaphan, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun who helped divide the land of Canaan.

2269.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2269.b: Family that returned from Babylonian exile
2269.s: Parosh was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, some of whom married foreign women.

2270.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2270.s: Parosh was a leader who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel, bringing a group of his descendants.

2271.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2271.b: A clan leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
2271.s: Parosh, a clan leader who sealed the covenant of Nehemiah.

2272.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2272.b: A man involved in repairing Jerusalem's wall
2272.s: Parosh, a man who made repairs near the house of Pedaiah son of Parosh.

2273.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2273.b: Son of Haman killed by the Jews
2273.s: Parshandatha, one of the ten sons of Haman killed by the Jews.

2274.s: Parthians, one of the people groups present in Jerusalem at Pentecost.

2275.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2275.b: Father of one of Solomon's district governors
2275.s: Paruah, the father of Jehoshaphat, who was one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

2276.b: Son of Japhlet from the tribe of Asher
2276.s: Pasach, a son of Japhlet, who was a descendant of Asher.

2277.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2277.b: Son of Eshton from the tribe of Judah
2277.s: Paseah, a son of Eshton, who was from the tribe of Judah.

2278.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2278.b: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile
2278.s: Paseah, whose descendants were among the temple servants that returned from Babylonian exile.

2279.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2279.b: Father of Joiada, who repaired the Old Gate
2279.s: Paseah the father of Joiada (or 'Jehoiada'), who helped repair the Old Gate of Jerusalem.

2280.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2280.b: Head of a priestly family that returned from exile
2280.s: Pashhur, the ancestor of a priestly family that returned from Babylonian exile.

2281.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2281.b: Priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib
2281.s: Pashhur, a priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib, meaning "terror on every side."

2282.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2282.b: Priest sent by Zedekiah to inquire of Jeremiah
2282.s: Pashhur, a priest King Zedekiah sent to inquire of Jeremiah.

2283.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2283.b: Son of Gedaliah, an official who opposed Jeremiah
2283.s: Pashhur, the son of Gedaliah, one of the officials who opposed Jeremiah.

2284.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2284.s: Pashhur, one of the priests who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's time.

2285.b: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
2285.s: Pathrusim, a People from Mizraim, son of Ham, according to <ref="Genesis 10:14">Genesis 10:14</ref>.

2286.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2286.b: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
2286.s: Patrobas, a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

2287.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
2287.b: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles
2287.s: Paul, also known as Saul, the apostle to the Gentiles and author of many New Testament epistles.

2288.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2288.b: Leader from Naphtali appointed to divide Canaan
2288.s: Pedahel, son of Ammihud, the leader from Naphtali appointed to help divide Canaan.

2289.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2289.b: Father of Gamaliel, leader from Manasseh
2289.s: Pedahzur, father of Gamaliel, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh during the wilderness wanderings.

2290.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2290.b: Officer over the half-tribe of Manasseh
2290.s: Pedaiah, son of Parosh, an officer over the half-tribe of Manasseh in King David's administration.

2291.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2291.b: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
2291.s: Pedaiah, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah born during the Babylonian captivity.

2292.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2292.b: Father of Zebidah, mother of King Jehoiakim
2292.s: Pedaiah, father of Zebidah, who was the mother of King Jehoiakim of Judah.

2293.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2293.b: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
2293.s: Pedaiah, a Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

2294.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2294.b: Levite appointed as a treasurer by Nehemiah
2294.s: Pedaiah, a Levite Nehemiah appointed as a treasurer over the storehouses.

2295.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2295.b: Father of a man who repaired Jerusalem's wall
2295.s: Pedaiah, father of a man who made repairs to the wall of Jerusalem in Nehemiah's time.

2296.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2296.b: Levite who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
2296.s: Pedaiah, a Levite who stood with Ezra when he read the Law to the people.

2297.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2297.b: King of Israel who reigned for 20 years
2297.s: Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel who reigned for 20 years.

2298.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2298.b: King of Israel who reigned for 2 years
2298.s: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, king of Israel who reigned for 2 years before being assassinated.

2299.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2299.s: Pelaiah, a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 3.

2300.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2300.b: Levite who helped explain the Law and signed the covenant
2300.s: Pelaiah, a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people and signed Nehemiah's covenant.

2301.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2301.b: Priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
2301.s: Pelaliah, a priest who lived in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

2302.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2302.s: Pelatiah, a descendant of King Solomon mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 3.

2303.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2303.b: Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites
2303.s: Pelatiah, a Simeonite leader who joined in an attack against the Amalekites.

2304.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2304.b: Prince of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision
2304.s: Pelatiah, a prince of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision, and who died as Ezekiel prophesied.

2305.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2305.s: Pelatiah, a priest who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

2306.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2306.b: Descendant of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
2306.s: Peleg, a descendant of Shem and ancestor of Abraham, during whose time the earth was divided.

2307.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2307.b: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
2307.s: Pelet, a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag, along with his brother Berachah.

2308.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2308.b: Son of Jahdai, descendant of Judah
2308.s: Pelet, a son of Jahdai, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1Chronicles 2.

2309.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2309.b: Son of Jonathan, descendant of Jerahmeel
2309.s: Peleth, a son of Jonathan and descendant of Jerahmeel, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

2310.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2310.b: Reubenite, father of On who rebelled against Moses
2310.s: Peleth, a Reubenite; father of On who joined Korah's rebellion against Moses.

2311.b: Elite military unit loyal to King David
2311.s: The Pelethites, along with the Cherethites, were an elite military unit loyal to King David.

2312.d: Warriors from or of Pelon or Palet(?)
2312.b: Designation for two of David's mighty warriors
2312.s: Pelonite or Paltite, a designation for two of David's mighty warriors, Helez and Ahijah.

2313.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
2313.s: Peninnah, one of Elkanah's two wives and the rival of Hannah, Samuel's mother.

2314.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2314.b: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah
2314.s: Penuel, a son of Hur and descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 4.

2315.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2315.b: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
2315.s: Penuel, a son of Shashak and descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 8.

2316.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2316.b: Son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh
2316.s: Peresh, a son of Machir and grandson of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 7.

2317.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2317.b: Son of Judah, ancestor of David and Jesus
2317.s: Perez, son of Judah and Tamar, was an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

2318.b: Canaanite people group living in the land of Canaan
2318.s: The Perizzites, a Canaanite people group that inhabited the land of Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

2319.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2319.b: Female Christian in Rome greeted by Paul
2319.s: Persis, a beloved female Christian in Rome whom Paul greeted in his letter to the Romans.

2320.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2320.b: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants
2320.s: Peruda or Perida, the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

2321.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
2321.b: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church
2321.s: Peter, also known as Simon, Cephas, or Simon Bar-Jonah, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus and a prominent leader in the early Christian church.

2322.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2322.s: Pethahiah, head of the 19th priestly division in the time of David.

2323.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2323.b: Levite who married a foreign woman
2323.s: Pethahiah, a Levite who married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

2324.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2324.b: Levite appointed for the king's matters
2324.s: Pethahiah, a Levite appointed to represent the people before the Persian king during the time of Nehemiah.

2325.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2325.b: Levite who led the people in confession
2325.s: Pethahiah, a Levite who led the people in confession and worship during the time of Nehemiah.

2326.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2326.s: Pethuel, the father of the prophet Joel, as mentioned in <ref="Jol.1.1">Joel.1.1</ref>.

2327.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
2327.b: Son of Obed-Edom, a temple gatekeeper
2327.s: Peullethai, the eighth son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in the temple during the time of David.

2328.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2328.s: Phanuel, the father of Anna, a prophetess who witnessed the infant Jesus at the temple.

2329.d: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2329.b: Pharaoh and father-in-law of Mered, a descendant of Judah
2329.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler whose daughter Bithiah married Mered, a descendant of Judah.

2330.d: Pharaoh living at the time of United Monarchy
2330.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who made an alliance with King Solomon and gave him his daughter in marriage.

2331.d: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2331.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler whom Judah's King Hezekiah sought as an ally against the Assyrian threat.

2332.d: Pharaoh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2332.b: Egyptian Pharaoh during Moses' birth and early life
2332.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who oppressed the Israelites and decreed the killing of Hebrew male infants during the time of Moses' birth.

2333.d: Pharaoh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2333.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who refused to release the Israelites from slavery, resulting in the ten plagues and the Exodus.

2334.d: Pharaoh living at the time of the Patriarchs
2334.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who took Abraham's wife Sarah into his palace during their visit to Egypt.

2335.d: Pharaoh living at the time of the Patriarchs
2335.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who elevated Joseph to a position of authority and welcomed his family to Egypt during a severe famine.

2336.d: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2336.s: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler mentioned among those who would face God's judgment, as prophesied by Jeremiah.

2337.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2337.s: Phicol, the commander of the army of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied Abimelech in making treaties with Abraham and Isaac.

2338.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2338.b: Recipient of Paul's letter, Colossian slave owner
2338.s: Philemon, a Christian from Colossae to whom Paul wrote a letter appealing for the reconciliation with his runaway slave, Onesimus.

2339.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2339.s: Philetus, along with Hymenaeus, was a false teacher who had strayed from the truth and taught that the resurrection had already taken place.

2340.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2340.b: One of the seven deacons, evangelized in Samaria
2340.s: Philip, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church in Jerusalem, who preached the gospel in Samaria and baptized an Ethiopian eunuch.

2341.d: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
2341.s: Philip, the son of Herod the Great, who ruled as tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis during the time of John the Baptist's ministry.

2342.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
2342.b: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus
2342.s: Philip, one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus, from Bethsaida in Galilee.

2343.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2343.b: Herod Antipas' brother, first husband of Herodias
2343.s: Philip, the half-brother of Philip the Tetrarch, and Herod Antipas who took Philip's wife, leading to John the Baptist's condemnation of their marriage.

2344.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2344.b: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
2344.s: The Philistines, a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, according to the Table of Nations in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

2345.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2345.b: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
2345.s: Philologus, a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

2346.d: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
2346.b: Wicked son of Eli the priest
2346.s: Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest, was known for his wickedness and died in battle against the Philistines along with his brother Hophni.

2347.d: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2347.b: Aaron's grandson; zealous priest who opposed idolatry
2347.s: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron, was a priest known for his zeal in opposing idolatry and turning away God's wrath from Israel.

2348.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2348.s: Phinehas, a priest who assisted in weighing and recording the gold, silver, and vessels brought to Jerusalem by Ezra.

2349.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2349.b: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
2349.s: Phlegon, a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

2350.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2350.b: Deacon of the church in Cenchreae
2350.s: Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae, whom Paul commended to the believers in Rome.

2351.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2351.b: Believer who deserted Paul in Asia
2351.s: Phygelus, along with Hermogenes, was mentioned by Paul as having deserted him during his ministry in Asia.

2352.d: Ruler living at the time of the New Testament
2352.b: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial
2352.s: Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea who presided over the trial of Jesus and ultimately ordered his crucifixion.

2353.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2353.s: Pildash, one of the sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and Milcah.

2354.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2354.s: Pilha, one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

2355.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2355.s: Piltai, the head of the priestly family of Moadiah during the time of Joiakim, the high priest.

2356.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
2356.b: Edomite clan chief descended from Esau
2356.s: Pinon, one of the chiefs of Edom, descended from Esau, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

2357.s: Piram, the Amorite king of Jarmuth, who joined a coalition against Joshua and the Israelites.

2358.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2358.s: Pispa, a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

2359.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2359.s: Pithon, a descendant of King Saul, mentioned in the genealogies of the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

2360.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2360.s: Pochereth-hazzebaim, a family listed among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

2361.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2361.b: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
2361.s: Poratha, one of the ten sons of Haman, who was hanged along with his brothers after their father's downfall.

2362.d: Egyptian living at the time of the Patriarchs
2362.b: Egyptian official who bought Joseph as a slave
2362.s: Potiphar, the Egyptian officer who purchased Joseph as a slave and later imprisoned him after false accusations by Potiphar's wife.

2363.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2363.s: Potiphera, the priest of On (Heliopolis), whose daughter Asenath was given to Joseph as a wife by Pharaoh.

2364.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2364.b: Early Christian teacher; wife of Aquila
2364.s: Priscilla, also known as Prisca, was a Jewish Christian and the wife of Aquila, who worked with Paul in his ministry and hosted a church in their home.

2365.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2365.b: One of the seven deacons in Jerusalem
2365.s: Prochorus, one of the seven men chosen by the early church in Jerusalem to oversee the daily distribution of food to widows.

2366.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2366.s: Puah, one of the two Hebrew midwives, along with Shiphrah, who defied Pharaoh's order to kill male Hebrew babies.

2367.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2367.b: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob
2367.s: Puah, also known as Puvah, was a son of Issachar and grandson of Jacob, and his descendants were called the Punites.

2368.s: Puah, the son of Dodo from the tribe of Issachar, who's son Tola judged Israel after Abimelech.

2369.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2369.b: Chief official of Malta who hosted Paul
2369.s: Publius, the chief official of Malta, who hosted Paul and his companions for three days after their shipwreck on the island.

2370.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2370.b: Christian in Rome who greeted Timothy
2370.s: Pudens, a Christian in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy through Paul's letter.

2371.b: Gideon's servant who accompanied him to the Midianite camp
2371.s: Purah was Gideon's servant who went with him to spy on the Midianite camp.

2391.s: Ram was the son of Hezron and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

2398.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

2399.b: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites

2400.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs

2400.s: Rebekah was the wife of Isaac and the mother of Jacob and Esau.

2401.b: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God
2401.s: Rechab was the ancestor of the Rechabites, a nomadic tribe known for their faithfulness to God's commands.

2408.b: Father of Hadadezer, king of Zobah
2408.s: Rehob was the father of Hadadezer, the king of Zobah, who was defeated by King David.

2409.b: One of the leaders who sealed the covenant
2409.s: Rehob was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

2410.b: Son of Solomon, first king of Judah

2413.b: One who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time

2416.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2416.b: Son of Hebron, of the tribe of Judah
2416.s: Rekem was a son of Hebron, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

2417.s: Rekem was one of the five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

2420.s: Rephah was a son of Beriah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

2423.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

2423.s: Rephaiah was a son of Tola, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar.

2426.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

2426.s: Resheph was a son of Beriah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

2428.d: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs

2428.s: Reuben was the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah, and his descendants formed one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

2429.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2429.s: Reuel was a Benjamite mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

2430.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs

2433.s: Rezin was the ancestor of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned from the Babylonian exile.

2450.s: Sabteca was a son of Cush and a grandson of Ham, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

2474.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

2478.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
