2498.s: Shaaph, a son of Jahdai, was a descendant of Caleb.

2499.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2499.s: Shaaph, a son of Caleb's concubine Maacah, was the father of Madmannah.

2500.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2500.b: Eunuch in charge of King Ahasuerus' concubines
2500.s: Shaashgaz was the eunuch appointed by King Ahasuerus to be in charge of the concubines in the royal harem.

2501.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2501.b: Levite who opposed Ezra's marriage reforms
2501.s: Shabbethai, a Levite, opposed Ezra's efforts to address the issue of intermarriage among the returned exiles.

2502.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2502.b: Levite in charge of external affairs in Jerusalem
2502.s: Shabbethai, a Levite, was responsible for overseeing external affairs in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

2503.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2503.b: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
2503.s: Shabbethai, a Levite, assisted in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading led by Ezra.

2504.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2504.b: Benjamite who had wives Hushim and Baara
2504.s: Shaharaim, a Benjamite, had two wives, Hushim and Baara, and he sent them away.

2505.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2505.b: Son of Sismai, descendant of Judah
2505.s: Shallum, the son of Sismai, was a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

2506.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2506.b: Son of Josiah, king of Judah
2506.s: Shallum was a son of Josiah, king of Judah, and the brother of Jehoiakim and Zedekiah.

2507.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2507.b: Son of Shaul, descendant of Simeon
2507.s: Shallum was the son of Shaul and a descendant of Simeon.

2508.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2508.b: High priest, son of Zadok and father of Hilkiah
2508.s: Shallum, also known as Meshullam, was a high priest during the time of the kings of Judah, serving as the son of Zadok and the father of Hilkiah.

2509.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2509.b: Gatekeeper of the tabernacle during David's reign
2509.s: Shallum was a gatekeeper of the tabernacle during the reign of David, and his descendants continued to serve as gatekeepers in the temple.

2510.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2510.b: Ephraimite leader who opposed taking captives from Judah
2510.s: Shallum, along with other leaders from Ephraim, opposed the army of Israel taking captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz.

2511.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2511.b: King of Israel who conspired against Zechariah
2511.s: Shallum, son of Jabesh, conspired against Zechariah, king of Israel, assassinated him, and succeeded him as king, reigning for one month.

2512.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2512.s: Shallum, the husband of Huldah the prophetess, was the keeper of the wardrobe during the reign of King Josiah.

2513.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2513.b: Singer who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
2513.s: Shallum was one of the singers who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

2514.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2514.b: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
2514.s: Shallum was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

2515.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2515.s: Shallum was the uncle of Jeremiah the prophet and the father of Hanamel, who sold a field to Jeremiah.

2516.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2516.b: Father of Maaseiah, keeper of the threshold
2516.s: Shallum was the father of Maaseiah, who was a keeper of the threshold during the time of Jeremiah the prophet.

2517.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2517.b: Son of Hallohesh, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
2517.s: Shallum, the son of Hallohesh and ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired a section of the city wall along with his daughters.

2518.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2518.b: Son of Col-hozeh, repaired the Fountain Gate
2518.s: Shallum, the son of Col-hozeh and ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate and the wall of the Pool of Shelah during Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

2519.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2519.b: Nethinim ancestor whose descendants returned from Babylonian exile
2519.s: Shalmai (or Shamlai) was an ancestor of the Nethinim, and his descendants were among those who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

2520.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2520.b: Assyrian king who conquered Samaria and exiled Israelites
2520.s: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, besieged Samaria and conquered the northern kingdom of Israel, exiling its inhabitants and ending the kingdom's existence.

2521.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2521.b: Mighty man in David's army, a Harodite
2521.s: Shama, the son of Hotham the Aroerite, was one of the mighty men in David's army.

2522.b: Judge of Israel who killed 600 Philistines
2522.s: Shamgar, the son of Anath, was a judge of Israel who delivered the nation by killing 600 Philistines with an oxgoad.

2523.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2523.b: Fifth division commander in David's army
2523.s: Shamhuth the Izrahite was the commander of the fifth division in David's army, serving during the fifth month.

2524.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2524.s: Shamir (or Shamur) was a Levite descended from Uzziel, the son of Kohath.

2525.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2525.b: Son of Zophah, descendant of Asher
2525.s: Shamma was a son of Zophah and a descendant of Asher.

2526.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
2526.b: Mighty man in David's army, defended a lentil field
2526.s: Shammah, one of David's mighty men, single-handedly defended a lentil field against the Philistines, resulting in a great victory for Israel.

2527.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
2527.b: Mighty man in David's army, a Harodite
2527.s: Shammah (or Shammoth) the Harodite was one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and skill in battle.

2528.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
2528.b: Mighty man in David's army, son of Agee the Hararite
2528.s: Shammah (or Shagee) the Hararite, the son of Agee, was one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and skill in battle.

2529.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2529.b: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau
2529.s: Shammah was a son of Reuel and a grandson of Esau, and he became a chief of Edom.

2530.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2530.b: Son of Onam; father of Nadab and Abishur
2530.s: Shammai, the son of Onam, was the father of Nadab and Abishur, who were descendants of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron.

2531.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2531.b: Father of Maon, ancestor of Caleb
2531.s: Shammai was the father of Maon and an ancestor of Caleb, a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah.

2532.s: Shammai, the son of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh and Mered who was a descendant of Judah.

2533.d: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
2533.b: Son of David born in Jerusalem
2533.s: Shammua (or Shimea) was one of the sons of David born to him in Jerusalem.

2534.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2534.b: Priest during the time of Nehemiah
2534.s: Shammua was a priest who served during the time of Nehemiah and was a signatory to the covenant renewal.

2535.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2535.b: Spy from the tribe of Reuben
2535.s: Shammua, the son of Zaccur, was the spy representing the tribe of Reuben who was sent to explore the land of Canaan.

2536.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2536.s: Shamsherai was a Benjamite descendant who lived in Jerusalem during the time of the genealogical records in 1 Chronicles.

2537.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2537.b: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
2537.s: Shapham was a leader of the Gadites who lived in Gilead during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

2538.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2538.b: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah
2538.s: Shaphan, the scribe, played a significant role in the religious reforms of King Josiah and the events surrounding the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

2539.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2539.b: Father of Jaazaniah, an idolatrous worshipper
2539.s: Shaphan was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the seventy elders of Israel who were involved in idolatrous practices in the temple.

2540.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2540.b: Overseer of David's herds in the valleys
2540.s: Shaphat, the son of Adlai, was appointed by King David as the overseer of his herds that grazed in the valleys.

2541.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2541.b: Descendant of David during the postexilic period
2541.s: Shaphat was a descendant of King David who lived during the postexilic period, as recorded in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

2542.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2542.b: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
2542.s: Shaphat was a leader of the Gadites who lived in Bashan during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

2543.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2543.s: Shaphat was the father of Elisha, the prophet who succeeded Elijah and performed many miracles during the reigns of the kings of Israel.

2544.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2544.b: Spy from the tribe of Simeon
2544.s: Shaphat, the son of Hori, was the spy representing the tribe of Simeon who was sent to explore the land of Canaan.

2545.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2545.b: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
2545.s: Sharai was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

2546.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2546.b: Father of Ahiam, one of David's mighty men
2546.s: Sharar (or Sachar) was the father of Ahiam, who was one of David's mighty men known for his bravery and military prowess.

2547.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2547.b: Assyrian prince who assassinated his father Sennacherib
2547.s: Sharezer, along with his brother Adrammelech, assassinated their father, King Sennacherib of Assyria, and fled to the land of Ararat.

2548.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2548.b: Delegate sent to inquire about fasting
2548.s: Sharezer was part of a delegation sent to the house of God to inquire about the necessity of fasting in the fifth month.

2549.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2549.b: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
2549.s: Shashai was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

2550.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2550.b: Benjamite leader and descendant of Elpaal
2550.s: Shashak, a Benjamite leader, was a descendant of Elpaal and is mentioned in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles.

2551.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2551.s: Shaul (or Joel) was a Levite descended from Kohath, as listed in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

2552.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
2552.b: King of Edom from Rehoboth on the Euphrates
2552.s: Shaul, from Rehoboth on the Euphrates, was a king of Edom who reigned after Samlah and before Baal-hanan.

2553.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2553.b: Son of Simeon, grandson of Jacob
2553.s: Shaul, the son of Simeon, was the grandson of Jacob and is listed among the descendants who went to Egypt with Jacob.

2554.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2554.b: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
2554.s: Sheal was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

2555.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2555.b: Grandfather of Zerubbabel, descendant of David
2555.s: Shealtiel, the grandfather of Zerubbabel, was a descendant of David and played a significant role in the rebuilding of the temple after the Babylonian exile.

2556.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2556.b: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
2556.s: Shealtiel is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus as an ancestor in the line of David.

2557.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2557.s: Sheariah was a Benjamite, the son of Azel, and is mentioned in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles.

2558.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2558.s: Shear-jashub, meaning "a remnant shall return," was the son of the prophet Isaiah and accompanied his father to meet King Ahaz.

2559.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2559.b: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
2559.s: Sheba was one of the Gadite leaders who lived in Bashan during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

2560.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2560.s: Sheba, a Benjamite, led a rebellion against King David but was ultimately defeated, and his head was delivered to Joab.

2561.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2561.b: Descendant of Joktan, settling in southern Arabia
2561.s: Sheba, a descendant of Joktan, is associated with the ancient kingdom of Sheba in southern Arabia, known for its wealth and trade.

2562.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2562.b: Descendants of Cush, known for wealth and trade
2562.s: The Sabeans, descendants of Cush, were known for their wealth, trade in spices and precious stones, and were mentioned in various contexts throughout the Old Testament.

2563.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2563.s: Sheba was one of the sons of Jokshan, a descendant of Abraham through his wife Keturah, and is associated with the peoples of southern Arabia.

2564.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2564.b: Priest who blew trumpets before the ark
2564.s: Shebaniah was one of the priests who blew trumpets before the ark of God when David brought it to Jerusalem.

2565.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2565.b: Priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
2565.s: Shebaniah was one of the priests who signed the covenant document during the time of Nehemiah, pledging to follow God's law.

2566.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2566.b: Priest during the time of Nehemiah
2566.s: Shebaniah (or Shecaniah) was a priest who served during the time of Nehemiah and is mentioned in the lists of priests and their descendants.

2567.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2567.b: Levite who led the people in prayer
2567.s: Shebaniah, a Levite, was one of the leaders who guided the people in prayer and confession during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

2568.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2568.b: Son of Caleb and his concubine Maacah
2568.s: Sheber was one of the sons born to Caleb and his concubine Maacah, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

2569.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2569.b: Steward of the palace during Hezekiah's reign
2569.s: Shebna was a high-ranking official in King Hezekiah's court, serving as the steward of the palace, but was later demoted and replaced by Eliakim.

2570.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2570.b: Levite descendant of Gershom, in charge of treasuries
2570.s: Shebuel (or Shubael), a descendant of Gershom, was a Levite appointed by King David to be in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.

2571.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2571.s: Shebuel (or Shubael) was a Levite musician appointed by King David to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals in the temple service.

2572.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2572.s: Shecaniah, a Levite priest during the reign of King David.

2573.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2573.s: Shecaniah was a descendant of King David through Jeconiah and is mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants after the Babylonian exile.

2574.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2574.s: Shecaniah, a Levite who assisted in distributing tithes during Hezekiah's reign.

2575.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2575.b: Israelite who confessed marrying a foreign wife
2575.s: Shecaniah, an Israelite who admitted to marrying a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

2576.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2576.b: Descendant of Parosh who returned from exile
2576.s: Shecaniah, a descendant of Parosh, who returned from Babylonian exile.

2577.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2577.b: Descendant of Jahaziel who returned from exile
2577.s: Shecaniah, a descendant of Jahaziel, who returned from Babylonian exile.

2578.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2578.s: Shecaniah, whose daughter married Tobiah the Ammonite, an enemy of Nehemiah.

2579.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2579.s: Shechem, a son of Shemida, from the tribe of Manasseh.

2580.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2580.b: Founded the city where Dinah was raped
2580.s: Shechem, founder of a Hivite city where Jacob's daughter Dinah was raped.

2581.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2581.b: Son of Gilead and Manassite clan
2581.s: Shechem, a son of Gilead and forefather of a Manassite clan.

2582.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2582.b: Father of Elizur, a leader of Reuben
2582.s: Shedeur, the father of Elizur, who was a leader of the tribe of Reuben.

2583.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2583.b: Ephraim's granddaughter who built three towns
2583.s: Sheerah, granddaughter of Ephraim, who built Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah.

2584.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2584.s: Shehariah, a descendant of Benjamin in the genealogy of Saul.

2585.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2585.b: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham
2585.s: Shelah, son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham in Luke's genealogy.

2586.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2586.b: Judah's youngest son and his descendants
2586.s: Shelah, Judah's third son, and his descendants, the Shelanites.

2587.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2587.b: Israelite who married a foreign wife
2587.s: Shelemiah, an Israelite who married a foreign wife during the time of Ezra.

2588.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2588.b: Israelite who married a foreign wife
2588.s: Shelemiah, another Israelite who married a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

2589.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2589.b: Grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll
2589.s: Shelemiah, the grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll to the officials.

2590.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2590.b: Sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah
2590.s: Shelemiah was sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah and Baruch.

2591.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2591.b: Father of Irijah, who arrested Jeremiah
2591.s: Shelemiah, the father of Irijah, the guard who arrested Jeremiah.

2592.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2592.s: Shelemiah, a priest during King Zedekiah's reign; father of Jehucal.

2593.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2593.s: Shelemiah, a priest appointed by Nehemiah as a treasurer.

2594.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2594.b: Levite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
2594.s: Shelemiah, a Levite who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

2595.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2595.b: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
2595.s: Sheleph, a son of Joktan and descendant of Shem.

2596.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2596.s: Shelesh, a son of Hotham (or 'Helem'), from the tribe of Asher.

2597.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2597.b: Father of Ahihud, a leader from Asher
2597.s: Shelomi, the father of Ahihud, a leader from the tribe of Asher.

2598.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2598.s: Shelomith (or Shelomoth), a Levite of the family of Izhar.

2599.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2599.s: Shelomith, a son of Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah after the exile.

2600.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2600.b: Daughter of Rehoboam with Absolom's daughter
2600.s: Shelomith, of King Rehoboam with Absalom's daughter Maacah.

2601.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
2601.b: Descendant of Bani who returned from exile
2601.s: Shelomith, a descendant of Bani who returned from Babylonian exile.

2602.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2602.s: Shelomith, the mother of a man who blasphemed God's name.

2603.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2603.s: Shelomoth (or Shelomith), Levites of the family of Shimei, son of Gershon.

2604.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2604.s: Shelomoth, a Levite treasurer during King David's reign.

2605.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2605.b: Leader of the tribe of Simeon
2605.s: Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, leader of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness wanderings.

2606.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2606.b: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples
2606.s: Shem, one of Noah's three sons and the ancestor of the Semitic peoples.

2607.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2607.s: Shema, a son of Hebron and descendant of Judah.

2608.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2608.s: Shema, a descendant of Reuben, son of Joel.

2609.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2609.s: Shema, a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

2610.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2610.b: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
2610.s: Shema, one of the men who stood beside Ezra during the public reading of the Law.

2611.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2611.s: Shemaah, a Gibeathite warrior from Benjamin who joined David at Ziklag.

2612.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2612.s: Shemaiah, a Levite of the sons of Elizaphan, who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem.

2613.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2613.s: Shemaiah, a Levite scribe who recorded the divisions of the priests.

2614.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
2614.s: Shemaiah, a Levite gatekeeper, son of Obed-Edom, during David's reign.

2615.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2615.s: Shemaiah, a descendant of King Solomon, mentioned twice in the genealogy.

2616.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2616.s: Shemaiah, a descendant of Simeon, son of Shimri.

2617.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2617.s: Shemaiah, a descendant of Reuben, son of Joel.

2618.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2618.s: Shemaiah, a Levite who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

2619.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2619.s: Shemaiah (or Shammua), a Levite who served as a gatekeeper and singer in Jerusalem.

2620.d: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
2620.b: Prophet during the reign of Rehoboam
2620.s: Shemaiah, a prophet who delivered messages to King Rehoboam of Judah.

2621.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2621.b: Levite who taught the Law during Jehoshaphat's reign
2621.s: Shemaiah, a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

2622.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2622.s: Shemaiah, a Levite of the sons of Heman who helped cleanse the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

2623.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2623.s: Shemaiah, a Levite who assisted in distributing the offerings during Hezekiah's reign.

2624.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2624.s: Shemaiah, a Levite who contributed to the Passover offerings during Josiah's reign.

2625.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2625.b: Priest who married a foreign woman
2625.s: Shemaiah, a priest who was among those who had married foreign women during the exile.

2626.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2626.b: Israelite who married a foreign woman
2626.s: Shemaiah, an Israelite who was among those who had married foreign women during the exile.

2627.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2627.s: Shemaiah, a descendant of Adonikam who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

2628.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2628.s: Shemaiah, a Levite summoned by Ezra to join the return to Jerusalem.

2629.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2629.s: Shemaiah, a prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem during Jehoiakim's reign.

2630.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2630.b: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
2630.s: Shemaiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah during the Babylonian exile.

2631.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2631.s: Shemaiah, a scribe in the chamber of Elishama during the reign of King Jehoiakim.

2632.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2632.s: Shemaiah, a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time and participated in the dedication of the wall.

2633.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2633.s: Shemaiah, a priest who played a trumpet during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

2634.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2634.s: Shemaiah, a priest who played an instrument during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

2635.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

2702.s: Shimri was a Levite who assisted in purifying the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

2728.s: Shuhah was the brother of Chelub and a descendant of Judah.

2764.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2764.b: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
2764.s: Sophereth (or Hassophereth) was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

2765.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2765.b: Synagogue ruler in Corinth, co-sender of 1 Corinthians.
2765.s: Sosthenes was a synagogue ruler in Corinth who was beaten by a mob and later became a co-sender of Paul's first letter to the Corinthians.

2766.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2766.b: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
2766.s: Sotai was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

2767.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2767.b: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul as a beloved friend.
2767.s: Stachys was a believer in Rome whom Paul greeted as his beloved friend.

2768.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2768.b: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.
2768.s: Stephanas was a believer from Corinth who, along with his household, was baptized by Paul and later visited Paul to provide support and encouragement.

2769.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2769.b: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.
2769.s: Stephen, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church, was full of faith and the Holy Spirit, performed miracles, and became the first Christian martyr after his powerful testimony before the Sanhedrin.

2770.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2770.b: Son of Zophah, from the tribe of Asher
2770.s: Suah, a descendant of Asher mentioned in a genealogy.

2771.b: African people who invaded Judah under Shishak
2771.s: The Sukkiim were an African people who joined Shishak's invasion of Judah.

2772.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2772.b: Woman who helped support Jesus and his disciples
2772.s: Susanna was one of the women who provided for Jesus out of her resources.

2773.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2773.b: Father of the Manassite spy Gaddi
2773.s: Susi was the father of Gaddi, the spy from the tribe of Manasseh.

2774.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2774.b: Woman in the Philippian church whom Paul exhorted
2774.s: Syntyche was a prominent woman in Philippi whom Paul urged to reconcile with Euodia.

2775.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2775.b: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
2775.s: The Tabbaoth were a family of temple servants who returned to Judah from Babylonian exile.

2776.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2776.b: Man whom Syria and Ephraim wanted to make king of Judah
2776.s: Tabeal was the man Syria and Ephraim conspired to make king of Judah in place of Ahaz.

2777.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2777.b: Persian official involved in accusing the Jews to Artaxerxes
2777.s: Tabeel was a Persian official who joined in writing an accusation against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

2778.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2778.b: Charitable woman in Joppa whom Peter raised from the dead
2778.s: Tabitha, also called Dorcas, was a beloved disciple in Joppa known for her charitable works, whom Peter raised from the dead.

2779.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2779.b: Father of Ben-hadad I, king of Syria
2779.s: Tabrimmon was the father of Ben-hadad I, the king of Syria who was an ally of Asa king of Judah.

2780.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2780.b: Son of Telah, from the tribe of Ephraim
2780.s: Tahan was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Telah and father of Ladan.

2781.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2781.b: Son of Ephraim, ancestor of the Tahanites clan
2781.s: Tahan was a son of Ephraim and the ancestor of the Tahanites clan.

2782.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2782.s: Tahash was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

2783.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2783.b: Levite of the Kohathite clan, son of Assir
2783.s: Tahath was a Levite of the Kohathite clan, the son of Assir and father of Uriel.

2784.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2784.s: Tahath, a descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

2785.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2785.s: Tahath, another descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

2786.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
2786.b: Egyptian queen who raised Hadad the Edomite
2786.s: Tahpenes was the queen of Egypt who gave her sister in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.

2787.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
2787.b: King of Geshur; father of David's wife Maacah
2787.s: Talmai was the king of Geshur and father of Maacah, one of David's wives and mother of Absalom.

2788.d: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2788.b: Anakim king of Hebron, defeated by Judah
2788.s: Talmai was one of the Anakim kings of Hebron defeated by Caleb and the men of Judah.

2789.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
2789.b: Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylonian exile
2789.s: Talmon was a Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylon and served at the temple.

2790.d: David's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
2790.b: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon
2790.s: Tamar was David's daughter who was raped by her half-brother Amnon, leading to tragic consequences.

2791.d: Absalom's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
2791.s: Tamar was the beautiful daughter of Absalom, named after his tragic sister.

2792.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
2792.b: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah
2792.s: Tamar was Judah's daughter-in-law who, after being wronged by him, bore twin sons Perez and Zerah.

2793.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2793.b: Supporter of Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall
2793.s: Tanhumeth the Netophathite was one of the leaders who supported Gedaliah's governorship after Jerusalem's fall.

2794.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
2794.b: Daughter of Solomon; wife of Ben-abinadab
2794.s: Taphath was a daughter of Solomon who married Ben-abinadab, one of Solomon's district governors.

2795.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2795.b: Son of Hebron from the tribe of Judah
2795.s: Tappuah was a son of Hebron, a descendant of Judah.

2796.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2796.b: Son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth
2796.s: Tarea, also called Tahrea, was a son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth.

2797.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2797.b: Son of Bilhan from the tribe of Benjamin
2797.s: Tarshish was a son of Bilhan, a descendant of Benjamin.

2798.d: Persian living at the time of Exile and Return
2798.b: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
2798.s: Tarshish was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

2799.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2799.b: Son of Javan, great-grandson of Noah
2799.s: Tarshish was a son of Javan and great-grandson of Noah, associated with the ancient city of Tarshish.

2800.b: Title of an Assyrian military commander
2800.s: The Tartan was a high-ranking Assyrian military commander who led campaigns against Ashdod and Jerusalem.

2801.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2801.b: Persian governor who questioned the Jews' authority to rebuild
2801.s: Tattenai was the Persian governor of the province Beyond the River who questioned the Jews' authority to rebuild the temple.

2802.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2802.s: Tebah was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

2803.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2803.s: Tebaliah was a Levite gatekeeper, the third son of Hosah.

2804.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2804.b: Father of Ir-nahash from the tribe of Judah
2804.s: Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash and a descendant of Chelub from the tribe of Judah.

2805.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2805.b: Son of Resheph from the tribe of Ephraim
2805.s: Telah was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Resheph and father of Tahan.

2806.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2806.b: Temple servant who married a foreign wife
2806.s: Telem was a temple servant who married a foreign wife during the Exile and later divorced her.

2807.d: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
2807.b: Son of Ishmael, associated with an Arabian city
2807.s: Tema was a son of Ishmael and is associated with the ancient Arabian city of Tema.

2808.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2808.b: Ancestor of a family of temple servants
2808.s: Temah was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

2809.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
2809.b: Grandson of Esau, associated with an Edomite clan
2809.s: Teman was a grandson of Esau and is associated with an important Edomite clan known for its wisdom.

2810.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2810.b: Son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') from the tribe of Judah
2810.s: Temeni was a son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') and a descendant of Judah.

2811.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2811.b: Abraham's father who settled in Haran
2811.s: Terah was the father of Abraham, Nahor, and Haran, who left Ur to settle in Haran.

2812.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2812.b: Persian official who plotted against King Ahasuerus
2812.s: Teresh was one of two Persian officials who plotted to assassinate King Ahasuerus but were discovered by Mordecai.

2813.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2813.b: Paul's scribe who wrote the Epistle to the Romans
2813.s: Tertius served as Paul's scribe, writing down the Epistle to the Romans.

2814.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2814.b: Lawyer who accused Paul before Governor Felix
2814.s: Tertullus was a lawyer hired by the Jewish authorities to accuse Paul before the Roman governor Felix.

2815.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2815.b: Recipient of Luke's Gospel and Acts
2815.s: Theophilus was the recipient of Luke's Gospel and the Book of Acts, likely a Christian of high social standing.

2816.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2816.b: Jewish rebel leader killed by Roman authorities
2816.s: Theudas was a Jewish rebel leader who was killed, and his followers scattered, by the Roman authorities.

2817.d: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
2817.b: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting
2817.s: Thomas, also called Didymus, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting Jesus' resurrection until he saw him in person.

2818.d: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
2818.b: Roman emperor during Jesus' ministry and death
2818.s: Tiberius was the Roman emperor during Jesus' ministry and crucifixion, mentioned in several Gospel accounts.

2819.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2819.b: Rival to Omri for the throne of Israel
2819.s: Tibni was a rival to Omri for the throne of Israel, leading to a divided kingdom until his death.

2820.d: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
2820.b: King of Goiim, ally of Chedorlaomer
2820.s: Tidal, king of Goiim, was one of the four kings allied with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

2821.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2821.b: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel
2821.s: Tiglath-pileser, also known as Pul, was an Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel and received tribute from King Menahem.

2822.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2822.b: Father of Shallum, husband of Huldah the prophetess
2822.s: Tikvah, also known as Tokhath, was the father of Shallum and the father-in-law of Huldah the prophetess.

2823.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2823.b: Opposed Ezra's reforms regarding foreign wives
2823.s: Tikvah was one of two men who opposed Ezra's reforms requiring Jewish men to divorce their foreign wives.

2824.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2824.b: Son of Shimon from the tribe of Judah
2824.s: Tilon was a son of Shimon, a descendant of Judah.

2825.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2825.b: Father of Bartimaeus, a blind man healed by Jesus
2825.s: Timaeus was the father of Bartimaeus, a blind beggar who was healed by Jesus near Jericho.

2826.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
2826.b: Concubine of Eliphaz; mother of Amalek
2826.s: Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau, and the mother of Amalek.

2827.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2827.b: One of the seven chosen to serve the church
2827.s: Timon was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to oversee the daily distribution of food to widows in the early church.

2828.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2828.s: Timothy was a young disciple and co-worker of Paul, who accompanied him on his missionary journeys and later served as a pastor.

2829.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2829.b: Son of Japheth, grandson of Noah
2829.s: Tiras was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, listed among the nations descended from Noah after the flood.

2830.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2830.b: King of Cush (Ethiopia) who opposed Sennacherib
2830.s: Tirhakah, the king of Cush (Ethiopia), opposed Sennacherib's invasion of Judah during the reign of King Hezekiah.

2831.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2831.b: Son of Caleb by his concubine Maacah
2831.s: Tirhanah was a son of Caleb by his concubine Maacah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

2832.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2832.b: Son of Jehallelel from the tribe of Judah
2832.s: Tiria was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

2833.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2833.b: Daughter of Zelophehad, granted inheritance rights
2833.s: Tirzah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who were granted inheritance rights in the absence of male heirs.

2834.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2834.b: Gentile convert and companion of Paul
2834.s: Titus was a Gentile convert and a trusted companion of Paul, who accompanied him on missionary journeys and served as his delegate to the church in Corinth.

2835.b: Clan from the tribe of Manasseh
2835.s: The Tizites were a clan from the tribe of Manasseh, mentioned among the mighty warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

2836.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2836.b: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
2836.s: Tobadonijah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

2837.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2837.b: Ancestor of returned exiles unable to prove lineage
2837.s: Tobiah was an ancestor of some returned exiles who were unable to prove their Israelite lineage and were excluded from the priesthood.

2838.d: Nehemiah's adversary living at the time of Exile and Return
2838.b: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts
2838.s: Tobiah was an Ammonite official who, along with Sanballat the Horonite, opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

2839.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2839.b: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
2839.s: Tobijah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

2840.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2840.b: Postexilic Jew who provided silver and gold for crowns
2840.s: Tobijah was a postexilic Jew who, along with others, provided silver and gold to make crowns for Joshua the high priest.

2841.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2841.b: Son of Gomer, grandson of Japheth
2841.s: Togarmah was a son of Gomer and grandson of Japheth, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

2842.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
2842.s: Tohu, also known as Nahath or Toah, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel, mentioned in his genealogy.

2843.d: King living at the time of United Monarchy
2843.b: King of Hamath who sent his son to David
2843.s: Toi, also known as Tou, was the king of Hamath who sent his son Joram to congratulate David on his victory over Hadadezer.

2844.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2844.b: Son of Issachar, ancestor of the Tolaites
2844.s: Tola was a son of Issachar and the ancestor of the Tolaite clan.

2845.b: Judge of Israel who succeeded Abimelech
2845.s: Tola, the son of Puah, was a judge of Israel who ruled for 23 years after Abimelech's death.

2846.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2846.b: Gentile Christian from Ephesus, companion of Paul
2846.s: Trophimus was a Gentile Christian from Ephesus who accompanied Paul on his missionary journeys and was falsely accused of defiling the temple in Jerusalem.

2847.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2847.b: Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul
2847.s: Tryphaena was a Christian woman in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

2848.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
2848.b: Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul
2848.s: Tryphosa was a Christian woman in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

2849.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2849.b: Son of Japheth, grandson of Noah
2849.s: Tubal was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

2850.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2850.s: Tubal-cain, a descendant of Cain, was the first metalworker mentioned in the Bible, forging tools out of bronze and iron.

2851.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2851.b: Faithful companion and messenger of Paul
2851.s: Tychicus was a faithful companion of Paul who served as his messenger to the churches in Asia Minor.

2852.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2852.b: Ephesian teacher who hosted Paul's discussions
2852.s: Tyrannus was a teacher in Ephesus who allowed Paul to use his lecture hall for daily discussions about the gospel.

2853.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2853.b: Recipient of Agur's wisdom in Proverbs 30
2853.s: Ucal is mentioned in <ref="Proverbs 30:1">Proverbs 30:1</ref> as one of the recipients of the wise sayings of Agur son of Jakeh.

2854.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2854.b: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
2854.s: Uel was one of the Israelites who agreed to put away his foreign wife during the time of Ezra's reforms.

2855.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2855.b: Son of Sheresh, great-grandson of Manasseh
2855.s: Ulam was a son of Sheresh and great-grandson of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

2856.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2856.b: Descendant of Benjamin, known for his numerous descendants
2856.s: Ulam was a descendant of Benjamin known for his numerous descendants, including many skilled archers.

2857.d: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2857.s: Unni was a Levite musician who played the harp and participated in the procession when the ark was brought to Jerusalem during David's reign.

2858.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2858.b: Postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple
2858.s: Unni was a postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple during the time of Nehemiah.

2859.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2859.b: Father of one of David's mighty men
2859.s: Ur was the father of Eliphal, one of David's mighty men.

2860.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
2860.b: Christian in Rome greeted by Paul
2860.s: Urbanus was a Christian in Rome whom Paul called a fellow worker in Christ and to whom he sent greetings.

2861.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2861.b: Father of Geber, one of Solomon's officers
2861.s: Uri was the father of Geber, one of the twelve officers appointed by Solomon to provide for the king and his household.

2862.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2862.b: Father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman
2862.s: Uri was the father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman chosen by God to construct the tabernacle and its furnishings.

2863.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2863.b: Postexilic Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
2863.s: Uri was one of the postexilic Israelites who agreed to put away his foreign wife during the time of Ezra's reforms.

2864.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2864.b: Priest during the reign of King Ahaz
2864.s: Uriah was a priest during the reign of King Ahaz who followed the king's instructions in building a new altar based on a pagan model from Damascus.

2865.d: Bathsheba's husband living at the time of United Monarchy
2865.s: Uriah was a Hittite soldier in David's army, the husband of Bathsheba, who was killed in battle as part of David's plan to cover up his adultery with Bathsheba.

2866.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2866.b: Postexilic priest involved in rebuilding the wall
2866.s: Uriah was a postexilic priest who participated in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem and was entrusted with the temple treasures.

2867.d: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2867.b: Prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem
2867.s: Uriah was a prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem and Judah during the reign of King Jehoiakim, and was killed for his message.

2868.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2868.b: Priest who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
2868.s: Uriah was one of the priests who assisted Ezra in reading the Law to the people during the religious revival in Jerusalem.

2869.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2869.b: Kohathite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
2869.s: Uriel, a Kohathite leader, assisted in bringing the ark to Jerusalem.

2870.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2870.b: Kohathite Levite, ancestor of the prophet Samuel
2870.s: Uriel, also known as Zephaniah, was a Kohathite Levite and an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

2871.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2871.b: Father of mother of Abijah, king of Judah
2871.s: Uriel was the father of the mother of Abijah, king of Judah.

2872.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2872.b: Judahite who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile
2872.s: Uthai, a descendant of Perez, resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

2873.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2873.b: Exile who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra
2873.s: Uthai, along with Zabbud, led a group returning to Jerusalem with Ezra.

2874.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2874.b: Son of Aram, grandson of Shem
2874.s: Uz, son of Aram and grandson of Shem, was an early Semitic patriarch.

2875.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2875.s: Uz, son of Nahor and nephew of Abraham, was an Aramean.

2876.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
2876.b: Son of Dishan, a Horite chief
2876.s: Uz, a Horite, was the son of Dishan, a chief in Seir.

2877.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2877.b: Father of Palal, who repaired Jerusalem's wall
2877.s: Uzai was the father of Palal, who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.

2878.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
2878.b: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
2878.s: Uzal, a descendant of Shem, was one of Joktan's sons.

2879.s: Uzza was a Benjamite born in Moab during the exile.

2880.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2880.b: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylon
2880.s: Uzza was an ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.

2881.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2881.b: Levite of the clan of Merari
2881.s: Uzzah, a Levite of the Merarite clan, was the son of Shimei.

2882.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
2882.b: Died while moving the ark; place named after him
2882.s: Uzzah died while moving the ark; the place was named Perez-uzzah.

2883.d: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2883.b: High priest in the line of Eleazar
2883.s: Uzzi was a high priest in the lineage of Eleazar, son of Aaron.

2884.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2884.b: Son of Tola, grandson of Issachar
2884.s: Uzzi, a grandson of Issachar, was one of the sons of Tola.

2885.d: Warrior living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
2885.b: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin
2885.s: Uzzi, a grandson of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Bela.

2886.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2886.s: Uzzi, a Benjamite, was one of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

2887.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2887.s: Uzzi, a Levite, was an overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem.

2888.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2888.b: Priestly leader in the days of Joiakim
2888.s: Uzzi was a leader of the priestly family of Jedaiah during Joiakim's time.

2889.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
2889.b: Priest at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
2889.s: Uzzi, a priest, participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

2890.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2890.b: Ashterathite, one of David's mighty warriors
2890.s: Uzzia the Ashterathite was one of David's mighty warriors.

2891.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2891.s: Uzziah was in charge of King David's storehouses.

2892.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2892.b: Levite musician in the time of David
2892.s: Uzziah (Azariah) was a Levite musician during David's reign.

2893.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
2893.s: Uzziah (Azariah) was king of Judah, known for his long and prosperous reign.

2894.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

3033.s: Zichri was a son of Shimei, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

3034.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3034.s: Zichri was a son of Jeroham, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

3035.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3035.s: Zichri was another son of Jeroham, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

3036.d: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
3036.b: Levite, descendant of Asaph, temple singer
3036.s: Zichri (or Zabdi), a Levite descendant of Asaph, was a temple singer during the time of Nehemiah.

3037.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3037.s: Zichri was a commander of 200,000 soldiers who volunteered to serve King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

3038.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3038.b: Father of Elishaphat, a supporter of Jehoiada
3038.s: Zichri was the father of Elishaphat, one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah.

3039.d: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3039.b: Ephraimite warrior who killed Maaseiah, Ahaziah, and Elkanah
3039.s: Zichri, a mighty warrior from Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, Ahaziah the governor, and Elkanah the second to the king during the reign of Ahaz.

3040.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3040.s: Zichri was a son of Izhar and grandson of Kohath, of the tribe of Levi.

3041.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3041.b: Son of Joab, a leader in Jerusalem
3041.s: Zichri, the son of Joab, was a leader in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

3042.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3042.b: Head of the priestly family of Abijah
3042.s: Zichri was the head of the priestly family of Abijah during the time of Joiakim the high priest.

3043.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3043.b: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
3043.s: Ziha was a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

3044.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3044.b: Family of temple servants living on the Ophel
3044.s: The temple servants, including the family of Ziha, lived on Ophel in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

3045.d: Woman living at the time before the Flood
3045.b: Wife of Lamech; mother of Tubal-Cain and Naamah
3045.s: Zillah, one of Lamech's two wives, was the mother of Tubal-Cain, the first metalworker, and Naamah.

3046.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3046.b: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
3046.s: Zillethai, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

3047.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3047.s: Zillethai was a son of Shimei and a descendant of Benjamin.

3048.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
3048.b: Leah's maidservant; mother of Gad and Asher
3048.s: Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, bore Jacob two sons, Gad and Asher.

3049.d: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3049.b: Levite, son of Shimei, descendant of Gershon
3049.s: Zimmah, a Levite and descendant of Gershon, was the son of Shimei.

3050.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3050.b: Levite, son of Asaph, during Hezekiah's reign
3050.s: Zimmah, a Levite and son of Asaph, participated in the purification of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

3051.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
3051.s: Zimran was one of the sons born to Abraham and his wife Keturah after the death of Sarah.

3052.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3052.s: Zimri, a Benjamite, was the son of Jehoadah and is mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

3053.d: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3053.b: King of Israel, reigned seven days
3053.s: Zimri, a commander of half of Israel's chariots, became king after assassinating Elah, but his reign lasted only seven days.

3054.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3054.b: Simeonite prince, killed in the Baal-Peor incident
3054.s: Zimri, a prince of the Simeonites, was one of the Israelites killed in the incident involving the worship of Baal-Peor.

3055.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3055.s: Ziph, a descendant of Judah, was one of the sons of Jehallelel.

3056.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3056.s: Ziphah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the sons of Jehallelel.

3057.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3057.b: Son of Gad, progenitor of the Zephonites
3057.s: Ziphion (or Zephon), a son of Gad, was the ancestor of the Zephonite clan.

3058.d: Moabite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3058.b: Father of Balak, king of Moab
3058.s: Zippor was the father of Balak, the king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

3059.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3059.b: Wife of Moses, daughter of Jethro
3059.s: Zipporah, the daughter of Jethro, was Moses' wife and the mother of his two sons, Gershom and Eliezer.

3060.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3060.s: Ziza, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Shiphi.

3061.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3061.b: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
3061.s: Ziza was one of the sons born to King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah, the granddaughter of Absalom.

3062.d: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3062.s: Zizah (or Zina), a Gershonite Levite, was the second son of Shimei.

3063.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3063.s: Zobebah was one of the sons of Koz, a descendant of Judah.

3064.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
3064.s: Zohar was the father of Ephron the Hittite, from whom Abraham purchased the cave of Machpelah as a burial site.

3065.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3065.s: Zoheth was a son of Ishi and a descendant of Judah.

3066.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3066.s: Zophah was a son of Hotham (or 'Helem') and a descendant of Asher.

3067.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
3067.b: One of Job's three friends, the Naamathite
3067.s: Zophar the Naamathite was one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him during his affliction.

3068.s: The Zorathites were a Judahite clan descended from Shobal.

3069.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3069.b: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar
3069.s: Zuar was the father of Nethanel, a leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

3070.d: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
3070.b: Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet
3070.s: Zuph, also called Zophai, was an Ephraimite Levite, an ancestor of Samuel the prophet.

3071.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
3071.s: Zur was a son of Abiel and a descendant of Benjamin.

3072.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3072.s: Zur was a Midianite leader whose daughter was involved with an Israelite, resulting in a plague on Israel.

3073.d: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3073.s: Zur was one of five Midianite kings defeated by Israel during the conquest of Canaan.

3074.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3074.s: Zuriel was the leader of the Merarite Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

3075.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3075.b: Father of Shelumiel, leader of Simeon
3075.s: Zurishaddai was the father of Shelumiel, a leader of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness wanderings.

3076.s: The Zuzim were an ancient people defeated by Chedorlaomer and his allies during Abraham's time.

3077.d: Priest living at the time of Conquest
3077.b: A descendant of Ithamar the son of Aaron.
3077.s: This unnamed descendant of Ithamar was an ancestor of Eli who acted as High Priest.

3078.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3078.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3078.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3079.s: This unnamed descendant of Ithamar was an ancestor of Eli who acted as High Priest.

3083.b: A descendant of Ithamar the son of Aaron.
3083.s: This unnamed descendant of Ithamar was an ancestor of Eli who acted as High Priest.

3084.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3084.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3085.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3085.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3086.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3086.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3087.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3087.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3087.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3088.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3088.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3088.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3089.d: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
3089.b: Ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
3089.s: This is one of the ancestors of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

3090.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
3090.b: The wife of Caiaphas the high priest.
3090.s: A reference to the unnamed wife of Caiaphas, the high priest who condemned Jesus.

3091.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed daughter of Machir
3091.s: The daughter of Machir married Hezron and gave birth to Segub.

3092.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return - unnamed daughter of Meshullam
3092.b: Married Jehohanan, son of Tobiah the Ammonite
3092.s: The daughter of Meshullam was married to Jehohanan, the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

3093.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed daughter of Pharaoh
3093.b: Daughter of Pharaoh - Wife of King Solomon
3093.s: Solomon married the daughter of Pharaoh, forming a political alliance with Egypt.

3094.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed daughter of Pharaoh
3094.b: Daughter of Pharaoh - Rescued and adopted Moses
3094.s: Pharaoh's daughter rescued the infant Moses from the Nile and adopted him as her son.

3095.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed daughter of Putiel
3095.b: Daughter of Putiel - Wife of Eleazar the priest
3095.s: The daughter of Putiel was the wife of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest.

3096.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return - unnamed daughter of Sanballat
3096.b: Married to a grandson of the high priest Eliashib
3096.s: The daughter of Sanballat the Horonite was married to a grandson of the high priest Eliashib.

3097.d: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return - unnamed daughter of Shecaniah
3097.b: Married to one of Tobiah's sons
3097.s: The daughter of Shecaniah was married to one of Tobiah the Ammonite's sons.

3098.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed older daughter of Lot
3098.b: Elder daughter of Lot; mother of Moab
3098.s: Lot's unnamed elder daughter, who bore Moab after the destruction of Sodom.

3099.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed younger daughter of Lot
3099.b: Younger daughter of Lot; mother of Ben-ammi
3099.s: Lot's unnamed younger daughter, who bore Ben-ammi after the destruction of Sodom.

3100.d: Levite living at the time of the New Testament - unnamed father of Barnabas
3100.b: A close relative of John Mark.
3100.s: A reference to the grandfather or other close relative of John Mark.

3101.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy - unnamed father
3101.b: Father of Conaniah, a Levite in charge of offerings
3101.s: The father of Conaniah, a Levite who supervised the offerings during King Hezekiah's reign.

3102.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament
3102.b: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.
3102.s: Elizabeth was the wife of Zechariah, a priest, and the mother of John the Baptist.

3103.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament - unnamed father of Eunice
3103.b: Father of Eunice - Grandfather of Timothy
3103.s: Eunice's father, unnamed in the Bible, was the maternal grandfather of Timothy.

3104.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy - unnamed father
3104.s: The father of Hilkiah, who was the cousin of the prophet Jeremiah.

3105.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed father
3105.s: An unnamed man, the father Naham and his sister Hodiah

3106.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament - unnamed father
3106.b: The father of Mary, Martha and Lazarus of Bethany.
3106.s: The unnamed father of Mary, Martha and Lazarus, who lived in Bethany.

3107.d: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed father
3107.b: Father of Mamre - Amorite, ally of Abraham
3107.s: Mamre's father, an Amorite, was an ally of Abraham during the battle against Chedorlaomer.

3108.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed father
3108.b: Father of Nathan, one of David's mighty men
3108.s: The father of Nathan, one of King David's mighty men.

3109.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed father
3109.b: Egyptian Pharaoh who gave his daughter to Hadad
3109.s: The father of Tahpenes, an Egyptian Pharaoh who gave his daughter in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.

3110.d: Man living at the time of the New Testament - unnamed father of Timothy
3110.b: Father of Timothy - Greek man; husband of Eunice
3110.s: Timothy's father was a Greek man, and his mother was a believing Jewish woman named Eunice.

3111.d: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed husband of Hammolecheth
3111.b: Husband of Hammolecheth - Father of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah
3111.s: Hammolecheth's husband, unnamed in the Bible, was the father of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

3112.d: Levite living at the time of the New Testament  - unnamed husband of Mary
3112.b: Husband of Mary - John Mark's father
3112.s: Mary's husband, unnamed in the Bible, was the father of John Mark.

3113.d: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed husband of Matred
3113.b: Husband of Matred, of Edomite royalty
3113.s: Matred's mother was Mezahab, the grandmother of Mehetabel, who was the wife of an Edomite king.

3114.d: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy - unnamed husband of Shimeath
3114.b: Husband of Shimeath - Father of King Joash's assassins
3114.s: Shimeath's husband, unnamed in the Bible, was the father of Jozachar, one of the assassins of King Joash.

3115.d: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
3115.b: Husband of Zeruiah; father of Abishai and Joab
3115.s: The unnamed husband of Zeruiah, who was the father of David's mighty men, Abishai and Joab.

3116.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
3116.b: Mother-in-law of Peter, healed by Jesus
3116.s: Peter's unnamed mother-in-law, whom Jesus healed of a fever.

3117.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
3117.b: Egyptian queen, given in marriage to Hadad
3117.s: The sister of Tahpenes, an Egyptian queen, was given in marriage to Hadad the Edomite by Pharaoh.

3118.d: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
3118.b: Son of Jashen - One of David's mighty men
3118.s: The son of Jashen, unnamed in the Bible, was one of David's mighty men.

3119.d: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
3119.b: Grandson of Eliashib, married Sanballat's daughter
3119.s: The son of Joiada, a grandson of the high priest Eliashib, married the daughter of Sanballat the Horonite.

3120.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
3120.s: The wife of Heli was sister of Elizather who mothered John the Baptist.

3121.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
3121.b: Wife of Eliphaz and mother of Teman.
3121.s: Wife or concubine of Eliphaz, was the mother of Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

3122.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3122.b: Wife of Ezekiel - Died as a sign to Israel
3122.s: Ezekiel's wife died suddenly, and God used her death as a sign to the people of Israel.

3123.d: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
3123.b: Mother of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb
3123.s: An unnamed wife of Hezron who bore him Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

3124.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
3124.b: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Ram
3124.s: An unnamed wife of Jerahmeel who bore him Bunah, Ram, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

3125.d: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
3125.b: A wife of Josiah; mother of Shallum
3125.s: One of King Josiah's wives was the mother of his son Shallum.

3126.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
3126.b: Wife of Lot, daughter-in-law of Terah
3126.s: An unnamed wife of Lot, who was Terah's daughter-in-law.

3127.d: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
3127.b: Wife of Peter, whose mother Jesus healed
3127.s: Peter's unnamed wife, whose mother Jesus healed of a fever.

3128.d: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
3128.b: Wife of Simeon, the son of Jacob.
3128.s: An unnamed wife of Simeon, the son of Jacob, is mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon's descendants.

3129.d: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
3129.b: Daughter of Abinadab, one of Solomon's wives.
3129.s: One of Solomon's wives was the daughter of Abinadab, who was placed in charge of the district of Dor.

3130.b: A river of Damascus, preferred by Naaman over the Jordan.
3130.s: Abana, a river near Damascus, which Naaman saw as superior to the Jordan River.

3131.b: A Levitical city in the territory of Asher.
3131.s: Abdon, a town allotted to the Levites within the tribal territory of Asher.

3132.b: A large stone in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
3132.s: Abel, a large stone in Joshua's field at Beth-shemesh, where the Ark stopped.

3133.b: A city in northern Israel, also called Abel-maim.
3133.s: Abel-beth-maacah, a fortified city in northern Israel, near Dan.

3134.b: A place near Ammon, attacked by Jephthah.
3134.s: Abel-keramim, a town near Ammon, destroyed by Jephthah during his battles against the Ammonites.

3135.b: A town in Israel, home of Elisha.
3135.s: Abel-meholah, a town in Israel, the birthplace of Elisha.

3136.b: A region ruled by Lysanias when John began preaching.
3136.s: Abilene, a region north of Damascus, ruled by the tetrarch Lysanias.

3137.b: A desert campsite during Israel's wilderness wanderings.
3137.s: Abronah, an Israelite campsite between Jotbathah and Ezion-geber during the wilderness wanderings.

3138.b: An ancient city in Nimrod's kingdom, probably Akkad.
3138.s: Accad, one of the cities in Nimrod's kingdom, likely the Akkadian city of Akkad.

3139.b: A seaport in Asher, also called Ptolemais.
3139.s: Acco, a port city in Asher, later known as Ptolemais.

3140.b: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.
3140.s: Achaia, a Roman province covering much of Greece, with Corinth as its capital.

3141.b: A valley near Jericho, where Achan was stoned.
3141.s: The Valley of Achor, where Achan was punished for his sin.

3142.b: A Canaanite city-state conquered by Joshua.
3142.s: Achshaph, a Canaanite city defeated by Joshua and allotted to Asher.

3143.b: A town in Judah, birthplace of Shelah.
3143.s: Achzib (Chezib, Cozeba), a town in Judah's Shephelah region.

3144.b: A coastal town allotted to Asher.
3144.s: Achzib, a coastal city assigned to Asher but not conquered.

3145.b: A town in the Negev region of Judah.
3145.s: Adadah, a town in the southernmost part of Judah.

3146.b: A city near the Jordan River.
3146.s: Adam, a city beside the Jordan, where the river was stopped for Israel's crossing.

3147.b: A fortified city allotted to Naphtali.
3147.s: Adamah, a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali.

3148.b: A boundary marker for the territory of Naphtali.
3148.s: Adami-nekeb, a place marking the border of Naphtali's territory.

3149.b: A place from which some returned exiles came.
3149.s: Addan (Addon), a place from which some Jewish exiles returned to Judah.

3150.b: A boundary marker for the territory of Judah.
3150.s: Addar, a place on the southern border of Judah's territory.

3151.b: A town in the Shephelah region of Judah.
3151.s: Adithaim, a town allotted to Judah in the Shephelah.

3152.b: One of the cities destroyed with Sodom and Gomorrah.
3152.s: Admah, one of the "cities of the plain" destroyed along with Sodom and Gomorrah.

3153.b: A fortified city built by Rehoboam in Judah.
3153.s: Adoraim, one of the cities fortified by King Rehoboam in Judah.

3154.b: A seaport in Asia Minor, visited by Paul.
3154.s: Adramyttium, a port city in Asia Minor, where Paul boarded a ship.

3155.b: The sea where Paul's ship drifted during a storm.
3155.s: The Adriatic Sea, where Paul's ship was driven by a storm on his journey to Rome.

3156.b: A Canaanite city, later fortified by Judah.
3156.s: Adullam, a city in Judah, known for its cave where David hid.

3157.b: A pass on the border between Judah and Benjamin.
3157.s: Adummim, a mountain pass on the boundary between Judah and Benjamin.

3158.b: A place near Salim where John the Baptist baptized.
3158.s: Aenon, a site near Salim where John the Baptist conducted baptisms.

3159.b: A place where Ezra assembled the returning exiles.
3159.s: Ahava, a location near Babylon where Ezra gathered the exiles before their return to Jerusalem.

3160.b: A Canaanite city allotted to Asher.
3160.s: Ahlab (Mahalab), a city in Asher's territory, not conquered by the Israelites.

3161.b: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.
3161.s: Ai, a Canaanite city near Bethel, captured by Israel under Joshua.

3162.b: An Ammonite city, to be destroyed by Babylon.
3162.s: Ai, an Ammonite city, mentioned in a prophecy against the Ammonites.

3163.b: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.
3163.s: Aijalon, a city allotted to Dan and the Levites, known for Joshua's miracle.

3164.b: A city in Judah, allotted to the Levites.
3164.s: Ain or En-rimmon, a city in Judah's Negev region, given to the Levites.

3165.b: A place on the eastern boundary of the Promised Land.
3165.s: Ain or Rimmon, a location marking the eastern border of Israel's territory.

3166.b: Field purchased with Judas' betrayal money; burial place for strangers
3166.s: Akeldama, also known as the Field of Blood or Potter's Field, was purchased with the money Judas received for betraying Jesus and used as a burial place for foreigners.

3167.b: A pass marking the southern border of Judah
3167.s: Akrabbim, a pass located in the Negev, marked the southern border of the tribe of Judah.

3168.s: Alemeth, also known as Almon, was a Levitical city allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

3169.s: Alexandria, a significant port city in Egypt, played a role in Paul's journey to Rome.

3170.s: Allammelech, a town allotted to the tribe of Asher.

3171.b: A boundary marker for the territory of Naphtali.
3171.s: Allon, meaning "oak," a place on the border of Naphtali's territory.

3172.b: The burial place of Deborah, Rebekah's nurse.
3172.s: Allon-bacuth, meaning "oak of weeping," where Rebekah's nurse Deborah was buried.

3173.b: A campsite during Israel's wilderness journey.
3173.s: Alush, an Israelite encampment between Dophkah and Rephidim during the Exodus.

3174.b: A border town in the territory of Asher.
3174.s: Amad, a town on the boundary of Asher's territory.

3175.b: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.
3175.s: Amalek, a nomadic tribe descended from Esau, who were persistent enemies of Israel.

3176.b: A town allotted to the tribe of Judah.
3176.s: Amam, a town in the Negev region of Judah.

3177.b: A mountain range mentioned in the Song of Solomon.
3177.s: Amana, a mountain range featured in a poetic description of the beloved's beauty.

3178.b: A place near the Euphrates River, associated with Balaam.
3178.s: Amaw, a place near the Euphrates, where Balaam son of Beor lived.

3179.b: A hill near Gibeon, where Joab pursued Abner.
3179.s: Ammah, a hill near Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.

3180.b: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.
3180.s: Ammon, a nation descended from Lot, and its capital Rabbah, often in conflict with Israel.

3181.b: A city visited by Paul on his missionary journey.
3181.s: Amphipolis, a city in Macedonia, passed through by Paul and Silas.

3182.b: A city in the hill country of Judah.
3182.s: Anab, a town in Judah's hill country, captured by Joshua.

3183.b: A border town in the territory of Issachar.
3183.s: Anaharath, a town on the border of Issachar's territory.

3184.b: A town inhabited by Benjamites after the Babylonian exile.
3184.s: Ananiah, a town settled by the Benjamites after the exile.

3185.b: A Levitical city in Benjamin, home of the prophet Jeremiah.
3185.s: Anathoth, a Levitical city in Benjamin, notable as the birthplace of Jeremiah.

3186.b: A tower built by King Uzziah in Jerusalem.
3186.s: The Angle, a fortified tower constructed by Uzziah in Jerusalem.

3187.b: A city in the hill country of Judah.
3187.s: Anim, a town allotted to Judah in the hill country.

3188.b: A city in Pisidia where Paul preached the gospel.
3188.s: Antioch in Pisidia, a city visited by Paul on his missionary journeys.

3189.b: A major city where the gospel spread to Gentiles.
3189.s: Antioch, a city in Syria where the gospel first reached Gentiles and the believers were first called Christians.

3190.b: A city where Paul was taken during his transfer to Caesarea.
3190.s: Antipatris, a city where Paul was brought by soldiers during his journey to Caesarea.

3191.b: A city in the north, site of Aramean battles.
3191.s: Aphek, a city in the north, where the Arameans fought against Israel.

3192.b: A city in the Shephelah, site of Philistine battles.
3192.s: Aphek or Aphekah, a city in the Shephelah, known for Philistine conflicts with Israel.

3193.b: A city in the territory of Asher.
3193.s: Aphek, a city allotted to the tribe of Asher.

3194.b: A city in Macedonia visited by Paul.
3194.s: Apollonia, a city in Macedonia through which Paul passed on his way to Thessalonica.

3195.s: Ar, the capital of Moab, mentioned in the context of Israel's journey and prophecies.

3196.b: A city allotted to the tribe of Judah.
3196.s: Arab, a town in the hill country of Judah.

3197.b: A desert region in the Jordan Valley and southward.
3197.s: The Arabah, a desert plain extending from the Sea of Galilee to the Gulf of Aqaba.

3198.b: A region and its inhabitants, mentioned in various contexts.
3198.s: Arabia, a desert region southeast of Israel, known for trade and nomadic tribes.

3199.b: Arad, Canaanite city, attacked Israel, later inhabited by Kenites
3199.s: Arad, a Canaanite city that attacked Israel during their wilderness journey, later inhabited by the Kenites.

3200.s: Aram-maacah was an Aramean kingdom that allied with the Ammonites against David.

3201.b: A region mentioned in the title of Psalm 60.
3201.s: Aram-naharaim, a region David fought against, as referenced in Psalm 60's title.

3202.b: A region mentioned in the title of Psalm 60.
3202.s: Aram-zobah, a region David fought against, as referenced in Psalm 60's title.

3203.b: A mountain range where Noah's ark rested after the flood.
3203.s: Ararat, the mountain range where Noah's ark came to rest after the flood.

3204.b: A hill in Athens where Paul preached the gospel.
3204.s: The Areopagus, a hill in Athens where Paul addressed the philosophers and preached about the unknown God.

3205.b: A region in Bashan, known for its fortified cities.
3205.s: Argob, a region in Bashan, conquered by the Israelites and known for its many fortified cities.

3206.b: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.
3206.s: The Arnon, a river and valley that marked the boundary between Moab and the Amorites, later serving as Israel's southern border.

3207.b: A city in Judah, receiving spoils from David.
