4035.s: Taanach, a Canaanite city allotted to the tribe of Manasseh, later designated as a Levitical city (<ref="Josh. 12:21; 17:11; 21:25">Josh. 12:21; 17:11; 21:25</ref>).

4036.b: Landmark on the border of Ephraim's territory
4036.s: Taanath-shiloh, a landmark on the eastern border of the territory allotted to the tribe of Ephraim (<ref="Josh. 16:6">Josh. 16:6</ref>).

4037.b: Place near where Midianites fled from Gideon
4037.s: Tabbath, a place near the Jordan River where the Midianites fled after being defeated by Gideon (<ref="Judg. 7:22">Judg. 7:22</ref>).

4038.b: Israelite camp where God sent fire as judgment
4038.s: Taberah, a place where the Israelites camped and experienced God's judgment by fire for their complaints (<ref="Num. 11:3; Deut. 9:22">Num. 11:3; Deut. 9:22</ref>).

4039.b: Oak tree near Bethel, mentioned in Samuel's prophecy
4039.s: Tabor, an oak tree near Bethel, mentioned in Samuel's prophetic message to Saul (<ref="1Sam. 10:3">1Sam. 10:3</ref>).

4040.b: Mountain in Israel, site of Deborah and Barak's victory
4040.s: Mount Tabor, a mountain in Israel, known for the gathering of Deborah and Barak's forces and their victory over Sisera (<ref="Judg. 4:6, 12, 14">Judg. 4:6, 12, 14</ref>).

4041.b: City built by Solomon in the wilderness
4041.s: Tadmor (or Tamar), a city built by Solomon in the wilderness, possibly the later site of Palmyra (<ref="1Kgs. 9:18; 2Chr. 8:4">1Kgs. 9:18; 2Chr. 8:4</ref>).

4042.b: Israelite campsite during the wilderness journey
4042.s: Tahath, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey (<ref="Num. 33:26-27">Num. 33:26-27</ref>).

4043.b: Egyptian city where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem's destruction
4043.s: Tahpanhes (or Tehaphnehes), an Egyptian city where Jewish refugees, including Jeremiah, settled after the destruction of Jerusalem (<ref="Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18">Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18</ref>).

4044.b: Landmark on the southeastern border of Israel
4044.s: Tamar, a place mentioned as a landmark on the southeastern border of the Promised Land (<ref="Ezek. 47:18-19; 48:28">Ezek. 47:18-19; 48:28</ref>).

4045.b: Canaanite city allotted to Ephraim and Manasseh
4045.s: Tappuah (or En-tappuah), a Canaanite city on the border between Ephraim and Manasseh, allotted to Manasseh but with land belonging to Ephraim (<ref="Josh. 16:8; 17:7-8">Josh. 16:8; 17:7-8</ref>).

4046.s: Tappuah, a town in the Shephelah (lowlands) of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:34">Josh. 15:34</ref>).

4047.b: Town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin
4047.s: Taralah, a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin (<ref="Josh. 18:27">Josh. 18:27</ref>).

4048.b: Distant maritime city known for its wealth and trade
4048.s: Tarshish, a distant maritime city known for its ships, wealth, and trade, possibly located in southern Spain (<ref="1Kgs. 10:22; Isa. 23:1; Jonah 1:3">1Kgs. 10:22; Isa. 23:1; Jonah 1:3</ref>).

4049.b: City in Cilicia, birthplace of the apostle Paul
4049.s: Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, known as the birthplace and early residence of the apostle Paul (<ref="Act.9.11, 30; 21:39; 22:3">Act.9.11, 30; 21:39; 22:3</ref>).

4050.b: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos
4050.s: Tekoa, a town in Judah, known as the birthplace of the prophet Amos and the home of one of David's mighty men (<ref="2Sam. 14:2; 1Chr. 11:28; Amo.1.1">2Sam. 14:2; 1Chr. 11:28; Amo.1.1</ref>).

4051.b: Settlement of exiled Jews in Babylonia
4051.s: Tel-abib, a settlement of exiled Jews by the Chebar River in Babylonia, where the prophet Ezekiel lived (<ref="Ezek. 3:15">Ezek. 3:15</ref>).

4052.b: Place where Saul gathered his army
4052.s: Telaim, a place where Saul gathered his army before attacking the Amalekites (<ref="1Sam. 15:4">1Sam. 15:4</ref>).

4053.b: Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians
4053.s: Telassar, a Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians, mentioned in the context of Sennacherib's boasting (<ref="2Kgs. 19:12; Isa. 37:12">2Kgs. 19:12; Isa. 37:12</ref>).

4054.b: Town in the Negev region of Judah
4054.s: Telem, a town in the Negev region of Judah, allotted to the tribe of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:24">Josh. 15:24</ref>).

4055.b: Babylonian city from which exiles returned
4055.s: Tel-harsha, a Babylonian city from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem, but could not prove their genealogy (<ref="Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61">Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61</ref>).

4056.b: Babylonian city from which exiles returned
4056.s: Tel-melah, a Babylonian city from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem, but could not prove their genealogy (<ref="Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61">Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61</ref>).

4057.b: Arabian city and tribe known for trade
4057.s: Tema, an Arabian city and tribe known for its caravans and trade, mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts (<ref="Job.6.19; Isa. 21:14; Jer. 25:23">Job.6.19; Isa. 21:14; Jer. 25:23</ref>).

4058.b: Region and town in Edom, known for wisdom
4058.s: Teman, a region and town in Edom, named after Esau's grandson, known for its wisdom (<ref="Jer. 49:7; Amo.1.12; Obad. 1:9">Jer. 49:7; Amo.1.12; Obad. 1:9</ref>).

4059.b: Israelite campsite during the wilderness journey
4059.s: Terah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey (<ref="Num. 33:27-28">Num. 33:27-28</ref>).

4060.b: Ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power
4060.s: Thebes, an ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power, mentioned in prophecies of judgment against Egypt (<ref="Jer. 46:25; Ezek. 30:14-16; Nah. 3:8">Jer. 46:25; Ezek. 30:14-16; Nah. 3:8</ref>).

4061.b: Canaanite city where Abimelech was killed
4061.s: Thebez, a Canaanite city where Abimelech was fatally wounded by a millstone thrown by a woman (<ref="Judg. 9:50-54; 2Sam. 11:21">Judg. 9:50-54; 2Sam. 11:21</ref>).

4062.b: Macedonian city, site of an early Christian church
4062.s: Thessalonica, a prominent city in Macedonia, where Paul established a church and wrote two epistles to the believers (<ref="Act.17.1-9; 1Thess. 1:1; 2Thess. 1:1">Act.17.1-9; 1Thess. 1:1; 2Thess. 1:1</ref>).

4063.b: Staging post on the Appian Way near Rome
4063.s: Three Taverns, a staging post on the Appian Way, about 33 miles from Rome, where Paul was met by Roman Christians (<ref="Act.28.15">Act.28.15</ref>).

4064.b: City in Asia Minor, home of the prophet Lydia
4064.s: Thyatira, a city in Asia Minor, known for its dyeing industry and the home of Lydia, a convert of Paul (<ref="Act.16.14; Rev. 1:11; 2:18, 24">Act.16.14; Rev. 1:11; 2:18, 24</ref>).

4065.b: City from which David took bronze for the Temple
4065.s: Tibhath, a city from which David took a large amount of bronze, used in the construction of the Temple (<ref="1Chr. 18:8">1Chr. 18:8</ref>).

4066.b: River flowing from Eden, mentioned in Daniel's vision
4066.s: Tigris, one of the rivers flowing from the Garden of Eden (<ref="Gen. 2:14">Gen. 2:14</ref>), and the location of Daniel's vision (<ref="Dan. 10:4">Dan. 10:4</ref>).

4067.b: Canaanite city associated with Judah and Dan
4067.s: Timnah, a Canaanite city on the border between Judah and Dan, associated with Judah's son Er and Samson (<ref="Gen. 38:12-14; Josh. 15:10; 19:43; Judg. 14:1-5">Gen. 38:12-14; Josh. 15:10; 19:43; Judg. 14:1-5</ref>).

4068.b: Town in the hill country of Judah
4068.s: Timnah, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:57">Josh. 15:57</ref>).

4069.b: Town allotted to Joshua, where he was buried
4069.s: Timnath-heres (or Timnath-serah), a town in the hill country of Ephraim, allotted to Joshua, where he was buried (<ref="Josh. 19:50; 24:30; Judg. 2:9">Josh. 19:50; 24:30; Judg. 2:9</ref>).

4070.b: City on the Euphrates, extent of Solomon's kingdom
4070.s: Tiphsah, a city on the Euphrates River, marking the extent of Solomon's kingdom (<ref="1Kgs. 4:24">1Kgs. 4:24</ref>).

4071.b: City attacked by King Menahem of Israel
4071.s: Tiphsah, a city attacked and brutally conquered by Menahem, king of Israel (<ref="2Kgs. 15:16">2Kgs. 15:16</ref>).

4072.b: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel
4072.s: Tirzah, a Canaanite city captured by Joshua, later served as the capital of the northern kingdom of Israel before Samaria (<ref="Josh. 12:24; 1Kgs. 14:17; 15:21, 33; 16:6-23">Josh. 12:24; 1Kgs. 14:17; 15:21, 33; 16:6-23</ref>).

4073.s: Tishbe (or Tishbite), the hometown of the prophet Elijah, located in Gilead (<ref="1Kgs. 17:1; 21:17, 28; 2Kgs. 1:3, 8; 9:36">1Kgs. 17:1; 21:17, 28; 2Kgs. 1:3, 8; 9:36</ref>).

4074.b: Region where Jephthah fled and recruited mercenaries
4074.s: Tob (or Ish-tob), a region east of the Jordan River where Jephthah fled and later recruited mercenaries to fight the Ammonites (<ref="Judg. 11:3, 5; 2Sam. 10:6, 8">Judg. 11:3, 5; 2Sam. 10:6, 8</ref>).

4075.b: Town in the territory of Simeon
4075.s: Tochen, a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon (<ref="1Chr. 4:32">1Chr. 4:32</ref>).

4076.b: Town in the territory of Simeon
4076.s: Tolad, a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon (<ref="1Chr. 4:29">1Chr. 4:29</ref>).

4077.b: A place near where Moses addressed the Israelites
4077.s: Tophel, a location mentioned in Moses' speech to the Israelites, possibly near modern-day et-Tafeleh, southeast of the Dead Sea (<ref="Deut. 1:1">Deut. 1:1</ref>).

4078.b: Site of pagan child sacrifice, south of Jerusalem
4078.s: Topheth, located in the Valley of Hinnom (also called the Valley of Slaughter or Baca Valley) south of Jerusalem, was a site of pagan child sacrifice that was defiled by King Josiah (<ref="2Ki.23.10; Jer.7.31-32; 19:2, 6, 11-14; 32:35; Isa.30.33">2Ki.23.10; Jer.7.31-32; 19:2, 6, 11-14; 32:35; Isa.30.33</ref>).

4079.b: A tower near Bethlehem, associated with the Messiah
4079.s: The Tower of Eder, a watchtower near Bethlehem, where Jacob pitched his tent and later associated with the coming of the Messiah (<ref="Gen. 35:21; Mic. 4:8">Gen. 35:21; Mic. 4:8</ref>).

4080.b: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
4080.s: The Tower of Hananel, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in prophetic visions of the city's restoration (<ref="Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10">Neh. 3:1; 12:39; Jer. 31:38; Zech. 14:10</ref>).

4081.b: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
4081.s: The Tower of the Hundred, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's restoration of the city (<ref="Neh. 3:1; 12:39">Neh. 3:1; 12:39</ref>).

4082.b: A tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
4082.s: The Tower of the Ovens, a tower in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's restoration of the city (<ref="Neh. 3:11; 12:38">Neh. 3:11; 12:38</ref>).

4083.b: A rugged region northeast of the Jordan River
4083.s: Trachonitis, a rugged, rocky region northeast of the Jordan River, part of Philip's tetrarchy during the time of John the Baptist (<ref="Luke 3:1">Luke 3:1</ref>).

4084.b: A valley where Gog's army will be buried
4084.s: The Valley of the Travelers, a location where the army of Gog will be buried after their defeat, blocking the path of travelers (<ref="Ezek. 39:11">Ezek. 39:11</ref>).

4085.b: A city in Asia Minor, visited by Paul
4085.s: Troas, a city in Asia Minor, where Paul had a vision of a man urging him to come to Macedonia, and where he later preached and raised Eutychus from the dead (<ref="Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13">Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13</ref>).

4086.b: A city near Ephesus, visited by Paul
4086.s: Trogyllium, a coastal town near Ephesus, where Paul's ship anchored during his journey to Jerusalem (<ref="Act.20.15">Act.20.15</ref>).

4087.b: A nation, descendant of Japheth, known for trading
4087.s: Tubal, a nation descended from Japheth, known for trading in slaves and bronze, and allied with Gog in the prophecy of Ezekiel (<ref="Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1">Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1</ref>).

4088.b: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade
4088.s: Tyre, a prominent Phoenician port city, known for its wealth, trade, and craftsmanship, often mentioned in the context of judgment and prophecy (<ref="Josh. 19:29; 2Sam. 5:11; 1Kgs. 5:1; Isa. 23:1-17; Ezek. 26-28; Matt. 11:21-22; Act.12.20">Josh. 19:29; 2Sam. 5:11; 1Kgs. 5:1; Isa. 23:1-17; Ezek. 26-28; Matt. 11:21-22; Act.12.20</ref>).

4089.b: A river in Elam, near where Daniel saw a vision
4089.s: Ulai, a river in Elam, near Susa, where Daniel received a vision of a ram and a goat (<ref="Dan. 8:2, 16">Dan. 8:2, 16</ref>).

4090.b: A town allotted to the tribe of Asher
4090.s: Ummah, a town allotted to the tribe of Asher in the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh. 19:30">Josh. 19:30</ref>).

4091.b: A place known for its fine gold
4091.s: Uphaz, a place mentioned in the Bible, known for its high-quality gold (<ref="Jer. 10:9; Dan. 10:5">Jer. 10:9; Dan. 10:5</ref>).

4092.b: The hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia
4092.s: Ur of the Chaldeans, the hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia, from where God called him to go to the land of Canaan (<ref="Gen. 11:28, 31; 15:7; Neh. 9:7">Gen. 11:28, 31; 15:7; Neh. 9:7</ref>).

4093.b: A region associated with Job, Edom, and Arabia
4093.s: Uz, a region mentioned in the Bible as the homeland of Job, possibly located in Edom or Arabia (<ref="Job.1.1; Jer. 25:20; Lam. 4:21">Job.1.1; Jer. 25:20; Lam. 4:21</ref>).

4094.b: A place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
4094.s: Uzal, a place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy, possibly referring to a region in Arabia known for its high-quality swords (<ref="Ezek. 27:19">Ezek. 27:19</ref>).

4095.b: A garden where Manasseh and Amon were buried
4095.s: Uzza, a garden in Jerusalem where Manasseh and his son Amon, kings of Judah, were buried (<ref="2Kgs. 21:18, 26">2Kgs. 21:18, 26</ref>).

4096.b: A town built by Sheerah, daughter of Ephraim
4096.s: Uzzen-sheerah, a town built by Sheerah, the daughter of Ephraim, along with the towns of Upper and Lower Beth-horon (<ref="1Chr. 7:24">1Chr. 7:24</ref>).

4097.b: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
4097.s: The Valley Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in connection with King Uzziah's fortifications (<ref="2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13">2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13</ref>).

4098.b: A place mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy
4098.s: Vedan, a place of uncertain location, mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy as trading with Tyre (<ref="Ezek. 27:19">Ezek. 27:19</ref>).

4099.b: A place mentioned in the Book of Numbers
4099.s: Waheb, a place mentioned in the Book of Numbers, possibly located in Moab (<ref="Num. 21:14">Num. 21:14</ref>).

4100.b: A location near Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in prophecies
4100.s: The Washer's Field, a location near Jerusalem's wall, where the Assyrian officials stood and delivered messages to King Hezekiah (<ref="2Kgs. 18:17; Isa. 7:3; 36:2">2Kgs. 18:17; Isa. 7:3; 36:2</ref>).

4101.b: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
4101.s: The Water Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and associated with the reading of the Law and the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles (<ref="Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37">Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37</ref>).

4102.b: A prophesied highway for the redeemed in Isaiah
4102.s: The Way of Holiness, a prophesied highway in Isaiah, reserved for the redeemed and leading to Zion (<ref="Isa. 35:8">Isa. 35:8</ref>).

4103.b: A place near En Gedi where David hid from Saul
4103.s: Wildgoats Rocks, a rugged area near En Gedi where David hid from Saul and had the opportunity to spare the king's life (<ref="1Sam. 24:2">1Sam. 24:2</ref>).

4104.b: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
4104.s: The Yeshanah Gate, also known as the Old Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall rebuilt by Nehemiah (<ref="Neh. 3:6; 12:39">Neh. 3:6; 12:39</ref>).

4105.b: A town allotted to the tribe of Naphtali
4105.s: Yiron, a town in the territory of Naphtali, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh. 19:38">Josh. 19:38</ref>).

4106.b: A town mentioned in Micah's prophecy
4106.s: Zaanan, a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, possibly located in the Shephelah region of Judah (<ref="Mic. 1:11">Mic. 1:11</ref>).

4107.b: A place near Kedesh in Naphtali
4107.s: Zaanannim, a place near Kedesh in Naphtali, associated with the Kenites and mentioned in connection with the story of Deborah and Barak (<ref="Josh. 19:33; Judg. 4:11">Josh. 19:33; Judg. 4:11</ref>).

4108.b: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
4108.s: Zalmonah, a campsite of the Israelites during their wilderness journey, located between Mount Hor and Punon (<ref="Num. 33:41-42">Num. 33:41-42</ref>).

4109.b: A town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah
4109.s: Zanoah, a town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah, whose inhabitants helped rebuild the Valley Gate during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Josh. 15:34; 1Chr. 4:18; Neh. 3:13; 11:30">Josh. 15:34; 1Chr. 4:18; Neh. 3:13; 11:30</ref>).

4110.b: A town in the hill country of Judah
4110.s: Zanoah, a town in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe (<ref="Josh. 15:56">Josh. 15:56</ref>).

4111.b: A city in Gad and a term for the north
4111.s: Zaphon, a city allotted to the tribe of Gad, also used as a term for the north or the heavenly dwelling place of God (<ref="Josh. 13:27; Judg. 12:1; Ps. 48:2; Isa. 14:13">Josh. 13:27; Judg. 12:1; Ps. 48:2; Isa. 14:13</ref>).

4112.b: A Phoenician city where Elijah stayed with a widow
4112.s: Zarephath, a Phoenician city between Tyre and Sidon, where Elijah stayed with a widow during a famine and performed miracles (<ref="1Kgs. 17:9-10; Obad. 1:20; Luke 4:26">1Kgs. 17:9-10; Obad. 1:20; Luke 4:26</ref>).

4113.b: A place near the Jordan River associated with Israel's crossing
4113.s: Zarethan, a place near Adam and the Jordan River, mentioned in connection with Israel's crossing and the casting of bronze implements for Solomon's Temple (<ref="Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22">Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22</ref>).

4114.b: One of the cities of the plain destroyed with Sodom
4114.s: Zeboiim, one of the cities of the plain, along with Sodom and Gomorrah, that was destroyed by God due to its wickedness (<ref="Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8">Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8</ref>).

4115.b: A town resettled by the people of Judah after the exile
4115.s: Zeboim, a town resettled by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Neh. 11:34">Neh. 11:34</ref>).

4116.b: A valley mentioned in connection with Saul's military campaigns
4116.s: The Valley of Zeboim, a location mentioned in the context of Saul's military campaigns against the Philistines (<ref="1Sam. 13:18">1Sam. 13:18</ref>).

4117.b: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land
4117.s: Zedad, a place mentioned as part of the northern border of the Promised Land in both the Mosaic and Ezekiel's descriptions (<ref="Num. 34:8; Ezek. 47:15">Num. 34:8; Ezek. 47:15</ref>).

4118.b: A city in Benjamin where Saul's family was buried
4118.s: Zela was a city in Benjamin where Saul and his family were buried .

4119.b: A place near Rachel's tomb in Benjamin
4119.s: Zelzah was a place near Rachel's tomb in Benjamin that Samuel referenced when giving directions to Saul .

4120.b: A town in Benjamin; also a hill in Ephraim
4120.s: Zemaraim was a town allotted to Benjamin (<ref="Jos.18.22">Jos.18.22</ref>). Mount Zemaraim in Ephraim was where Abijah addressed Jeroboam's army .

4121.b: A town in the Judean lowlands
4121.s: Zenan was a town in the lowlands of Judah .

4122.b: A Canaanite city captured by Judah and Simeon
4122.s: Zephath, later called Hormah, was a Canaanite city that Israel failed to capture but was later defeated by Judah and Simeon .

4123.b: A valley where Asa defeated the Cushite army
4123.s: The Valley of Zephathah is where King Asa of Judah defeated Zerah the Cushite's large army .

4124.s: Zer was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali .

4125.b: A brook marking the end of Israel's wilderness wanderings
4125.s: The Zered Brook marked the end of Israel's 38 years of wilderness wanderings until they crossed it to enter Moab .

4126.b: The hometown of Jeroboam, first king of Israel
4126.s: Zeredah was the hometown of Jeroboam, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel .

4127.b: A city in Reuben's territory by the Dead Sea
4127.s: Zereth-shahar was a city in the territory of Reuben, located on a mountain in the plain by the Dead Sea .

4128.s: Ziddim was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali .

4129.b: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's
4129.s: Ziklag was a city allotted to Judah and Simeon that was later given to David by the Philistine king Achish .

4130.b: A nation mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against nations
4130.s: Zimri was a nation mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy of God's judgment against various nations .

4131.b: A desert and wilderness region south of Judah
4131.s: The Wilderness of Zin was a desert region south of Judah where the Israelites encamped during their wilderness wanderings .

4132.b: A town in the hill country of Judah
4132.s: Zior was a town in the hill country of Judah .

4133.b: A town in the Negev of Judah
4133.s: Ziph was a town in the Negev region of Judah .

4134.b: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul
4134.s: Ziph was a town in the hill country of Judah where David hid from Saul in the nearby wilderness .

4135.b: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land
4135.s: Ziphron was a place on the northern border of the Promised Land .

4136.b: A pass where Jehoshaphat defeated Moab and Ammon
4136.s: The Ascent of Ziz was a pass where Jehoshaphat defeated the armies of Moab and Ammon .

4137.b: An ancient Egyptian city, probably Tanis
4137.s: Zoan was an ancient Egyptian city where God performed miracles through Moses; it is probably to be identified with Tanis .

4138.b: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction
4138.s: Zoar, also known as Bela, was a small city near Sodom where Lot fled when God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah .

4139.b: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign
4139.s: Zobah was an Aramean kingdom northeast of Israel, conquered by David and later a source of opposition to Solomon .

4140.b: A place in Moab where Balaam blessed Israel
4140.s: The field of Zophim was a place on the top of Pisgah in Moab where Balaam blessed Israel .

4141.b: A town in the Shephelah, home of Samson
4141.s: Zorah was a town in the Shephelah region, originally allotted to Judah and later to Dan, and was the hometown of Samson .

4142.b: A land where Saul searched for his father's donkeys
4142.s: The land of Zuph was a region in Ephraim where Saul and his servant searched for his father's lost donkeys .
